row.name: Ravenmoore Psychiatric Hospital
row.detailed_description: Ravenmoore Psychiatric Hospital: Enter an oppressive and terrifying environment where you play as a young man who infiltrates the old and abandoned Ravenmoore Psychiatric Hospital in search of the harsh reality hidden behind this place, but what you least expected was to end up discovering something much worse than you could ever have imagined. Remember that every sound is a sign of danger... Synopsis : Kaelix Drum, a boy obsessed with exploring abandoned places, is led by his curiosity to Ravenmoore, the abandoned psychiatric hospital in his town, where he finds what he least wanted to find... Monsters and creatures This place is full of secrets, monsters, very disturbing places, and endless horrible things... You will have to deal with every danger in this place if you want to survive and unearth what has been hidden for years. This place ceased to be what it once was a long time ago, due to inexplicable events that still offer no clue as to what happened. But what is certain is that there are extremely dangerous creatures here. Be careful when exploring this place and don't let HER fool you. What could happen to you is much worse than you can imagine... EVERYTHING WILL BE REVEALED.... Key Features: A dark and immersive atmosphere Exploration and immersive, realistic gameplay Secrets and Easter eggs Intriguing and mysterious characters
row.short_description: Explore an oppressive and terrifying environment where you play as a young man who infiltrates the old and abandoned Ravenmoore Psychiatric Hospital in search of the harsh reality hidden behind this place. Every sound can be a sign of danger... Don't let them find you, and especially not HER......

row.name: Train Wreck
row.detailed_description: Train Wreck is a 3D top-down isometric, local co-op, base defense game, where players take the role of train operators delivering cargo across multiple stations while fending off relentless train robbers set in the desert environment of a steamwest world. Players have to maintain fuel levels, defend their train from bandits and repair the damages . Each delivery route is filled with danger, and players achieve victory by successfully delivering cargos to all stations. Keep the train alive. Keep it moving. Work together to manage your steam-powered train as it barrels through treacherous canyons and outlaw territory. Maintain fuel, repair damages, and fend off waves of relentless robbers who’ll do anything to derail your mission. Every player has a role: whether you’re shoveling coal, manning defenses, or patching bullet holes mid-ride, coordination is key. Get on the mounted gun and fight back against the enemies by shooting at them. Hold your ground as waves of bandits try to follow you on horsecars. Time your shots, manage your ammo, and coordinate with your crew to keep the attackers from boarding.  Be aware of the bombs, those can devastate your train. Every mile is a battle for survival in the scorching steamwest. The further you go, the tougher it gets: faster enemies, heavier damage, and tighter resource management. Only the most coordinated crews will make it to the final station. Deliver the cargo, defend your train, and prove your crew has what it takes to survive the Train Wreck.
row.short_description: Train Wreck is a 3D top-down, local co-op base defense game, where players become train operators delivering cargo across multiple stations while fending off train robbers set in the wildwest. Players must maintain fuel levels, defend their train and repair the damages to reach all stations.

row.name: The Good Dog: Chasing Shadows Playtest
リップルアイランド　カイルとキャルのレストラン Playtest
The Tragedy of Ezekiel Asmerom
row.detailed_description: You are the last heir of a cursed bloodline. At the moment of your death, your soul is destined for hell—unless you uncover the truth behind your ancestor’s betrayal and rewrite your fate. Explore a forsaken mansion, read painful diaries, and solve intricate puzzles to gather fragments of forgotten memories. These will grant you access to the mysterious Gallery of Souls, where the secrets of your dynasty await. Your journey leads to the Black Chapel, where you must confront the devil himself and attempt to barter your ancestor’s soul for your own. Your choices shape the story, unlock occult powers, and determine which of the multiple endings you’ll face.
row.short_description: A first-person psychological horror adventure where you explore a cursed mansion, solve puzzles, and uncover dark family secrets to escape eternal damnation.
row.notes: Suicide - Psychological and physical violence

row.name: Maloomify the Ocean
row.detailed_description: Relaxing puzzles Experience a small underwater world full of peaceful inhabitants, loving details, and cozy puzzles. In Maloomify The Ocean, you place, rotate, and change different inhabitants and objects until everyone is happy. Each inhabitant has their own personality, so you have to create the perfect balance in the ecosystem. When everyone is satisfied, your world expands and unlocks new wondrous things. Sit back while you ponder the puzzle and listen to the lo-fi underwater-themed soundtrack. Create your own levels With the integrated Steam Workshop connection, you can easily create your own levels with the level editor and share them with the world! Whether you want to create beautiful, difficult, or crazy levels, it's entirely up to you! Mini-games for variety Some objects cannot be changed easily, which means it's time for a mini-game! Mini-games are small events that make your stay underwater more varied and colorful. Of course, everything is done without pressure or stress. Something new to discover in every corner While you're thinking about how to make everyone happy, you can discover the colorful underwater world. Just click around and see what happens! A student project More than 60 students from the Media Informatics and Interactive Entertainment program at Mittweida University of Applied Sciences developed their own game within two semesters. The program teaches game design, computer science, engine, game art, and team management, offering insight into the gaming industry. For more information, visit:
row.short_description: Maloomify The Ocean is a relaxing puzzle game in which you must fulfill every need of your underwater inhabitants. Each inhabitant has their own personality, so it's important to avoid complications. When all the inhabitants are happy, your game world expands and reveals new, things to discover.

row.name: Night Patrol：Barracks
row.detailed_description: You are the security of this old Chinese barracks apartment. Your duty begins on the first floor. Patrol each level carefully, one by one, until you reach the ninth. Remember : Always move forward, and walk to the end of the hallway. Keep your eyes open. Use your flashlight to check every corner, even the slightest anomalies could be a warning. If you notice anything unusual, turn back immediately!  Ignore it, and the loop will begin again. You’ll find yourself back where you started， and you may never escape this building. The only things you can rely on are your eyes, your memory, Stay alert, and begin your patrol. [Security Operations Manual] Basic Controls: [W/A/S/D] : Move [Mouse] : Control view [E] : Toggle Flashlight [F] : Snap fingers (Activates the voice-controlled hallway lights) Patrol Rules: Observe the hallway carefully. No Anomaly : Walk straight through, go up to the next floor. Anomaly Detected : Turn back immediately, go up to the next floor.
row.short_description: You patrol an abandoned Chinese apartment where time loops endlessly. Watch closely, find anomalies on every floor. If you ignore them, you will never escape this building.

row.name: Grime Reapers
row.detailed_description: Grime Reapers is a first-person horror survival game where you clean haunted houses while trying to survive the shift. Each job places you inside a property filled with monsters and ghouls . Your task is to complete cleaning objectives  while avoiding the hostile entities that roam the house. Cleaning is never safe. Making noise, moving too quickly, or staying in one place too long can draw unwanted attention. To survive, you must work carefully , distract enemies , or hide until it’s safe to continue. Gameplay Features First-person cleaning gameplay focused on completing objectives within haunted houses Stealth-based survival mechanics where enemies react to player actions Monsters that patrol environments and investigate disturbances Distraction and hiding systems to avoid confrontation Rising tension as the shift progresses and danger increases Survive the shift by completing enough objectives to escape alive In Grime Reapers , success isn’t just about doing a good job  it’s about making it out alive . Developed as a group project as part of the Indie Game Development Course at Falmouth University.
row.short_description: Grime Reapers is a first-person horror survival game where you clean haunted houses while avoiding monsters and ghouls. Complete cleaning objectives, distract enemies, or hide to survive your shift and escape the house alive.

row.name: Gobotix: Duo
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the Gobotix, a robot manufacturing company that runs by robots. In this distant future, humanity is long gone. The two bots - remnants of an advanced civilization - are undergoing a quality test to prove their worth. Yet with each completed challenge, they uncover fragments of forgotten messages from the past, learning not only about their makers but about what it means to exist. About the Game Step into a world where logic meets rhythm. Control two curious robots; each with their own charm and personality - through a series of mind-bending platform puzzles. Whether you play solo or cooperate with a friend, every level challenges your perception of space, timing, and teamwork. Your goal is simple: solve puzzles, activate mechanisms, and reach the glowing portal that marks your success. But the path is never straightforward; buttons, lifts, portals, and physics-based contraptions will test your every move. A Game That Plays Its Own Music Every click, every command becomes part of the soundtrack. The game runs on an infinite looping beat, and each of your interactions adds a new musical note - creating a unique rhythm for every session. No two playthroughs ever sound the same. Your puzzle-solving journey literally shapes the music. What to expect Two playable robots with distinct personalities Designed for both single player and co-op play Isometric 3D visuals with smooth, minimalist design Reactive soundtrack that evolves with your actions Clever physics elements for dynamic puzzle solving Free to play — with optional DLC packs that simply support the developers Support the Robots The game is completely free. Optional DLCs offer no gameplay advantages; only a way to show support through the 'pay what you want' options. Supporters might just see their robots react with a little extra warmth and surprise during their adventures. The Journey Ahead The game currently features 25 handcrafted levels, each designed to test precision, logic, and rhythm. New levels will be released as free content packages, expanding the robots’ story and world over time.
row.short_description: Guide two tiny robots through clever 3D isometric puzzles; solo or in co-op. Every click adds a new note to the game’s looping beat, making each run sound unique. Free to play, with optional supporter DLCs that add nothing but love.

row.name: In Our Parlor
row.detailed_description: STORY - In Our Parlor tells the story of a game developer who falls asleep at home and dreams about the game world they're creating. To end the nightmare and wake up, they must make their way through their own creation and reach the parlor. THE EXPERIENCE - Atmospheric horror and realistic set pieces make this horror walking simulator an immersive and terrifying experience. The surreal settings and music drive this mysterious narrative.  GAMEPLAY - Using only the light of a lantern, navigate a series of dark set pieces and follow the music to discover the path forward. The player must make their way through a mysterious manor to unfold the story, find the parlor, and escape this nightmare. MUSIC - Featuring original music by Kyle Faber
row.short_description: In Our Parlor is a short, horror walking simulator. The player must make their way through a mysterious manor to unfold the story, find the parlor, and escape this nightmare. Navigate a series of dark set pieces and follow the music to discover the path forward.

row.name: Lost Trust-Episode 1
row.detailed_description: Story: After years apart, you return to visit a friend you’ve known your whole life. It was supposed to be a quiet evening — but soon, you realize you’re not as alone as you thought. Slowly, you uncover a betrayal far darker than you could ever imagine. Gameplay:  The game is a first-person experience with a linear story, where players explore environments and uncover secrets, all presented in a retro PSX-style graphics. “A short, intense experience lasting about 30 minutes .”
row.short_description: After years apart, you visit an old friend for what should’ve been a quiet evening. But you soon realize you’re not alone and a dark betrayal awaits .The game is a first-person, linear PSX-style experience focused on exploration and uncovering secrets.”

row.name: Desktop Waifu
row.detailed_description: Whether you're working or relaxing, your Desktop Waifu will always stay on the top layer of your screen, keeping you company. By idling in the game, you can unlock new outfits—and once unlocked, you can switch to them anytime. The current version includes 3 outfits, with future updates adding more clothing irregularly, or as DLC releases.
row.short_description: This is an idle game. By idling in the game, you can unlock new outfits—and once unlocked, you can switch to them anytime.
row.notes: There's a purple dress that shows some cleavage

row.name: Milk Mafia
row.detailed_description: Brine City is a battleground where rival dairy and snail-slime cartels fight for control — turf, trade, and pride all on the line. Ever played a game and wished you could go off-script during a big conversation? Argue your point, try to sweet-talk someone, or just see what happens when you don't pick from a list of three options? That's the core idea behind Milk Mafia . While there's a main story to follow, the real heart of the game is in the Debates . These are high-stakes conversations where your words are your best weapon. Each debate is its own unique scenario, dropping you into a room with a cast of characters who have their own personalities, goals, and hidden agendas. And here's the twist: these characters aren't just reading from a script. We've built a social AI simulation that runs completely on your PC, allowing them to generate their own responses based on what you say. They'll react to your arguments, and might even be swayed if you make a good point. It makes every debate feel like a real, unscripted conversation where you have to think on your feet. It's a game about figuring out how to deal with difficult people in tricky situations.
row.short_description: An AI-driven narrative adventure where rival dairy and snail-slime gangs battle for control of Brine City. Engage in high-stakes debates where every word counts—argue, persuade, and outsmart unpredictable characters who think and react in real time.
row.notes: There are mild mentions of violence in a comedic setting and use of tobacco.

row.name: Boxed Up!
row.detailed_description: 'Welcome back to hell, now with added hell!' The world is being overrun by monsters, the last hope? A parcel delivery company Boxed up is a first-person Parcel-Scanning simulation game with a ghoulish twist! Certain boxes contain monsters, and its up to you to figure it out, match the given stats to the box's actual measurements and info. Your office contains many gadgets and gizmos to help you find fault in the boxes. If something doesn't match, its a discrepancy, and the box must be thrown out, as it will contain a monster. Each day the monsters will adapt and new discrepancies will arise, along with the quota of boxes needed! Make sure to upgrade and keep your machines healthy so you can keep up with the increased demand. Who knows what you'll unpack in Boxed Up! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Box Sorter – Contract Position (For Official Applicants Only) As a world-class organization, the Box Company™ is passionate about warehouses, packaging, delivery, and excellence! As Box Sorter, your role will be to act as a champion of quality, destroying discrepant packages that do not follow our strict Box Company™ standards. With your skills, you will keep all Box Company™ boxes to this standard, faultless and troll free!* *The Box Company™ denies any and all claims of trolls infiltrating our packaging. Such claims are without evidence and are fabricated by conspirators. What You’ll Do · Act as a final assurance of quality, checking each box individually for discrepancies. · Perform tests with top-of-the-line Box Company™ equipment, such as the Metal Detector, state of the art computers from decades past, and exciting barcode scanners! · Proactively work with other disciplines, using our unique industry standard E-mail system to correspond and communicate with our various teams. · Meet your quota of boxes each shift, motivated by our fair and infallible strike system. · Send off our troll-free boxes to be delivered, ensuring no non-existent trolls have not un-infiltrated our packaging. Scanner & Computer The scanner is the bread and butter of any good box sorter. Competent workers scan labels for details about their package, a helpful tool in analysing for discrepancies. Info desk We understand that many workers are forgetful, that’s why we’ve installed a secondary computer to your workstation with all the relevant information needed to remind you again and again! Scale Measure the weight of all your packages with this industrial grade scale! A necessary tool for confirming details of your package, this scale will ensure no box-related problems ever weigh on you again. Metal detector Some packages come with declarations of contents, and metal is an important one to keep track of for the Box Company™. Use this heavy-duty machine to search packages for traces of metal and confirm their contents. (DO NOT PLACE ANY LIMBS OR BODY PARTS INSIDE THE MACHINE AT ANY TIME) Sorter / incinerator When your job is done correctly, it’s time to send off the package to be delivered or destroyed. Luckily, your sorting machine will do the legwork for you. Simply pull the right lever to send your package off or watch it burn before your eyes! Footnote The Box Company™ is excited to hire you! We hope you apply for this unmissable opportunity soon, to become a valued cog in our welcoming and friendly machine, and we hope to receive your application Boxed Up!
row.short_description: The Box Company™ is excited to hire you as our new Box Sorter! Act as our champion of quality, destroying discrepant packages, and keeping our service faultless and troll free!* *The Box Company™ denies any and all claims of trolls infiltrating our packaging. Such claims are without evidence.

row.name: Out Of The Shadows (2025)
row.detailed_description: “Ten years behind bars for a crime I didn’t commit. Tonight, it ends.” Out of the Shadows is a third-person stealth adventure thriller about escaping a high-security prison and uncovering a deadly conspiracy. You play as Dr. Graham Ellington , a scientist framed for leaking nuclear secrets. After a decade in isolation, a mysterious note offers one final chance at freedom. Sneak through shadow-drenched corridors , outsmart patrolling guards , and use  light manipulation, blind spots , and environmental stealth to stay undetected. Every sound matters — every move could expose you. As you escape the prison , uncover hidden clues about who framed you and why. What begins as a story of survival turns into a pursuit of truth, revenge, and redemption. Key Features Stealth Gameplay: Hide in shadows, disable lights, throw objects, and silently take down guards. Cinematic Storytelling: Experience an emotional narrative driven by voiceovers, atmosphere, and tension. Environmental Puzzles: Find keys, disable power grids, and manipulate your surroundings to escape. Immersive Audio & Visuals: Dynamic lighting, echoing footsteps, and environmental ambience build a tense prison world. Linear, Story-Rich Experience: A focused 20–25 minutes stealth adventure. Escape. Survive. Uncover the truth. Out of the Shadows is perfect for players who love story-rich stealth games , cinematic adventures , and tense, atmospheric escapes where every step counts.
row.short_description: A stealth adventure thriller where every shadow is your ally. Escape a maximum-security prison as a framed scientist in this story-driven third-person game of survival and revenge.
publishers: The National Film and Television School

row.name: PUNCH FOREVER
row.detailed_description: Extended version of the Winner of Ludum Dare 54 (Fun #1) game. Including new game modes, multi-platform support and much more! LIMITED SPACE – original 27 levels with challenges and bosses ARENA – fight 1 on 1 in Local League to earn the reputation 2 PLAYERS – play PvP hot-seat even with one controller SURVIVAL – stand up against waves of enemies with rogue-lite perks and meta upgrades
row.short_description: Smash opponents with punches! Dive into a world of chaotic brawls, climb the PvE League, master wild physics, and survive the roguelite mayhem. Face your friend in the hot-seat 2-player arena and see who wobbles last!

row.name: JellieShift
row.detailed_description: Jump into the world of JellieShift,  where you play as Jellie, an adventurous, hue-shifting blob trapped in a mysterious underwater land.  ~ Discover unique crystals and abilities ~ Explore and discover four different jelly crystals that grant you unique power-ups! ~ Shoot to manipulate the environment ~ Alter your environment by spitting empowered jelly blobs at blocks to change their physical properties.  Make blocks sink, vanish, or bouncy to navigate the world! ~ Switch between three states ~  Freely shift between three crystals! With only two swappable crystal slots, make choices about which crystals to keep, swap, or drop as you encounter new situations that require different combinations of abilities.  ~ Solve puzzles and collect treasures ~  Experiment, create, and discover strategies to master the manipulation of the world around you and make your escape in record time! Early Access Features: Original handcrafted pixel art and visuals. Relaxing 2D puzzle platforming with reticule-assisted aiming and shooting. Controller supported and encouraged! Explore 10 individually crafted levels and discover new mechanics, puzzles, and strategies. Experiment with 4 unique abilities, apply different combinations, and solve your way to the exit. Collect shells and unlock cute accessories to make your adventures more enjoyable! Speedrun and replay levels to achieve high scores! You are in control of your hue . Showcased at SXSW Sydney Student Games Showcase 2025!
row.short_description: Shoot, explore, and navigate a mysterious underwater environment, solving puzzles and meeting curious creatures to make your escape! Discover crystals that grant strange abilities and use these powers to alter the properties of the world around you!

row.name: Pax Autocratica: Prologue
row.detailed_description: If you enjoyed the Prologue, wishlist & follow the full game to get notified at launch About the Game 1% of all net revenue from Pax Autocratica will be donated to support people forced too flee violence in conflict areas through the Norwegian Refugee Council (NRC), a politically neutral humanitarian organization assisting civilians affected by war, displacement, and oppression. The free prologue of 'Pax Autocratica' invites you to establish the foundations of the greatest regime in history in this darkly satirical totalitarian colony sim + FPS roguelite hybrid. You are tasked with managing and leading your citizens to spread your doctrine through the first sector 'Elysia' and free it from the oppression of the current ruling power. Add the Prologue to your wishlist to be notified on release. If you enjoy it, wishlist the full game. Dictate wisely as your choices will shape society, for better or worse. Notes about the Prologue: The Prologue contains a limited portion of the full game. The scale of the base and the battles is smaller than in Early Access. Certain advanced systems, such as deeper automation, mechs, and other late‑game mechanics, are not available here. Content and balance may change before Early Access release. Content Breakdown (subject to change) : 1 space sector & boss (out of 4 in Full Game) 47 roguelite buffs (out of 225 in Early Access) 16 buildings (out of 65 in Early Access) 6 weapons (out of 18 in Early Access) 3 player classes (out of 10 in Early Access) 9 troop types (out of 29 in Early Access) 7 policies (out of 189 in Early Access) Mold your populace by enacting tyrannical or benevolent reforms to sway your citizens’ Fear, Happiness, Hunger, and Loyalty. Indoctrinate them through propaganda, surveillance towers, whippings, and public executions until even their dreams serve the State. Or rise as the benevolent visionary of a new age, providing comfort, healthcare, and prosperity to those who once despaired. Every decree shapes the soul of your regime, and the fate of those who live beneath it. Build your state apparatus. Turn a handful of survivors into a tightly run, self-sustaining machine. Expand your base from a cluster of shelters into an immense complex housing a growing population, each citizen serving the grand design of your regime. Research new technologies, buildings, and doctrines to refine your colony’s efficiency and tighten your control. Automate production lines and streamline logistics in the full game. In the Prologue, lay the groundwork and watch facilities hum with the cold precision of industry. Every upgrade is efficiency, every structure, a testament to your vision. You, the Leader of Auroria, will venture into the frontier of the Tyris System to conquer the fractured territories ruled by rival regimes. Conscript new citizens, gather vital resources, trade with wandering merchants, and influence local populations through decisive acts that shift the balance of power. Then lead your forces into battle. From desperate skirmishes to large-scale mechanized battlefields of infantry, tanks, and mechs, each victory is another step in spreading the regime. During each expedition, choose among dozens of roguelite buffs in the Prologue (hundreds in the full game) to forge your path toward absolute supremacy. Each campaign strengthens your base, your army and you, the Leader, alike: new resources, new recruits, and experience that unlocks advanced class skills. No two expeditions unfold the same. Pax Autocratica is a totalitarian colony sim and FPS roguelite hybrid that combines base building, citizen management, and first-person tactical combat in a sci-fi dystopian world. It offers a dynamic, accessible, and approachable gameplay experience for all. It’s a game about power. How it’s built, how it corrupts, and how it consumes. You will command armies, dictate laws, and witness consequences in every face that salutes you or fears you. THE STATE OBSERVES ALL How will history remember your reign?
row.short_description: Free stand‑alone Prologue. Shape a grand colony where every life bends to your will. Feel the weight of absolute power as you decree laws, then march into chaos, leading squads in roguelite FPS battles from brutal skirmishes to large-scale battlefields. Play Sector One now & wishlist the full game.
row.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work

row.name: Valiant Attempt
row.detailed_description: This is a DEMO of a game, not a full game, made in collaboration with Jyväskylä University of Applied Sciences. The Valiant Attempt is a story-driven 3D action RPG set in a low-poly world on the brink of collapse. You play as a displaced noble turned mercenary, wandering through the ruins of nations devoured by war. Alongside AI-driven companions, you’ll battle, explore, and make choices that may change what’s left of your world — or simply survive it. Gameplay Gameplay in The Valiant Attempt mixes real-time combat with reactive AI behavior. Enemies coordinate with each other, allies respond to your actions, as enemies and you try to defeat each. Combat blends physical collisions, directional strikes, and projectile mechanics — every swing, block, or spell feels grounded in motion and timing. Story and World Generations after a fallen empire’s monsters reshaped the realm, humanity’s own greed has reignited the cycle of conquest. Your homeland lies divided, your family’s fate unknown, and rumors speak of an ancient artifact that could end — or escape — the endless war. Whether it’s myth or salvation is yours to uncover. Key Features AI-Driven Companions & Enemies — Battle alongside allies who think and react dynamically. Physics-Based Combat — Engage in melee and ranged fights where positioning, timing, and precision matter. Interactive Narrative — Experience dialogue-driven encounters that reveal character and consequence. Low-Poly Aesthetic — Explore a handcrafted 3D world with a clean, stylized look. Atmospheric Worldbuilding — A somber tone underscored by a world weary of conflict.
row.short_description: A low-poly 3D action RPG where you fight, talk, and survive alongside AI-driven companions in a world consumed by endless war. Master physics-based combat, form bonds with companions, and uncover what remains worth saving.

row.name: Once Upon a Shell
row.detailed_description: Once Upon a Shell is a roguelike racing game of ridiculous speed and wild upgrades. As a tortoise, use your shell to your advantage and slide downhill to generate speed. Build movement combos between races and prove that even a tortoise can lift The Hare Cup. Features: Race at Ridiculous Speeds Outrun a pack of overconfident hares in chaotic, fast-paced races where momentum is everything. Master the Shell Slide Tuck into your shell to drift around the grasslands with ecstatic speed. Evolve Your Movement Unlock movement upgrades that influence how you gain speed and how fast you become. Claim the Hare Cup Conquer all four divisions in a single run to prove, once and for all, that the tortoise can beat the hares. A Living Fable Explore a charming watercolor storybook world that continues the classic tale of The Tortoise and the Hare . Credits: Game Director: Vladimír Hořký Producer: Viktor Máni Mønster Game Designer: Anita Tiwari Level Designer: Mikkel Gam-Pedersen Composer: Niels De Fine Olivarius Audio Programmer: Asger Fihl Hedegaard Nielsen Art Director: Emili Mikkelsen Visual Artist: Lucia Šupová Technical Artist: Jacob Kjerulf-Thomasen Lead Programmer: Philip Hviid-Wodschow Programmer: Claudiu Mihai Jechel Programmer: Sebastian Giovanni Murgia Kristensen Programmer: Viktor Krarup Andersen This game was created as part of the DADIU 2025 program in Copenhagen.
row.short_description: Once Upon a Shell is a roguelike racing game of ridiculous speed and wild upgrades. As a tortoise, use your shell to your advantage and slide downhill to generate speed. Build movement combos between races and prove that even a tortoise can lift The Hare Cup.

row.name: 矮人炮弹 Dwarven Cannonball Playtest
Ninja Warp
row.detailed_description: Choose between a variety of weapons, skills, and characters to fend off the ever growing waves of enemies. The choices you make will heavily influence the tide of the battle. Each enemy has their own unique attacks and behaviors, creating different challenges after each stage. Be sure to look for weaknesses and patterns in the enemies you face. Enemies will work together to take you down; some will focused on supporting allies while others will charge you head on. Watch out for the glowing elite creatures! Unlock upgrades after each run to become strong enough to take on the final boss!
row.short_description: A top-down Rougelike with a focus on build diversity and unique enemies. Fight through the eldritch monsters with your ninja skills!

row.name: Feast of Fools
row.detailed_description: You have been invited to a mysterious dinner party. But alas, it seems you are to be the dinner! Feast of Fools is a turn-based horror game - escape the haunted house, all while avoiding the endless waves of unspeakable horrors. Endless Horrors : No matter how many you fell, yet more monstrosities crawl forth from the shadows. They are unending. Stay away from from the eyes in the darkness - when you stare into the abyss, the abyss stares back. Escape or Perish : Run, run for the doors! The manor is massive, but if you can get in, you can surely get out. Any who fall behind are lost. Flee, and you may yet survive! Give Me a Hand : You must work with your other dinner guests to navigate the haunted halls of the manor. Each guest has their own abilities to push and pull yourselves out of danger. The Dinner Party Who of our party will survive? And who will be yet more of the feast? Your party must work together to survive, ach in their own manner: The Professor: A student of science. Can pull his allies away from danger. The Lady: The daughter of a lesser baron. Can push her allies forward, towards the doors. The Priest: The steward of the local church. Can heal his allies. But be warned, he cannot heal himself!
row.short_description: You have been invited to a mysterious dinner party. But alas, it seems you are to be the dinner! Flee, and you may yet survive!!

row.name: Предновогодняя сказка
row.detailed_description: This is a romantic story about a Drow named Violet, who teleported to Russia in the early 2000s, and a simple Russian guy named Ivan, who found her. The dark elf went to our world in search of the missing stone from the family pendant. This is a story-oriented game, in the course of the story the player will be given the opportunity to solve emerging in-game situations in different ways. The total gameplay duration is 30-40 minutes. The game can end with two endings (a bad one and a good one). Game Features: 1) Memorable characters 2) Interesting and funny dialogues 3) Detailed locations 4) Pleasant musical accompaniment Be tactful and polite so that Violet wants to stay with you.
row.short_description: A Drow named Violet teleports to our world to find the missing piece of the family pendant. The predominant genre of the game is a romantic comedy with elements of a visual novel, and a movement system from classic JRPGs.

row.name: Crisis: The Third Way
row.detailed_description: The game takes place in 2034, eight years after World War III. Amid the ruins of the old world, new leaders, the European Economic Cooperation (EEC) and Communist China, are vying for global domination, drawing ever more countries into the conflict. The story of one of these countries is the focus of the novel. The Ural Republic, a country that emerged from the ruins of Russia, has been drawn into a bloody conflict. Now the country's fate depends not only on the will of its leaders, but also on the will of an ordinary man, namely, Yevgeny Krylov, a junior sergeant in the Special Order Control Service (SSKP) and the game's protagonist. As Yevgeny, you will decide whether the Urals will remain a loyal ally of Europe in the fight against the spreading threat of communism or side with China in the confrontation with the new empire represented by the EEC. But is it really necessary to choose? Is it worth interfering in the course of world history? The choice is yours. Are you, as a little person, ready to take on such responsibility and follow your chosen path to the end? Features: - Original music. - Around 1,000 backgrounds, all created in an original style. - Variability (10 endings). English and Chinese localization is currently under development!
row.short_description: 'Crisis: The Third Way' is a fantastic visual novel set in a world struggling to recover from a devastating financial crisis that led to World War III.
row.notes: ATTENTION! This game contains scenes of violence, including against minorities, as well as scenes of drug, tobacco, and alcohol use, as well as sexual content. There is also a political context that not every player may be able to accept. Play at your own risk :)

row.name: BUS: Prologue
row.detailed_description: The zombie outbreak caught you off guard. Your only hope for survival is an old school bus and a team of loyal friends. Under the leadership of G, a charismatic radio host and conspiracy theorist, you must try to survive and figure out how to stop the impending apocalypse. The already dangerous journey across Fang Island will plunge you into the epicenter of a power struggle between two rival forces. Fight for survival, forge unexpected alliances, uncover the roots of the outbreak, and make a choice that will decide the fate of the entire island. Surviving a zombie apocalypse is no easy task. Throughout the story campaign, you'll have to fight, build, drive the bus from location to location, and escape hordes of angry green little folks. Fang Island adapts to the number of survivors. The more players, the more complex the puzzles and the more dangerous the enemies. Zombies WON'T make a cottage a castle. But you will. Haul resources in your bus, build defenses and fortify your own apocalyptic hideout. Any scrap you collect can be turned into effective weaponry with a bit of imagination. What could be better than a bus during the apocalypse? An armored bus. Customize your monster to your heart's content - from a new paint job to different wheels. And circular saws on the sides and a ram on the front bumper will be the perfect finishing touches for your personal zombie-clearing machine. We're waiting for you on our Discord server !
row.short_description: Ride through the apocalypse with your friends! BUS: Bro U Survived is a co-op story-driven adventure featuring your very own bus! row.detailed_description: ⚔️ Build Synergy or Dominate Alone Each race thrives on its own strengths, but true mastery comes from combining unlikely allies . The more diverse your team, the greater your potential — inspired by Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) principles, your deck’s harmony determines its might. 🔨 Craft Your Legacy Every match takes place inside a realistic 3D forge environment , where your chosen creatures work together to produce armor and equipment tied to their cultural identity. To craft the best gear, you’ll need the right races, the right synergies, and the right strategy.  Improvement Cards Use Improvement Cards to boost your employees’ performance. You can play one Improvement Card per turn . Each employee can only hold one Improvement Card during their contract. Accomodation Cards Accommodation Cards enhance specific races by improving their work environment. You can play one Accommodation Card per turn , but only on an employee of a matching race . Each employee can only have one Accommodation Card active during their contract. Malice Cards Use Malice Cards to disrupt your opponents’ workforce. You can play one per turn , targeting any opposing employee . These cards last contract time , unless they cause a reduction in production for the entire workers . In that case, they are removed after the turns' end . DEI Cards DEI (Diversity, Equality & Inclusion) Cards reward unity and cooperation in your forge. You can only play them once your forge includes all races of employees . Only one can be played per turn , and it will be removed at the end of turn if it applies to all workers . 🧠 Strategic Depth, Endless Replayability With countless combinations, faction bonuses, and tactical plays, no two matches are the same. Outsmart your opponent by reading their strategy, predicting their plays, and crafting victory card by card. 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Player vs Player Battles Challenge friends or other players online in intense PvP duels . Build decks that reflect your playstyle — whether you prefer brute force, clever synergy, or full-spectrum cooperation.
row.short_description: Deep beneath the mountains lies a living forge, where rival creatures — Ogres, Goblins, and Amphibians — must set aside their grudges to craft powerful gear. row.name: AEON DIRECTIVE: THE INTERVIEW
row.detailed_description: You have entered an isolated testing sector of the AEON DIRECTIVE, the final system that determines who may enter The Building, humanity’s last refuge. Nothing here is decorative. Every question you answer and every change you notice shapes your evaluation. The evaluation consists of 50 binary questions. You may answer only YES or NO. On the screen in front of you, two constantly shifting values are displayed. The Compliance Score represents how well your decisions align with Directive standards. The Perception Score reflects your ability to notice environmental distortions and react to them correctly. After each question, anomalies occur. The testing chamber may subtly or dramatically change. Chairs may slide across the floor. Boxes can vanish. Objects may appear where they were not before. Sometimes you will see something that looks like you standing in the wrong place, locked in a still and unnatural posture. These manifestations are known as Replicants. If you detect an anomaly, you must stop answering and select RECALIBRATE. Failing to do so lowers your Perception Score. Incorrect or undesirable answers lower your Compliance Score. If either score reaches a dangerously low level, the system will remove you from the interview permanently. There is no recovery after removal. The environment is presented in a retro styled black and white aesthetic reminiscent of early surveillance systems and abandoned office archives. Cold lights, silent rooms and minimal furnishing create an atmosphere where even stillness feels hostile. As the test progresses, keycards grant access to additional rooms. Each new area increases both opportunity and risk. The deeper you move into the facility, the more unstable reality becomes. This is a single continuous evaluation. Failure in either category ends the experience entirely The game will expand over time with new endings, content updates and ongoing improvements. Player feedback helps determine the future direction of the project.
row.short_description: 50 binary questions. Infinite consequences. Observe every detail... the environment could change. Fail to notice an anomaly, and you fail the test. The further you progress, the more rooms you have to remember. Permadeath.

row.name: Nightork Adventures 3 - Arena
row.detailed_description: Nightork Adventures 3 brings back the fast-paced, explosive action of the Nightork series - now with deeper strategy and more destruction than ever! Each enemy is protected by three shields , and every shield has one of two colors: Magic or Antimagic . To destroy them, you must hit the correct colors in the right order  - precision and timing are everything. Collect powerups to trigger massive explosions and chain reactions, and choose one of three Totems to shape your playstyle: 🐻 Ice Bear – Boosts defense and absorbs incoming damage. 🐅 Snow Tiger – Increases attack power and fire rate. 🦅 Frost Raven – Enhances mobility and special energy regeneration. Face waves of enemies across three unique arenas , each filled with intense battles, glowing projectiles, and spectacular effects. Features: Dynamic Magic/Antimagic shield system Three Totems with unique bonuses Explosive powerups and chain reactions Three arenas packed with fast-paced action Arcade-style gameplay with a strategic twist Can you master the rhythm of destruction and survive the chaos?
row.short_description: Blast your way through magical chaos! Choose your totem, master the color-coded shield system, and unleash explosive power in Nightork Adventures 3 - the ultimate test of reflexes and strategy.

row.name: Truck Company
row.detailed_description: Truck Company is a real-time strategy game in which you and other players strive to gain the widest possible market share for your orders. You start by purchasing your first vehicle and searching for the most profitable orders for it, ensuring your truck operates 24/7 without wasting time on free flights. You also need to take care of your drivers, as a well-rested and experienced driver is key to ensuring your truck completes its tasks quickly and efficiently. Trucks require repairs over time, otherwise their speed decreases. Later, once you earn more money, you can build bus stations or shops to which you will have to deliver goods, either by purchasing them in advance or by producing them in your own factories. The direction of your company depends on you. The game is based on a natural system of supply and demand, so other players influence the profits you earn. Players who join companies participate in seasonal rankings, at the end of which they receive rewards that help them develop their business. The company offers a wide range of tasks to complete, as well as bonuses that will help you increase your profits. The cars you start with date back to the 1950s. As technology advances, you'll gain access to more modern trucks with better performance. You can combine vehicles into convoys, making managing a large fleet a breeze. Cars have a wide range of modifications, but you'll first need to earn points to upgrade them.
row.short_description: TruckCompany - is a strategic game in which you develop your transport enterprise, the aim of which is to create a great consortium with other players and compete with others for the title of the best businessmen

The task in this 2D game is to control the train and collect various objects with it, which will be attached to the train in the form of a wagon. After hitting a wall or wagon, the level is reset. After collecting all the objects, just go through the gate to the next level. Each level has its own password, through which it is possible to return to it.

row.name: Z.A.T.O. // I Love the World and Everything In It
row.detailed_description: STORY USSR, 1986. When Ira Grachevskaya goes missing in the closed city of Vorkuta-5, not a soul seems to be concerned – except for the quiet outcast Asya Shubina, that is. Uncover the mystery behind Ira’s disappearance, transmit your radio signal to the universe and learn why a bird flies past the window. CHARACTERS Meet the cast. A problem child and a truant, Ira doesn't have the best reputation. Her standoffish demeanor makes her difficult to talk to, especially for someone as meek as you. There is a rumour she's been meeting with an older man. Marina's carefree personality makes her quite popular among her classmates. Adults don't seem to like her very much, probably due to poor grades. Despite the girl's outgoing nature, her worldview is rather cynical. A boy with an unpleasant sense of humour. Likes picking on people weaker than him, namely you. His family has been a little out of it the past few weeks. You. Not worth writing about. GAME INFO Z.A.T.O. is a linear visual novel with roughly 7-8 hours of playtime. There are no choices. The ending is predetermined. Sit back and enjoy your time in a town that doesn't exist. DISCLAIMER: the game contains strong language, loud noises and flickering images.

row.name: The wild darkness
row.detailed_description: You have been summoned to this world against your will. You know nothing, and everything here is utterly strange. You must find your own food, and monsters emerge at night. A moment of carelessness could send you to the next world. However, if you persevere and challenge yourself, you will accumulate knowledge, and the totems and crafting recipes you collect will allow you to progress through the game more smoothly. It will likely require a great deal of patience and focus, but there will be an equal amount of excitement and thrill in the adventure. Now, be brave. Destiny awaits. A Survival Story in an Unknown World This world contains countless regions, such as cool plains, cold tundras, and sultry jungles. There are various interactions with nature, such as lighting a fire when cold or cooling down in water when hot. Learning about the ecology and nature of this world will make it easier to survive. You can experience various stories as you progress through the game. Diverse Classes with Unique Abilities You can choose one of various classes to explore this world. Initially, only the Adventurer is selectable, but you can unlock new classes by meeting specific conditions. Gather, Craft, and Build This world is filled with various gatherable resources. You can use these to craft various items like delicious dishes, potions, and equipment. You can unlock new functions by constructing various facilities. For example, you can craft potions with an Alchemist's Cauldron, and building a Human Cannon will allow you to travel to distant regions. If you are short on materials, try finding a merchant and attempting a trade. Into a New Adventure with Good Equipment and Magic Equipment can come with outlandish modifiers, including beneficial options or harmful ones. Different skills are used depending on the weapon and gear equipped. There are spell scrolls and castable magic, and magic becomes more powerful when enhanced.
row.short_description: Explore a survival-roguelike RPG set in an unknown and bizarre world. To withstand its many dangers, you'll need to gain new knowledge, scavenge for food, and acquire useful items. Craft, build, and learn your way through a crucial adventure to uncover the world's secrets.

row.name: Gaussian Mansion
row.detailed_description: Fight your way through a haunted Victorian mansion in this intense 10-minute on-rails shooter. Face hordes of spectral apparitions, test your reflexes, and compete for the highest score. Can you survive the horror and uncover the tragedy hidden within? About This Game Enter Gaussian Mansion, if you dare. In the icy peaks of Northern Europe, an ancient curse has corrupted a majestic hotel, trapping its spirits in a loop of eternal torment. Now, its ghostly echoes haunt every Victorian hall, and you are trapped inside. Gaussian Mansion is a fast-paced, first-person, on-rails action-horror experience. Forget about free exploration: your path is an inescapable journey into darkness, and your only defense is your aim. The camera moves automatically as enemies infest each room. Aim fast, shoot precisely, and survive! WHAT YOU'LL FIND IN THE GAME: Non-Stop Arcade Action: Dive into an on-rails shooter experience where the action never stops. Enemies appear quickly and from all angles. Every second counts! Test Your Reflexes: The main goal is clear: get the highest possible score in the shortest amount of time. Perfect your technique, memorize patterns, and replay to beat your own records. Uncover the Hidden Tragedy: It's not all about shooting. Hidden in the darkest corners of the hotel are delicate Victorian cutouts. Collect them to form the pages of a macabre scrapbook, the only key to understanding the tragedy that occurred here. Solve Spectral Mysteries: Your progress will be challenged by two clever puzzles you must solve to continue your escape from the mansion. A Complete 10-Minute Adventure: Gaussian Mansion offers a concise and replayable horror-action experience, perfect for a quick game session anytime. Completely Free: Enjoy the full experience at no cost. Your precision is your ally. Time is your enemy. Do you have what it takes to make it to the end?
row.short_description: Explore a cursed hotel in this FREE rail shooter. Face off against hordes of ghosts, uncover hidden secrets, and fight for the best time in this 10-15 minute experience.
