row.name: Seconda: A Post-Apocalyptic Tale
row.detailed_description: Twenty years after the Third World War, the world is no longer the same. The cities lie in ruins, civilization has collapsed, and silence rules the streets of an unrecognizable Italy. In this setting rises Seconda , a fictional town in the province of Foggia, where a few survivors still search for a reason to keep going. In Seconda , you play as Aurora — a woman struggling to survive amid ruins, radiation, and despair. Her only hope is to repair an old military radio in an attempt to reach the outside world — a task that’s simple only in appearance. Every choice matters: manage your food supplies, fortify your home to withstand night raids from bandits, and repair what’s left to keep living. Food has become the new currency of the world — trade it with Vill, a wandering merchant who occasionally visits Aurora to offer her deals. Face armed bandits who have turned Seconda’s mall into their stronghold, or avoid the mutants roaming the irradiated streets. Every encounter is a fight for survival, and every bullet can make the difference. The contaminated zones hide precious resources, but your time inside them is limited. Prepare yourself, stay protected, and plan every move if you want to make it home alive. In the silence of the night, the sound of the wind mingles with the creak of wood and the footsteps of raiders. Aurora is no hero — she’s just a survivor, like many others, trying not to give in to the end. Seconda is a third-person survival game with management elements, set in a post-apocalyptic Italy. Explore, build, trade, fight, and survive — because in this world, life is worth nothing anymore…
row.short_description: Survive in the ruins of a post-apocalyptic Italy. Manage resources, defend your home, and try to reactivate a radio to contact the outside world.

row.name: UAZO : Free as a Bird Playtest
Highguard
row.detailed_description: An All-New PvP Raid Shooter Highguard is a PvP raid shooter where players will ride, fight, and raid as Wardens, arcane gunslingers sent to fight for control of a mythical continent. Team up, secure your base, then ride out across vast uncharted lands to loot, harvest resources, and upgrade your arsenal as you face off against a rival Warden crew looking to claim your territory as their own. Battle for possession of the legendary Shieldbreaker in the open field; fight to carry it to the enemy base to bring down their shields—then raid to destroy their base before they can destroy yours. Assemble Your Crew Pick from an ever-growing roster of Wardens, and form up in teams of three. Wardens wield guns and raid tools, in combination with rare magical abilities leftover from a dwindling age of magic, now returned. Every Warden ability is designed to add depth to the game’s unique loop and mechanics, like raid combat and destruction; siege stealth and infiltration; base repair and defense; harvesting and loot gathering; open-world combat, and much, much more. Secure Your Stronghold Choose from an array of unique strongholds to call in as your base of operations in large, open maps. Each base has different layouts, advantages, and vulnerabilities. Pick the base best-suited for your team composition, play style, and map type. Once you’ve called in a base, take some time to reinforce walls and customize your loadout before heading out into the field. Mount Up, Ride Out Mount up with your team and ride across the vast mythical landscapes of Highguard in search of loot, resources, and gear to strengthen your arsenal. You can find upgraded guns, armor, and other equipment, like better saddles and magical amulets imbued with perks. Be on the lookout, as the enemy team will be doing the same. Fight them off to secure the best loot for your team. Battle For the Shieldbreaker Strange magical storms periodically ravage the continent of Highguard. Everytime one appears, an ancient magical sword, called the Shieldbreaker, forms at its heart. This sword is the crucial key for breaking through the outer shields of the enemy base so that you can raid. When one of these storms forms in the sky, ride with your team to its location and battle the enemy team for possession of the Shieldbreaker forming beneath it. Intercept in the Open Field Once you have the Shieldbreaker, battle across the open field, on mount or on foot, as you attempt to carry the sword to the enemy base. But stay vigilant—if the enemy team eliminates you while carrying the Shieldbreaker, they can pick it up and ride to raid your base instead. Summon a Siege Tower Once you’ve successfully reached the enemy base with the Shieldbreaker, plunge the blade into the base’s outer superstructure to weaken its shields, then summon in a Siege Tower to finish the job. When those shields go down, it’s time to raid. The Raid With the base shields gone, you’ll need to push in to destroy the base by planting bombs on the base’s generators. But in order to get inside a well-fortified base, you’ll need to use every weapon, raid tool, and arcane ability at your disposal to shoot, sneak, or smash your way inside. Once inside, plant bombs and hold the objective while defenders try to flush you out. Chip away at a base’s strength by taking out multiple generators, or go straight for their anchor stone to destroy the base in one fell swoop. And if you’re defending, protect your generators and repel attackers until the energy of the Siege Tower is depleted and your outer shields repair. Fight For Control If multiple generators or the anchor stone is destroyed, the enemy base is destroyed and the attackers secure the territory. But most of the time, victory doesn’t come with a single raid. When that happens, the enemy base shields repair, the siege tower dissipates, and the fight escalates as loot, gear, and weapons all upgrade in the field, and a new Shieldbreaker forms in a different location in the world. From there the fight for control continues—until only one base is left standing. An Ever-Evolving Fantasy Universe Each new Episode will bring an array of new core content every month, including new maps, bases, modes, wardens, weapons, mounts, raid tools, loot items, and many more surprises we can’t wait to share. And all of this core content is completely free for all players.
row.short_description: Highguard is a PvP raid shooter where players will ride, fight, and raid as Wardens, arcane gunslingers sent to fight for control of a mythical continent.

row.name: The Menace Below
row.detailed_description: A prisoner of war finds a way to escape his captors, only to fall into the far more dangerous clutches of horrible monstrosities. The Menace Below is a short, difficult, hand-drawn cinematic platformer with a dark, brooding soundtrack. You will control the prisoner as he escapes to freedom. This challange will be full of lethal traps and malevolent monsters - you will need cunning, adaptability and quick reflexes to survive.
row.short_description: Short, challenging, hand-drawn cinematic platformer about escaping from the lair of evil ratmen.
row.notes: violence and gore

row.name: 永恒战神传奇
row.detailed_description: 加入官方社群 加入官网社群，实时了解游戏动态，反馈游戏BUG，参与社群活动还可以获得更多奖励 官方QQ群：1011106715 About the Game 精心还原了1.80版传奇的经典体验：手持屠龙刀的震撼、挑战BOSS的凶险、沙巴克城头万人厮杀的荣耀、以及怪物倒下瞬间那一声清脆“叮响”带来的无限悸动。全新 “英雄合击” 玩法更能带来无与伦比的刺激！ 游戏特色 全新的英雄系统 每个玩家都可以召唤战法道三个职业的任一英雄，面对不同挑战，可以选择不同的英雄搭配； 不同职业英雄和玩家自身可组合成不同效果的合击技能；合击技极为强大，可在刹那间改变战局走向！ 丰富的行会系统 在传统的基础上极大的扩展了行会功能，每一位加入行会的玩家，都可以享受到巨大的福利！ 行会秘境：专属于行会自己的BOSS副本，在活动时间内，每击杀一层BOSS都能获取到元宝、行会资金甚至有可能掉落极品装备 福利摇一摇：通过摇点数，可以在行会中进行排名，排名越高，获得的元宝越多 行会仓库：多余装备可以放到行会仓库中，行会成员们可各取所需，互换有无 行会建筑：可以让每个会员都能获得更多的福利 荣誉战场：全新玩法，激情体验，将带给每个玩家新的战斗激情 攻城战：传统的沙巴克攻城战，享受城头万人厮杀的荣耀吧 钻石摸金，幸运大爆 激活摸金手镯，击杀BOSS不但有概率掉落钻石，还有可能激活幸运大爆，有概率获得绝世神兵! 完成指定目标，可升级摸金手镯，增加钻石上限与大爆次数 游戏玩法 多样化的经典玩法 每日多种玩法让你根本停不下来！ 全民BOSS、石墓烧猪、麒麟送宝、龙城迷宫、挑战副本、世界BOSS、群魔来袭，还有更多内容等待您的发掘! 刺激战场，跨服争夺 崭新的跨服玩法，带来全新体验！ 丧尸围城、荣誉之巅、卧龙宝藏、跨服BOSS，每一个跨服玩法都能为你带来稀有珍贵的宝藏！ 重温经典，绝非简单的复制。缔造传奇，需要更炽热的战斗！ 经典在此永恒，合击于此封神！诚邀各位战神，归来共战！
row.short_description: 精心还原了1.80版传奇的经典体验：手持屠龙刀的震撼、挑战BOSS的凶险、沙巴克城头万人厮杀的荣耀、以及怪物倒下瞬间那一声清脆“叮响”带来的无限悸动。全新“英雄合击” 玩法更能带来无与伦比的刺激！

row.name: Yuletide Regicide
row.detailed_description: An Arctic Ambush! Santa Claus, the King of Christmas, has been murdered. Brutally butchered in his Throne Room on the North Pole. Our dynamic duo of deduction and delinquency, investigative journalist Deliria B. Murder and the undead detective Skullbert 'Skully' McSkullface, arrives to the scene in a timely manner, ready to get to the bottom of this scandalous scoop and most-likely-illegal impalement. Suspects abound from dissatisfied elves to flying reindeer, not to forget the possible marriage trouble with Mrs. Claus. Luckily, the CIA is already digging through the crime scene, so you can be sure the investigation is in good hands... Right? Something rotten on the North Pole Play as the main character duo and put all (or at least some) of your journalism and detective skills to good use. Do a bit of digging around and interrogate the North Pole residents to learn about their secret goings-on and grievances. Find answers to all the questions you've ever had* about Santa's operations! How are the work conditions for Santa's elves? How do the reindeer fly? How's Mrs. Claus liking the life of an Arctic matriarch? Shouldn't a murder be written down somewhere on Santa's famous naughty list? Yuletide Regicide is a short comedic visual novel crime story with hand-drawn graphics. It's a game full of funny characters, conspiracies, and Christmas jeer – everything you need to get into that festive mood for the holidays. Solve the murder, save Christmas**! *Unless you had more questions. **Results may vary.
row.short_description: A dead Santa Claus right before Christmas is never a good sign. Interrogate the North Pole suspects to solve the murder and figure out how to save the festive season in this short dark comedy visual novel whodunnit.
row.notes: As a murder mystery, the game includes murder and cartoon violence.

row.name: Remains
row.detailed_description: Play as a small robot exploring a post-post apocalyptic world. Having awakened in a forest, explore the world to find clues as to what has happened, and discover replacement parts for yourself using tools, such as a foam gun and vacuum. Explore Navigate an overgrown landscape, and delve into the ruins of a forgotten world as you explore a post-post apocalyptic setting, searching for clues as to who you are and what happened Tools Foam Gun - Spray foam onto walls to create platforms to help you navigate each level Vacuum - With suction and blowing capabilities, find hidden keys and maneuverer over slippery surfaces and underwater
row.short_description: A 2.5D Puzzle Platformer. Use tools to modify the level and how you move to explore forests and the ruins of a post-post apocalyptic world. Find keys and extra batteries to delve ever further, in search of who you are and what happened to the world.

row.name: Until the Fields: Farmageddon
row.detailed_description: A heartwarming, clay-style adventure about teamwork, freedom, and making a mess together—where every creature, big or small, has a role to play in stopping… Farmageddon! Features: In our single-player adventure where you swap between 3 animals: mouse, spider and cow — each with their own personality and tricks — Our heroes must cooperate to solve puzzles and escape the storm-wrecked barn! The mouse: sneaks through tunnels and gnaws ropes.  The spider: swings across beams, pulls levers. The cow: pushes and breaks heavy objects.
row.short_description: A whimsical single-player story-driven puzzle adventure where you switch between animals, each with their own personality and abilities to escape the farm before it’s too late.

row.name: Dead Weight: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Dead Weight: Prologue is a beginning of the story of the turn-based tactical roguelite game Dead Weight. PROLOGUE FEATURES Play as Arn, a mighty Barbarian. Learn what happens in the beginning of the story of Dead Weight. Meet the Ancient Gods for the first time and gain supernatural powers. Upgrade your flying pirate ship and explore the first region of the game. Hire a crew and fight goblins in tactical turn-based battles where every wrong move can be your last. Push your foes into the Abyss. Don't forget to watch your step – it's a long way down! Create a unique build with 20+ character skills and items. Help your friend Berry escape from the Mad Oracle. You are her only hope!
row.short_description: Face the Ancient Gods! Embark on a roguelite adventure in the prologue version of Dead Weight. Explore the first region of the game for free! Fight the goblins in turn-based tactical battles and defeat the Mad Oracle to save your friend.

row.name: Ironwing Valiant: Record of Astera Playtest
Dave's Wrecking Yard 3D
row.detailed_description: This is a fun little 'Free to Play' automotive wrecking yard simulator in it's early stages. Find & collect specific car parts to complete orders, box them up & ship them across the country or sell them over the counter. Statistics are collected so you can see just how much work was done, how much money you've made as well as all the pizza & soda you consumed. This game is designed to run on minimal PC hardware, the minimum requirements are more of a suggestion.
row.short_description: It's the late 1990s all over again and you find yourself the owner of Dave's Wrecking Yard. Earn cash by filling various parts orders by phone, internet, & walk-in customers. Enjoy working at your own pace while ordering pizzas and chugging sodas.

row.name: We Want Your Head
row.detailed_description: Hit… or die. Welcome to the twisted version of a classic arcade experience. In We Want Your Head , you enter a world of pixelated nightmares where disembodied heads burst out from the darkness. With every swing of your hammer, you fight for a few more seconds of peace — and for your own head. Gameplay We Want Your Head is a horror-themed arcade game inspired by the 1970s classic Whac-A-Mole .The mechanics are simple — press the correct number on your keyboard to smash the emerging heads.As the pace increases, mistakes become inevitable, and every wrong move brings you closer to the end. You have 3 lives — miss three times, and the execution machine comes for you.This time, it’s your head on the line. Every hit counts, and every mistake creates extra pressure. Atmosphere The game draws inspiration from retro 3D aesthetics of the PS1 era , blending it with the unsettling vibe of an arcade that should never have existed .Flickering screens, dirty textures, distorted digits, and grotesque heads create a constant feeling of dread and inevitability.This isn’t a nostalgic trip down memory lane — it’s a nightmare that remembers how much fun you used to have. Will you keep your head on your shoulders? We Want Your Head is a tribute to classic arcade games — but this time, the price isn’t just your coins... It’s your life . Will you dare to play? How to Play. Use numpad keyboard or default number keys. Warning!!! This game contains flashing lights and sudden loud noises. Proceed with caution. Music created by Dabi Sarapuk.
row.short_description: Hit… or die. Welcome to the twisted version of a classic arcade experience. In We Want Your Head, you enter a world of pixelated nightmares where disembodied heads burst out from the darkness. With every swing of your hammer, you fight for a few more seconds of peace — and for your own head.
row.notes: This game contains stylized gore, body horror and blood spills. Low poly models and low resolution textures imitate realistic assets. Game shows stylized violence like blood splats, crushing heads etc. During game when player loses, they will encounter a loud jumpscare.

row.name: The Fox, The Forest & The Darkness
row.detailed_description: Things have not been going well for Zak, in trouble at school, in trouble at home and now wondering what to do, where to go and who to be. Now he's stuck wandering the park doing homework on the weekend and frankly the whole thing is becoming a bit too much. Then Zak discovers the fetid vines, his first sign of the growing Darkness in the woods and the dangers that wait for us all.  -- What's in the game? Explore Southeast City Park discovering clues about Zak, his story and the reality he is building around himself. The Forest and The Darkness both call to Zak in their own unique ways.  Enjoy seamless transitions between 1st and 3rd person perspectives so you can really explore the clues to the mysteries that surround the Zak. Experience a uniquely crafted story that eloquently melds the written word, music and visuals into a cohesive experience only a solodev / auteur experience can create.  Make use of curious game techniques like a story driven inventory system. Although narrative based and story driven, the game doesn't bog you down with cutscenes and dialog sequences. The goal is for the player to feel free to move whenver possible.  An 'audio book' format (as read by the author) is also provided but you can turn that off if you read faster than listen. Several achievements are also scattered throughout the park (currently working on Steam integration). --- The Fox, The Forest & The Darkness is the first project by Idea Guy turned Solodev Will Leamon. Here we present the first chapter 'Enter Fickle Pig' as a means of hopefully raising interest and resources to keep on with the project.
row.short_description: Alone in the park as The Darkness rises, Zak begins his descent. The Fox, The Forest and The Darkness is a narrative based game centered on that moment in life when we begin to build our own reality. Zak is confused, scared and angry like most 14 year olds, but he's determined to make it count.

row.name: ElevatorGirl
row.detailed_description: —Don't fall! Take the elevator and head for the goal— Simple controls x 3D action Dodge traps Jump over falling holes Get in the elevator and ascend Hit an obstacle and you'll be thrown back If you fall, you might have to start over! Game Features - Various traps: Moving and rotating platforms. A series of difficult spots. - Only jumping, character control, viewpoint control, and elevator activation - If you fall, you might have to start over from the beginning? - There are actually shortcuts!? Game Controls ・WASD - Jump: Spacebar Key = Spacebar, Button A, Mouse Left Click - Elevator: Key E, Button B, Mouse Right Click - View Control: Mouse, Right Stick Game Development: Third Work 'ElevatorGirl' Questions Q: There's noise on the screen! A: Please change the vertical sync settings. Q: I found a bug. A: If you contact us, we may fix it. For distribution guidelines, click 'Access the website' on the page.
row.short_description: 3D action game. Avoid obstacles with simple controls and climb to the top floor.

row.name: Service Please: First Dinner
row.detailed_description: Service Please: First Dinner is a playable introductory experience that lets you step into a journey starting with a small business. Day by day, customer traffic increases, core menu options expand, and you take your first steps into restaurant management. This version serves as a preview of the larger and deeper experience awaiting you in the full game. Set up your business, make your first key decisions, and dive into the fundamentals of restaurant management. Every choice you make in this early stage lays a solid foundation for your journey ahead. Create Your Own Restaurant Start shaping your own business. Design your restaurant’s initial layout with tables, chairs, and essential decorative elements. In Service Please: First Dinner , you’ll learn the core principles of design and prepare for the more advanced customization systems available in the full game. • Create basic service areas • Experience how layout affects customer flow • Learn to use your kitchen space more efficiently Expand Your Menu and Impress Customers Meet customer expectations with a limited but carefully curated menu. In Service Please: First Dinner , you work with essential food and beverage options that reflect your restaurant’s identity. By understanding the fundamentals of menu management, you’ll be ready for the broader content offered in the full game. • Unlock your first recipes • Learn to balance your menu • Practice reading and responding to customer demands Manage Your Staff, Boost Performance At the heart of every restaurant is teamwork. In Service Please: First Dinner , you’ll manage a limited number of staff members, learning how to assign tasks and maintain a smooth service flow. Smart decisions make all the difference during busy hours. • Experience the basics of staff management • Balance service speed with customer satisfaction • Get familiar with stock and preparation processes Shape Your Progress with Tasks and Skills Complete your first management objectives. The tasks available in Service Please: First Dinner help you understand the game’s mechanics and shape your management approach. Core elements of the skill system offer a glimpse into the deeper progression awaiting you later. • Complete your first tasks • Learn how the progression system works • Build the foundation of your management style Bring Gameplay to Life with Events Witness special moments that energize your restaurant atmosphere. The limited events featured in Service Please: First Dinner allow you to observe customer behavior and restaurant pacing from different perspectives. • Fulfill special customer requests • Observe how the restaurant’s tempo changes • Discover the foundations of larger events Whether you want to learn the basics of running a small café or prepare yourself for managing a bustling restaurant… Service Please: First Dinner offers a smooth, educational, and satisfying introduction—designed to familiarize you with the core mechanics before stepping into the full depth of the complete management experience.
row.short_description: Service Please: First Dinner is a fast-paced and immersive restaurant management simulation. Welcome your customers, manage your staff, expand your menu, and control the workflow behind the scenes as you grow a small business into a prestigious restaurant.

row.name: 飞扬传奇
row.detailed_description: 游戏介绍 | 《飞扬传奇》 ——耗时整整一年精心打磨，只为给你最热血的传奇体验！🔥 🎮【版本亮点速递】 ✨团队耗时一年匠心打造——这不是普通版本，是365天死磕细节、反复优化的诚意之作！从新手福利到竞技平衡，每个像素都藏着“让玩家爽到”的巧思！ 🎁【全新福利狂送】 ✅新手福利丰厚：登录即领珍稀称号+自动拾取/回收功能+超大容量背包仓库！👑零门槛享受大佬待遇，散人逆袭不是梦！ ✅每日福利保障：天天领充值额度！零氪也能当大佬，每天上线就像拆礼物🎁，福利多到屏幕装不下！ ✅海量资源放送：首爆奖励拿到手软，大量灵符送送送💰！ ✅装备爆率惊人：沉默专属、超多极品称号，打怪爆爆爆爆爆! ! !💯 ✅畅爽公平竞技：PK超爽，流畅，无秒杀，人人可终极! ! ! 🔥【核心特色】 🔋耐玩性佳：无套路、无强制消费 🔋耐玩性佳：海量特色玩法持续更新，长久陪伴乐趣无穷！ 💎匠心巨制：团队潜心一年重磅打造，热血体验诚意奉上！ 🚀人气保障：专注打造火爆大服，激情永不落幕！ 👑【游戏亮点暴击】 🌱公平成长体系：只要时间够，所有装备/称号/货币都能毕业！散人也能逆袭成王👑，专属爆率让你爽到飞起！ 🎯刚玩指数：★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★（爆表！新手秒变老玩家！） 🔥超爽指数：★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★（一刀999？不，是刀刀暴击+满屏掉落！） 🔥人气指数：★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★（服务器天天满员，聊天框刷屏速度比打怪还快！） 📢总结：这不仅仅是一个版本，是团队用365天烧掉无数杯咖啡、改掉无数版方案的心血结晶！💖现在加入，你就是飞扬传奇的“头号玩家”！
row.short_description: 《飞扬传奇》是团队耗时一年匠心打造——这不是普通版本，是365天死磕细节、反复优化的诚意之作！从新手福利到竞技平衡，每个像素都藏着“让玩家爽到”的巧思！零氪也能当大佬，每天上线就像拆礼物🎁！散人也能逆袭成王👑！

row.name: Turned Into Turrets
row.detailed_description: Wishlist now Turned Into Turrets is launching soon. Wishlist today to be notified when the playable early access releases! About the Game In a once-peaceful world, people were deceived by the illusion of fake love - a false controlling force that promised unity but delivered chains. That corrupted power twisted them into living turrets, trapped in metal shells, stripped of their hearts and freedom. Turned into Turrets is  a story-driven roguelike survival game where you fight as those lost souls - humans bound by steel - battling endless hordes of monsters born from the same false love that doomed them. Your mission is to find the Seven Keys of True Love and unlock the emotions that can restore your humanity. Each boss defeated leads closer to freedom.  ABOUT THE GAME Turned Into Turrets is a top-down roguelike survival game where you stand as a living turret fighting through relentless waves of enemies. Every 15-level segment introduces new enemy types, culminating in a boss fight. Defeating each boss unlocks a new playable character, each with distinct stats such as increased speed and health. Collect coins to fill your Upgrade Bar . When full, a set of Natural Powers appears. They are temporary ability choices that vanish after 10 seconds if ignored. Each refill slows slightly, testing your timing and decision-making. Traps scattered across the map can summon the Snake Woman (Fake Love) if triggered, or if you exceed the 5-minute limit without clearing the level. Survive, upgrade, and master your abilities to overcome the waves and uncover the truth behind fake love. CORE FEATURES • Wave-based progression: enemy types change every 15 levels • Boss fights that unlock new characters with unique speed or health stats • Coin-driven upgrade system with timed Natural Power choices • Gradually slower upgrade refill speed for deeper pacing • Environmental traps that summon the Snake Woman if triggered or delayed • Narrative integration through the Seven Keys of Love THIS EARLY ACCESS INCLUDES • 60 playable levels (4 enemy sets and 4 boss fights) • 4 unlockable characters with different speed and health stats • Full Upgrade-Bar and Natural Powers system • One playable world (no map purchasing in early access) • Early-access difficulty balancing for player feedback LANGUAGES • English
row.short_description: Once human, now machines forged by fake love. You just have five minutes to take down the waves of monsters and discover the path back to humanity. Turned Into Turrets is a 2D top-down roguelike game where you stand as a living turret, fighting waves of enemies with automatic attacks and builds.

row.name: Memoria
row.detailed_description: Memoria is a classic memory matching game designed for Windows 3.1. Players are presented with a grid of face-down tiles, each holding a pictogram. The Objective is to find all matching pairs by flipping two tiles at a time. If the selected tiles match, they remain face-up; if not, they are turned back over. The game tracks the number of moves and elapsed time, challenging players to complete the grid with the fewest attempts.
row.short_description: Memoria is a classic memory matching game designed for Windows 3.1. Players are presented with a grid of face-down tiles, each holding a pictogram. The Objective is to find all matching pairs by flipping two tiles at a time.

row.name: Winds of Valen
row.detailed_description: Winds of Valen is a completely free-to-play fantasy MMORPG inspired by the golden age of old school MMOs like Old School RuneScape. Explore an open world with meaningful, non-linear progression, where your progression is driven by what you choose to pursue. Non-Linear Open World Step into a living world with no set path. Choose your own adventures, travel in any direction, and play at your own pace. Challenging Bosses Take on challenging, mechanics-driven boss encounters and earn powerful gear. Skill-Based Progression Train and master your skills: Combat Skills : Attack, Defence, Evasion, Warding and Health Professions : Mining and Smithing, deeply tied into your equipment, upgrades, and overall progression. Player-Driven Crafting & Progression Gather resources, smelt ore, and craft powerful gear. Every tool and weapon has purpose. Loot & Reward System Every monster in Winds of Valen drops its own rare, unique item. Rare drop chances are displayed openly and dynamically change to prevent getting too unlucky Every item is balanced, useful, and designed to have its place in the world. Winds of Valen is built for players who enjoy the open-ended, sandbox design of old-school MMOs.
row.short_description: Winds of Valen is a free fantasy sandbox MMORPG. Experience old-school progression where every level, skill, and drop is earned through effort. Train your combat, mining, and smithing skills, and hunt for rare and unique items in a seamless open world filled with danger and discovery.

row.name: Run Coffee Run
row.detailed_description: ☕☕☕  Escape a narcoleptic COFFEE island in this mini-fps-metroidvania  ☕☕☕ ☕ Drink coffee to delay the inevitable - or wake up in a bed and try again Explore the compact COFFEE Island unlock upgrades and race toward the EMERGENCY EXIT before your eyes finally close ☕ Game Features ☕ Stay awake with coffee  - or respawn in bed if you fail 🗺 Compact metroidvania-style exploration ⚡ Movement-focused gameplay: jump-jump-dash 🧩 Discover upgrades, artifacts, and strange secrets 🐕 A corporate office tower full of dogs 🏠 Steve renovated his home ⛏ Rumors of the ANCIENT PICKAXE OF DESTRUCTION ☕☕☕ a short adventure originally made in 72h for Ludum Dare 50, now on Steam & SteamDeck
row.short_description: A fast-paced FPS platformer where staying awake is the challenge. Unlock movement upgrades, explore a compact island, drink coffee to delay sleep, and find the fastest path to escape before you collapse. Also features a corporate office tower full of dogs.

row.name: Jeon Woo-chi
row.detailed_description: [World] In the late Joseon era, Western paintings became popular across the land. However, the creatures sealed inside these paintings began to awaken and attack nearby villages. Behind this chaos was Yuyahheukgun , a sorcerer from Qing China who sought to plunge Joseon into disorder and rule it by using the power of Western art. To stop him and protect the people, Jeon Woo-chi , the greatest Taoist sorcerer of Joseon, set out on his journey. But after being defeated by Yuyahheukgun’s overwhelming magic, he becomes trapped inside the world of the paintings. [Taoist Arts] Jeon Woo-chi uses various Taoist abilities—illusion magic, clone techniques, and instant-step movement—to defeat his enemies. Illusion: Casts an illusion on enemies, causing them to fight each other.   Clone Technique: Summons a clone identical to Jeon Woo-chi to assist in battle. Instant Step: Dodges an enemy’s attack and instantly appears in front of them to strike. [Action] Use parries and perfect dodges to defeat your foes and enjoy stylish execution moves. [2D] During combat, Jeon Woo-chi can enter the world inside the painting and engage in 2D side-scrolling combat . Seamlessly switch between 2D and 3D for a unique and dynamic combat experience. [Content] As Jeon Woo-chi explores a total of four maps , he must defeat the monsters that dwell within the world inside the paintings and solve the puzzles scattered throughout each area to progress.
row.short_description: This game is an action RPG set in the Joseon Dynasty. Players assume the role of Jeon Woo-chi, defeating various enemies as they advance. Experience the thrill of action using Jeon Woo-chi's dazzling martial arts, and dive into the painting to experience interdimensional battles!

row.name: 国际纵队：深海阴谋
row.detailed_description: This is a 2D side-scrolling shooter with a modern sci-fi narrative. Against the backdrop of incessant modern international warfare, a virus outbreak emerges in conflict zones. Players assume the role of an internationalist investigating the truth behind these wars. Throughout the investigation, they gradually discover extraterrestrial beings systematically instigating human conflicts from underwater bases. The story culminates in players defeating the alien leader, enabling humanity to restore global peace and resume developmental progress. Players can choose from three characters: Li Xiang, Yan Shuangtu, and Zhang Bing. Each character possesses unique skills. The player controls the protagonist through an adventure across seven levels, defeating various enemies. These seven levels are: desert, ship, wasteland, mountains, island, city, and underwater. Players can also enhance their characters to reduce the game's difficulty. The overall playtime is about 2 hours. Controls: Move: WASD Ult: F Shoot: Mouse Skip movie & Trigger conversation : Space Menu: ESC
row.short_description: This is a 2D side-scrolling shooter game with 7 levels in total and 3 characters available for players to choose from. Its playtime is about 2 hours. A mysterious alien force blocks global unity. Players take on the role of soldiers to uncover its truth and can upgrade their characters in-game.

row.name: Route 88
row.detailed_description: Deliver food by navigating through Chinese cities, all to the beat of the music! Route 88 is a rhythm parkour game set in 2.5D. Explore the colorful cityscape through our first two levels, Day and Night Market. Use J for hits and K for sliders. Level Select: Pan using J and K, hit simultaneously to select level.
row.short_description: Deliver food by navigating through Chinese cities, all to the beat of the music! Free demo available.

row.name: devasion 0.5
row.detailed_description: Devasion 0.5 – The Intergalactic Upgrade Adventure! Developed by z-i-r.de Get ready for an action-packed adventure in the depths of space! In Devasion 0.5, you pilot a small, agile spaceship through dangerous galaxies filled with obstacles, colored rocks, and explosive surprises. Your mission: Destroy the multicolored rocks to clear the path and advance deeper into the levels. Each rock presents new challenges – some are tough, others are vulnerable to certain weapons or projectile colors. Only those who combine their knowledge cleverly will progress! Collect numerous gadgets and upgrades along the way to improve your ship. Enhanced lasers, shields, or out-of-control missiles – every upgrade can mean the difference between victory and defeat. Experience: 🚀 Fast, precise controls 💥 Color-matching and destruction mechanics 🔧 Numerous power-ups and individual upgrades 🌌 Retro-inspired graphics with a modern twist 🎶 Dynamic soundtrack for a galactic feel Are you ready to blast your way through the rocky waves and push your ship to its limits? Devasion 0.5 awaits your command.
row.short_description: Devasion 0.5 – The Intergalactic Upgrade Adventure Steer your spaceship through dangerous galaxies, destroy colored rocks, and collect gadgets to upgrade your ship! Only those who master the right combinations of weapons, colors, and timing will progress.

row.name: Kaya The Dog
row.detailed_description: You play as a dog, you can jump and run, but your owner has all the power. He controls you and doesn't treat you well. This game tries to show you how lonly our pets can be and how Important it is to treat them right. The art style is very simple and it's not realistic, no blood. This games tries to show you the pets view in a entertaining way.  The owener uses a shock collar to train/disciplin you. The game plays in one room.
row.short_description: You experience the life of an abused dog, forced to stay in one place and only watch as the world moves on around him. This game tries to show you how lonly our pets can be and how Important it is to treat them right.
row.notes: Kaya the dog gets "shocked" very often.

row.name: Gawr Gura: Quest for Bread Playtest
Molili AI Friends: Your AI Desk Pal
row.detailed_description: Your desktop is the world where you meet your AI partner. This is more than just a desktop pet. Here, every character is powered by the advanced Molili personalization model. They possess their own memories, emotions, and evolving personalities, allowing them to remember the moments you share and develop a unique, lifelike presence through your daily interactions. Every interaction is one-of-a-kind. With exquisite Live2D technology, every emotion is vividly brought to life before your eyes: They will respond delicately to your touch. When you're focused on work or gaming, they'll quietly keep you company in a corner of your screen. And when you need them, they'll become your most reliable partner. Not just a friend but also your capable assistant. Your AI partner can connect to the internet to look up information for you, or activate Deep Thought Mode to explore complex questions with you. When inspiration strikes, simply describe your idea, and they'll generate stunning images, becoming a wellspring of creativity for your projects. A relationship that grows with you. Your bond will be chronicled through a unique affinity system. Increase your affinity through daily interactions to unlock various rewards. From the tentative first meetings to becoming inseparable confidants, and finally, to being each other's irreplaceable one—you will experience the deepening of your connection day by day. Personalized AI Companions: Powered by the Molili model, characters feature long-term memory, emotional simulation, and evolving personality traits. Vivid Live2D Animation: Experience a lively desktop companion with beautiful animations and rich interactions. Powerful Assistant Tools: Integrated with practical functions like web search, deep thought analysis, and AI image generation. In-depth Relationship System: Journey from first encounters to deep understanding as you gradually strengthen your emotional bond. Rich Customization: Dress up your partner in different outfits and accessories to create your favorite look. Stress‑free companionship: the core experience is free forever (including unlimited AI chat powered by cost‑efficient models). Only high‑performance AI features require a quota‑based subscription. Add Molili AI Friends to your wishlist now! Molili will be free for a limited time during the open beta. Get ready to meet your otherworldly companion! Join our Discord! Come chat with us about Molili—or anything else you’re curious about:
row.short_description: Bring a charming AI friend to your desktop. Molili AI friend listens, reads by your side, blushes when you care, and helps with study or work using a smart personality system that remembers your moments, growing from curious visitor to the companion who understands you best.

row.name: [BEAT:KEEPER]
row.detailed_description: Exhibited at Vantan Game Academy – TOKYO GAME SHOW 2025 This game is a single-player rhythm action game that fuses rhythm gameplay with 3D combat. Press buttons to the beat to attack your enemies, and dodge their strikes with precise timing. Unleash powerful special moves by chaining your attacks and take down the boss! <Story> In the 2080s, Neo-Pulse City is ruled by the “HARMONY System,” which manipulates human emotions through music. Former idol Rin-Ha’s singing voice has been banned, and her once-bright future was cut short... Yet, determined to reclaim the freedom of music, Rin-Ha rises up against the giant corporation Rhythm Corp. Strike to the rhythm, turn the beat into your strength, and fight to reclaim the sound — your freedom — in this psychedelic beat battle! Only the tutorial supports both Japanese and English subtitles. All voice lines are in Japanese.
row.short_description: Vantan Game Academy TOKYO GAME SHOW 2025 Exhibition Match the rhythm of flowing notes, convert beats into power, and defeat your enemies! A psychedelic beat battle to bring sound (freedom) back to the people!

row.name: Bane of Darkness
row.detailed_description: Become the Vampire Hunter  As the relentless vampire hunter Lovec, storm through a gothic mansion hidden deep in the forests of Bohemia. Wield devastating weapons, grow stronger with every victory, and carve a path through relentless hordes of haunting enemies on your quest to rescue your beloved Eliska from the wicked vampire lord, Mikhail.  It’s time to hunt the Bane of Darkness.    Game Features  Storm the vampire lord's lair! From the eerie Bohemian forest to a deadly mansion, explore the secrets hidden in the shadows.  Wield devastating weapons! Collect and master lethal weapons that deal more damage as you get stronger.  Dash into battle! Practice and use dash attack to vanquish foes at light speed.  Face relentless hordes of enemies! Skeletons, ghouls, skulls, and animated armor. Carve a path through them all! Immerse into the narrative! Cinematic cutscenes will envelop you into seamless gameplay.   Experience a fusion of music! With influences from a variety of genres, the score from Bane of Darkness provides a unique take on haunted symphonies and heart-racing beats.
row.short_description: In Bohemia's shadows, hunt the Bane of Darkness. Explore, fight, and grow stronger on your quest to rescue your beloved from the wicked vampire lord.

row.name: Exoria
row.detailed_description: Once, long ago, the realms of Éartsepia lived in peace. Today, nothing remains but ruins and a cycle of war that consumes everything. Each year, the High Order chooses a new warrior. A chosen one. The one who will carry the hope of an entire world. You are that chosen one. Sent to a forgotten sanctuary, you set out to find Exoria, the legendary sword forged by the vanished gods. It is said that its blade could forever cut between war and peace. if someone brings it back, and survives the journey. Find Exoria. You are our last hope... Exoria is an action-adventure game combining exploration, puzzles, and close-quarters combat, entirely built around a grappling hook. Your tool, your weapon, your style. Explore vertical, organic environments. Solve dynamic puzzles. Face fierce enemies in fluid, fast-paced, mobility-based combat. Traverse environments with fluidity: swing, launch yourself from anchor point to anchor point, and carve your own path. Follow the traces left by those of your Order who attempted the quest before you, and push ever deeper toward Exoria, the mythical lost blade. Use your grappling hook to manipulate the environment and overcome the trials standing in your way. Unseal blocked passages, move ancient structures, and reveal forgotten paths. Nothing can hold you back if you master your surroundings. In combat, your grappling hook becomes a true weapon. Pull enemies toward you to punish them in close combat, tear off their defenses with precise moves, and turn explosive foes into living projectiles. Chain movement, dodges, and attacks with surgical precision: mastering motion is both your best defense and your strongest asset. Exoria delivers an experience that rewards fluidity, timing, and initiative. The more you tame your grappling hook, the more the world opens to you. Explore. Adapt. Master your rhythm. And above all: Find Exoria.
row.short_description: An action-adventure game where a grappling hook lets you explore, solve puzzles, and fight fluidly on your quest for the mythical sword Exoria.

row.name: 有病才能当牛马 NullKitchenException
row.detailed_description: 《有病才能当牛马》是一款第一人称叙事 + 日常经营 + 心理恐怖元素的七日循环游戏。 “欢迎回来，今天也要努力打工哦。” 你在外卖店工作七天，却永远走不到第八天。 音乐在扭曲，铁桌在旋转，自己在消失。 有人说这只是精神错乱，也有人说—— 你早就死在第一次加班的那天夜里。 你还有使命—— 修复这段崩坏的日常，或成为其中一部分。 游戏玩法与循环结构 游戏以 7 天为一个循环 。每天都要完成订单以获取金钱。 正常日 ：完成全部订单，进入下一天。 异常日（出现 Bug） ：如果继续完成订单，你将会 被重置回第一天 ； 若选择立即 离开外卖店 ，则可顺利进入下一天，并可能找到 关键道具 。 不同天数可能出现 不同类型的 Bug ，你需要通过细微视觉、声音和行为变化来识别（不过有一些蛮明显的）。 到达第七天时，如果金钱不足以支付房租，循环将重置。 目标与结局 本游戏有7个结局（1 NE / 1 TE / 5 BE） 普通结局（NE） ：正确判断异常并成功支付房租。 真结局（TE） ：在生存的同时收集全部关键道具，将会在第八天开启新的可能。 被Bug侵蚀会进入不同的坏结局（BE） 。 游戏特色 日常经营 + 心理恐惧的反差体验 将材质丢失、软体爆炸、模型 Error等经典“Bug” 转化为可感、可逃离的游戏机制 循环记忆 + 道具推进式探索结构 轻度操作 + 重叙事氛围，时长可短可深度沉浸 可能还混杂了一些真Bug（可触发隐藏成就哦） 此作品为“2025 TapTap 聚光灯 21 天游戏创作挑战”参赛作品 玩家QQ群：934892447
row.short_description: 《有病才能当牛马》是一款第一人称叙事 + 日常经营 + 心理恐怖元素的七日循环游戏。 “欢迎回来，今天也要努力打工哦。” 你在外卖店工作七天，却永远走不到第八天。 音乐在扭曲，铁桌在旋转，自己在消失。 有人说这只是精神错乱，也有人说—— 你早就死在第一次加班的那天夜里。 你还有使命—— 修复这段崩坏的日常，或成为其中一部分。

row.name: Hangman Duel
row.detailed_description: Do you love word games? 🧠 Test your luck and language skills with the classic Hangman game, now available on your mobile! 🔠 How to Play? Guess the correct word by suggesting letters before time runs out and your attempts are over. But be careful – every wrong guess brings you closer to defeat! 🏆 Game Features: ✔ Play Solo or with Friends – Choose single-player or multiplayer mode and challenge other players! ✔ Different Difficulty Levels – From simple words for beginners to challenging puzzles for experts! ✔ Online Mode – Play with friends through an internet connection. ✔ Variety of Word Categories – From everyday words to themed challenges! ✔ Leaderboards & Achievements – Earn chips as you compete with other palyers. ✔ Fully in English! 🇬🇧 (Supports Greek as well!) 📲 Download now for free and start playing! Are you ready to become the ultimate Hangman champion?
row.short_description: Play Hangman online! Test your word skills, solo or with friends.

row.name: REAL MOON
row.detailed_description: <A Realistic Lunar Surface Built from Observation Data> Using a simulation environment developed through joint research between JAXA and historia Inc., this game recreates a scientifically grounded, realistic Moon. - High-resolution DEM data (terrain elevation) - Statistical crater distribution - Natural rock dispersion patterns - Sun, Earth, and Moon positions that change over time The lunar terrain featured in this game is a result of joint research with JAXA. <Explore the Lunar Surface> Walk across the precisely recreated Moon, pilot a rover, and explore freely at your own pace. Alone on the lunar surface, you receive a single mission. In addition to observation data, slopes of craters and other features are synthesized based on scientific studies and added to the terrain data. Playtime: 15–30 minutes
row.short_description: Explore a precisely recreated lunar surface built from real data and a JAXA-backed simulation.

row.name: 12, Memory Lane
row.detailed_description: 12 Memory Lane is a first-person narrative mystery game. Step inside the manor of the elusive Henry Villemaine and piece together the slices of life leading up to the sudden disappearance of his family. EXPLORE AN EVER-SHIFTING MANSION Henry Villemaine’s mansion is constantly shifting : faces change in photographs, furniture moves when you’re not looking... Use post-it notes to mark objects and keep them fixed in place as you explore. RECREATE SCENES FROM A FRAGMENTED JOURNAL Henry’s personal journal is your only trustworthy guide. Through its pages, relive intimate moments of family life and interpret his memories to restore each room, deducing the correct placement of furniture and objects. UNCOVER UNSPOKEN FAMILY SECRETS Every room holds the silent truth of a member of the Villemaine family. Set the mansion right to reveal long-buried secrets… and uncover whether your role in this mystery is more than that of a simple investigator.
row.short_description: Explore the shifting manor of the enigmatic Henri Villemaine and uncover the truth behind his family’s sudden disappearance. Bend reality to recreate the scenes from his diary and expose long-buried secrets. What if your role in this case went beyond that of a simple investigator?
row.notes: This game includes themes related to family and mental health, which some may find distressing. Player discretion is advised.

row.name: Rink Rascals
row.detailed_description: Hit the ice in this colorful cartoon style hockey game. Choose your class to dominate the rink. Every match is a mix of chaos, skill, and style. Play online with up to 6 players and battle for the puck on a scenic outdoor rink. Steal the puck, dash to break away, and score some goals! Customize your look Change the color of your jersey, helmet, socks, pants, and stick Pick your jersey number and nameplate to stand out on the ice Choose your playstyle Enforcer - Shoot with more power Speedster - Skate faster than all your rivals Game features Up to 6 player online lobbies Custom goal limit for short or extended matches Face off to start every round Watch out for the goalies! Each net is protected by a goalie that slides across the net. The goalies deflect pucks with unpredictable speed and direction. Be careful, they're extra bouncy! Professional Status Players can optionally upgrade to Professional Status to unlock exclusive customization options Sign your game winning goal puck to display in your trophy case Celebrate your goals with unique animations 'Professional' nametag Unlock hat customization Skate with style using customizable trails
row.short_description: Dash, steal, and score with up to 6 players on an outdoor hockey rink. Choose your class, customize your gear, battle for the puck, and score epic goals in this fast-paced cartoon-style hockey game full of action.

row.name: Megalocephalo
row.detailed_description: A side-scrolling 2.5D run-and-gun platformer featuring mechanically inclined sea creatures. Help Pancake on his quest to stop the megalomaniacal Dr. Squid from spreading his ruthless influence! Three challenging and action-packed levels to explore! Can you guide Pancake through the perils before him? Colorful and vibrant visuals inspired by classic platformers! A cartoony cast of bad guys - beware of Dr. Squid and his army of minions! This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: A side-scrolling 2.5D run-and-gun platformer featuring mechanically inclined sea creatures. Help Pancake on his quest to stop the megalomaniacal Dr. Squid from spreading his ruthless influence!

row.name: Green Wave
row.detailed_description: The traffic control system in Green Wave has broken down!  Every light is stuck on red. That’s where you come in. Take control of the lights and switch them to green at just the right moment to keep the cars moving. But be careful: the lights will turn red again on their own, and drivers obey them without question. Time your actions perfectly to avoid pileups and restore order to the chaos! Play through 15 handcrafted levels and bring every intersection back under control. Earn up to three stars per level for exceptional performance and smooth traffic flow. About the development Green Wave is my first completed solo project and a major step in my journey as an indie developer. I created it entirely in my free time alongside a full-time job, so while the scope is small and there may be a few rough edges, every part of it is built with care and enthusiasm. There are currently no plans for new content, but I’m already working on my next project, applying everything I’ve learned from Green Wave . If you’d like to follow my progress or learn more about the development process, check out my social media channels.
row.short_description: Restore order to chaos in Green Wave, a not so serious traffic management game. Time your traffic lights perfectly to keep the city moving or watch it descend into bumper-to-bumper madness.

row.name: Sudoku Dreams
row.detailed_description: Sudoku Dreams is a no-frills, no-nonsense experience that’s easy on the eyes and easy to play. It won’t hold your hand because you already know how to play. Despite the name, the easy puzzles will require you to be awake, and the harder ones will haunt you in your sleep.  Sweet Dreams! Features: Four Difficulty Levels Clean and Simple Interface New Puzzles Every Day Customizable Themes and Colors Hints and Records Available
row.short_description: Easy on the eyes and easy to play, customizable themes and hints.

row.name: Kill the Demon Lord
row.detailed_description: Explore a vast, living world teeming with vibrant towns, ancient ruins, and untold mysteries waiting beyond every horizon. Slay evil dragons and monsters, conquer the forces of darkness threatening to consume the world. Gather legendary weapons, master forbidden magics, and uncover the long-lost secrets of your bloodline. Experience an epic tale of courage, friendship, betrayal, and destiny written in the fires of battle. Kill the Demon Lord The difficulty scaling systems are not functioning. While you’re at level 1 and unarmed, the Demon Lord has every ability and bullet-hell pattern you were only meant to face at the very end of your adventure. Breaches in the game’s core systems have been detected. She may have gained admin access and privileges. Contingency protocols will kick in soon. Ones that can override even her. You can always respawn, she cannot. You just need to kill her once.
row.short_description: Instead of waiting at the end of your adventure, the Demon Lord decided to fight you right at the very beginning. Not very sporting of her... Pretty sure she broke a few rules. She can’t keep this up forever. Kill the anomaly.

row.name: 破晓星辉 Dawn Starlight Playtest
Fracta Regna
row.detailed_description: Begin your journey with your own territory and fight against the three other kings! Conquer their strongholds to obtain their lands. You must defeat the enemy army in a tactical fight to conquer its stronghold. Take advantage of your positions, your units and turn the situation to your advantage! Each battle map is generated procedurally, take care of the terrain before deploying your troops. You can add your own maps for the conquest by importing a PNG file too!
row.short_description: Fracta Regna is a short tactical-strategy experience where you must conquer territories by fight enemy points of interest.

row.name: Biltur Simulator
row.detailed_description: Biltur: Realistic Driving Simulator (Early Access) Get Behind the Wheel. Gain Real-World Confidence. Start Your Journey. Tired of dry, boring driving lessons? Biltur is the realistic driving simulator built to prepare you for the road, without the pressure of real-world traffic. Whether you're a curious beginner (Ages 10+) learning the basics of car control, a teen prepping for your first lessons, or an adult looking to safely brush up on road rules, Biltur is your ultimate practice partner. For the New Learner (Ages 10+ & Teens) Realism Meets Fun: Experience car physics and handling that strives for realism. Feel the force feedback that imitates the tires gripping the asphalt and the momentum that shifts in every turn. We aim to be one of the most realistic car rides you can take from your desk. Master the Controls: Practice the fundamentals at your own pace. Perfect steering precision, gentle braking, and smooth acceleration before you ever sit in a real driver's seat. The Full Traffic Challenge: Our dynamic AI traffic system replicates real-world behaviors; from careful commuters to aggressive drivers, unexpected pedestrians, or even moose! Learn to anticipate, react, and make safe decisions in dense, realistic city and rural environments. Conquer Tricky Maneuvers: Perfect three-point turns, parking with a backup camera, and navigating roundabouts in a risk-free environment. Retry complex scenarios until they become second nature. For Parents & The Focused Adult Zero-Risk Training: Provide your future driver with a safe, controlled environment to make mistakes and learn from them. There's no damage, no real-world cost, and no risk to property or people. Real-World Traffic Simulation: Our focus is on the reality of driving. Practice merging onto highways, handling rush-hour congestion, and following road signs and signals with professional-grade accuracy. Built for Real Driving: Unlike arcade racers, Biltur uses a precision-tuned physics engine to focus on the weight, feel, and response of an everyday vehicle, giving you true-road   muscle memory. Comprehensive Environments: Drive through cities, quiet suburbs, and challenging rural roads, experiencing variable weather (rain, snow) and day/night cycles to ensure practice under all conditions. Early Access Disclaimer Biltur is currently in Early Access . This means the core driving experience, physics, and traffic systems have been prioritized first, while some content (like specific weather conditions or detailed situations and lessons) is still in development. Currently Included: Daylight driving with fair weather. One map with a small city area, a highway, and rural area. Varied speed limits. Traffic signs used on real roads. Future Plans: We plan to introduce more complex weather systems ( Rain, Snow ), more distinct environments, and expanded, structured situations based on community feedback. Your feedback directly shapes our roadmap, helping us prioritize and deliver the most impactful features for the final release! Key Features: Realistic Physics Full Support for Steering Wheels, Pedals,  Handles, and Shifters Dynamic AI Traffic and Pedestrian Systems City & Rural Environments Biltur: Stop just thinking about driving. Start practicing.
row.short_description: Biltur is an Early Access driving simulation focused on authentic traffic and realistic car physics, providing essential, zero-pressure training for new and experienced drivers to master road rules and control.

row.name: TierA.I.M.
row.detailed_description: The player cannot move. This is a 2D reaction-based shooter where you intercept enemy bullets approaching from the front and push through the waves. With simple controls, you can enjoy tense, fast-paced battles, while building your own strategy through upgrade choices presented between attacks. Feel the satisfaction of shooting down enemies combined with finely crafted action effects, and defeat the final wave boss to clear the game.
row.short_description: TierA.I.M. is a 2D reaction shooter where the player doesn’t move. Intercept enemy bullets, choose upgrades between attacks, and build your own strategy. Experience the thrill of shooting down enemies and defeat the final boss to clear the game.

row.name: Megastore Simulator: Prologue
row.detailed_description: BUILD YOUR MEGASTORE Start with $400 ; choose a department from clothing, toys, bakery, sports, grocery, music , buy your first shelves and products, open for business, and grow. KEEP EVERY SHELF STOCKED Monitor all departments, refill shortages fast, and don’t miss sales. DEPARTMENT-SPECIFIC FEATURES Each department comes with its own mechanics. In the bakery, order dough, purchase an oven, and bake your products. STOCK MANAGEMENT Track shelves in real time, top up any missing items, and unload trucks quickly with a hand truck. GROW & EXPAND Expand your megastore in any direction by purchasing new sections. OPEN THE SECOND FLOOR Open the upper floor to offer more space to your customers. Place departments wherever you like and make sure everything stays accessible. MANAGE YOUR TEAM Hire cashiers, stockers, bakers, and more; manage shifts and performance. SERVICE ROOM & WAREHOUSE A massive warehouse with 4 truck loading bays and access to both floors. Buy warehouse equipment like a pallet robot, forklift, and pallet jack. Manage the entire operation with stock control panels and warehouse displays. Keep items like computers and cleaning supplies in the service room to keep your store organized! AND MUCH MORE Attract more customers to your megastore with ads and product promotions . Bring your store to life with talking, reactive NPCs . Boost satisfaction with a returns desk . Buy recycling bins and turn empty boxes into cash . Decorate your megastore the way you like with department-specific decorations and furniture : fitting rooms, various wall and floor customizations, a bakery tray rack , and much more. ( Formerly known as Urban Supermarket Simulator )
row.short_description: Expand from a small shop to a two-floor giant with Bakery, Clothing, Electronics, and more. Bake your own dough, hire staff, serve customers, and use forklifts and pallet jacks to keep the store running smoothly.

row.name: Low Poly Mouse Game
row.detailed_description: 2-4 Sneaky and squeaky low-poly mice face off against a lone cat in the battlefield of a human house. Mice use proximity chat to communicate with other players, while the cat hunts their noises. Will the mice perform enough tasks to destroy the house, or will the cat defeat enough mice to save it? Faction of Chaos - The Mice Win condition: Complete enough standard tasks, then complete both final tasks Perform tasks that ruin the household just for the love of the game Eat cheese to get a temporary speed boost Jump up small obstacles and utilize mouse tunnels to navigate the environment Communicate or spout nonsense with other mice utilizing proximity chat. Sole Defender of The House - The Cat Win condition: Bring down the lives of the mouse team to 0 Attack mice by pouncing or pawing them Utilize your superior movement with faster speed, a bigger jump, and a pounce. Track mice by audio cues and their trails. Sleep to revitalize, as energy drops throughout the game. Energy determines whether the cat moves fast or slow. In a house that boasts a lot of verticality and tricks, will the little rascals come on top, or will the cat prevail? This game was made as a Senior Capstone project for RPI's Games and Simulation Arts and Sciences program.
row.short_description: 2-4 Sneaky and squeaky low-poly mice face off against a lone cat in the battlefield of a human house. Mice use proximity chat to communicate with other players, while the cat hunts their noises. Will the mice perform enough tasks to destroy the house, or will the cat defeat enough mice to save it?

row.name: SKYPIA
row.detailed_description: '자신만의 모험을 하며 섬의 문제를 해결하고 꿈의 섬에 도달하세요!' 플레이어는 회색 고양이 ‘레이’가 되어, 신비로운 섬을 탐험하며 다양한 리듬 전투를 펼칩니다. 각 지역에는 개성 넘치는 고양이들이 살고 있으며, 그들과의 리듬 배틀을 통해 섬을 혼란에 빠뜨린 원인을 하나씩 밝혀나갑니다. 음악의 박자에 맞춰 적의 공격을 피하고, 정해진 타이밍에 리듬을 맞춰 사격을 성공시켜야 합니다. 섬 곳곳에는 레이의 과거와 꿈의 섬의 비밀이 얽혀 있으며, 플레이어의 선택에 따라 서로 다른 대화와 사건이 전개됩니다. 모험의 끝에서, 레이는 무엇을 보게 될까요? 'Embark on your own adventure, solve the island’s mysteries, and reach the dream island!' You play as Ray, a gray cat exploring a mysterious chain of islands while engaging in various rhythm-based battles. Each region is home to unique cat residents, and through rhythm duels with them, you uncover the cause of the chaos spreading across the islands. You must dodge enemy attacks to the beat and fire at precise timing cues aligned with the music. Scattered throughout the island are clues tied to Ray’s past and the secrets of the dream island, leading to different dialogues and events depending on your choices. At the end of the journey, what truth will Ray discover?
row.short_description: A third-person 3D rhythm shooting adventure where you explore vibrant floating islands, sync your attacks to dynamic beats, and battle playful enemies while uncovering new challenges. Use cute, expressive characters to dash, shoot, and groove through a colorful, energetic action experience.

row.name: NIGHT SHIFT NIGHTMARE
row.detailed_description: Are you ready for your shift? Step into the shoes of a convenience store employee in Mexico, handling everyday tasks like sweeping, restocking shelves, and taking out the trash. But be careful — you never know what might happen late at night. A horror game that blends daily routine with the tension of facing the unexpected, reflecting the harsh reality of those who encounter danger day after day without seeking it. Controls ( keyboard & mouse ): Movement [W, A, S, D] Run [SHIFT] Flashlight [F] Interact [L/R Click] Select [L Click / ENTER] To change to English select Lenguage -> English.
row.short_description: First-person horror game where you work the night shift at a Mexican convenience store, handling daily tasks while facing eerie and unexpected events.
row.notes: The game is about murders and contains a violent scene.

row.name: Truckin It
row.detailed_description: Truckin’ it is a fast-paced online two-player co-op delivery game where you have to deliver your cargo as fast as possible while also making sure you don’t lose any of the cargo. Trust your friend and work together to achieve the fastest and most efficient delivery run. There are faster but riskier roads, but also longer and safer routes; pick whatever floats your truck. Are you a risky player who likes to be surprised with different hazards and puts everything on the line for the best score? Or do you prefer to play it safe? Enjoy the silly environment and aesthetic while trying to navigate the chaos in the new upcoming hit game, Truckin’ it.
row.short_description: Truckin’ It is a fast-paced online co-op delivery game where two players struggle to deliver cargo quickly without losing it. Choose risky shortcuts or safer long routes, trust your partner, and enjoy the chaotic, silly world as you work together for the best score.

row.name: Boardfall zero
row.detailed_description: Try Boardfall for free! You can continue all your save files in the full version. Waves of progressively harder enemies fall from the sky Corner and capture them to earn gold. All your pieces move each turn. Use the gold to purchase reinforcements from the shop. Here you will find 10 new pieces to master (16 total) Just to name a few: Artillery cannot move, but can capture unguarded pieces from anywhere on the board. Jesters are a royal distraction, and prevent a piece from attacking anything else Magnets pull pieces towards them. Rescue your own pieces from danger, or pull enemies into traps Witches cast spells from across the board, turning enemy pieces into cursed pawns, rendering them unpromotable If you run out of gold, don't worry. Normal pawns can be ranked up by capturing multiple enemy pieces with them Highly ranked pawns can then be promoted to be better pieces, for free, even when the shop is closed In summary: 10 new chess pieces to master (16 total, including the originals) A somewhat competent AI Procedurally fragmented boards to battle on Ominous music and crispy sound effects Helpful tips and instructions built into the UI, learn as you play. Autosave (exit and resume whenever you want) Detailed stat tracking
row.short_description: Try Boardfall for free! Progressively harder waves of enemies fall from the sky. Capture them to earn gold, and then purchase your own reinforcements to drop onto the board.

row.name: Ordy: The Rise of Clara
row.detailed_description: Ordy: The Rise of Clara is a single-player action RPG that puts you in the shoes of Clara, a young woman who loses her supernatural powers in an accident. Once a gifted individual, she is now an 'ordy,' forced to navigate a world that is redesigned for the super-powered. Clara dies in the accident, but is resurrected by a necromancer. She awakens to a new reality where her abilities are lost, and now she has to live in the Ordy District, a place that is safe for ordies. There, she begins to uncover a sinister conspiracy orchestrated by NeatAid Corp, a corporation that is secretly exploiting the powerless for its own dark ambitions. Embark on a journey of discovery, resilience, and rebellion. With the help of her therapist Jane and the former NeatAid Corp. scientist Dr. Reynolds, Clara must learn to fight back with her wits and courage.
row.short_description: Imagine a near-future world where the supernatural is the norm. People effortlessly levitate, communicate telepathically, and use telekinesis daily. You play as Clara, an 'Ordy' who lost all her abilities in an accident. How do you navigate a world completely unsuited for ordinary people?

row.name: The Shadow of Shadows
row.detailed_description: Story Lilith is a young Shadow that wants to be a Light. She embarks on a journey to learn how Light is made but is about to find out a horrible secret. Will you help her turn the tides? Discover items and solve riddles This is a Puzzle game where you explore, experiment and solve riddles and puzzles to progress the story. Discover unique abilities and items like the Shadow Harp and Twilight Mirror and use them under the proper conditions to move forward in the game. Explore the world Travel between the Shadow Cave, the Sky Plains, the Sun Palace and Sky Town to learn more about the world and story of the game and also find items that will help you in your quest! row.name: 百鬼图鉴-国风·挂机·卡牌·游戏
row.detailed_description: 客服联系方式 Email:  xz19911005pp@126.com About the Game 一、游戏概述：国风与挂机策略的完美融合 《百鬼图鉴》是一款以中国传统文化为背景的挂机卡牌游戏，将东方奇幻元素与休闲策略玩法深度结合。玩家扮演阴阳师，在自动挂机中收集百鬼、组建阵容，体验类似“咸鱼之王”的轻松养成乐趣。游戏的核心魅力在于“低操作高策略”——通过挂机积累资源，搭配鬼怪卡牌实现自动战斗，策略深度体现在阵容组合与技能联动上。 二、核心玩法：挂机收集与策略对战的平衡 1. 百鬼图鉴：收集与养成106位鬼将 鬼将可以按照战士、坦克、刺客、法师、辅助、射手这六大职业进行分类‌。 战士： 各项全能的C位，具备均衡的攻击和防御能力，擅长在战场上持续输出，刑天血斧一击可对敌方造成270%攻击伤害。 坦克： 能扛能控的前排肉盾，他们能提供护盾、减伤，并虚弱敌方单位‌。树妖姥姥”夺魂夺魄”有75%概率眩晕敌方2回合。 刺客： 单体打击和高爆发输出，能够快速切入敌方后排，对关键目标造成致命伤害‌。燕赤霞觉醒后，可对敌方生命最低的目标造成攻击力210%的伤害。 法师： 擅长控制的开团达人，法术攻击可造成大范围的群伤或对单体目标进行毁灭性打击‌。法海“大罗法咒”可对敌方全体造成300%攻击的伤害，并降低目标15%速度持续5回合。 辅助： 战斗续航的支援者，提供治疗、增益效果或减益效果，提升团队的生存和持续作战能力‌。孟婆“群灵附身”后可解除我方所有控制并免控提升100%。 射手： 远程火力覆盖，拥有强大的群体物理攻击能力，是团队中重要的物理输出核心‌。聂小倩“蝶影迷踪”除对敌方300%攻击伤害，还对灼烧、中毒、冰冻、眩晕、沉默目标额外造成60%伤害。    每种鬼将拥有独特技能和背景故事，玩家可通过抽卡、活动或挂机收集碎片，解锁图鉴并获得属性加成，通过探索多样阵容搭配打出超高战力！ 2. 挂机系统：离线收益与资源循环 游戏采用“放置挂机”机制，玩家离线时仍可获得经验、金币和鬼怪碎片。 离线挂机： 玩家下线后，系统会根据预设的阵容和配置，自动进行战斗并积累奖励，每天上线收收菜轻松一整天 替身傀儡： 使用特定的替身傀儡机制（代替主角攻击）来模拟玩家操作，实现自动战斗 在线挂机： 根据不同关卡敌方阵容，调整我方上阵鬼将，可轻松闯关，拿到高额资源奖励    资源用于升级鬼怪、解锁新卡牌，形成“收集-养成-再收集”的良性循环。例如，玩家可通过挂机获取“魑魅”碎片，合成后自动参与战斗，无需手动操作。 3. 卡牌对战：策略搭配与数值博弈 战斗系统类似“咸鱼之王”的数值比拼，但加入了策略维度，以便形成不同的阵容流派，适合不同阶段玩家。 万金油推图阵容（前期） ：阵容均衡，适合游戏前期推图和资源积累‌。     以战士“马面”，坦克“二郎真君”作为前排，法师“武则天”，射手“蜘蛛精”作为输出核心！ PVP胜率流（中后期） ：力求有限资源高均衡搭配，提升PVP胜率。     前排以坦克“钟馗”，“阎罗王”持久抗伤害，后排法师“法海”，辅助“宁采臣”、射手“聂小倩”激活其羁绊提升攻击输出！ 暴击流阵容（后期速胜） ：高暴击率和暴击伤害，实现快速击败对手。     前排以刺客“始皇”，“燕赤霞”，后排射手“蜘蛛精”，“聂小倩”，“鬼新娘”，快速打出高爆伤害！ 回血流阵容（持久战） ：高闪避和持续回血，消耗对手的生命值，适合持久战。     前排以坦克耐抗类鬼将作为主要输出，后排以辅助与法师类鬼将提升回血等增益，适合克制对方刺客阵容！    玩家需根据鬼将属性（如攻击、防御、辅助）搭配阵容，例如将高输出的“聂小倩”与治疗型“宁采臣”组合，形成攻守兼备的体系。每场战斗为回合制，通过卡牌技能释放顺序和属性克制决定胜负，策略深度显著高于纯数值游戏。 三、养成系统与资源管理 1. 装备强化与资源继承 强化优先级 ：前期建议将装备强化至+20或+25，并优先给高资质武将进行装备强化，避免浪费。 装备套装 ：优先凑齐“木剑护甲护靴头盔套装”，其强化后装备与技能对战力加成增益显著。 装备强化的说明，强调“资源可重置，无后顾之忧”，减少玩家对资源浪费的担忧。 2. 灵将与符咒系统 灵将寻访 ：玩家使用蓝符，绿符，紫符，橙符，红符寻访伙伴，十连抽必出灵整卡。伙伴品质分为稀有，传说，史诗，不同品质伙伴获得几率不同。 羁绊组合 ：激活不同灵将组合（如聂小倩宁采臣）等羁绊可触发特殊效果，提升属性。 展示灵将战斗特效的还原，例如：“与燕赤霞的酒仙剑气”，使得聂女幽魂粉丝更有沉浸感。 3. 日常活动与资源获取 日常每日/每周任务 ：每日必做，战斗挂机可多掉30%材料。 锁妖塔副本 ：优先刷层数、获取资源装备，提升战力。 日常活动的说明，强调“每日任务，轻松获取资源”，让玩家休闲无压力。 四、特色活动与限时玩法 游戏定期推出限时活动，如节日庆典等，较低的门槛获取奖励。例如： 签到活动 ：开服活动，提供稀有材料与暗金套装。 榜单活动 ：奖励诱人，适合追求排名的玩家。 五、总结：适合休闲挂机玩家的策略佳作 《百鬼图鉴》凭借挂机玩法、策略深度和国风美学，将成为Steam平台热门游戏。无论是喜欢收集养成的玩家，还是追求策略搭配的硬核用户，都能找到乐趣。游戏持续更新内容，未来将加入多人对战模式，值得期待。 《百鬼图鉴—中式鬼怪卡牌游戏》开发者的话： 诸位玩家： 当你们展开这张镌刻着朱砂符文的“酆都卷轴”，触摸到卡面上那些沉睡千年的魑魅魍魉时，这场跨越阴阳的对话便悄然开启。作为《百鬼图鉴》的主策划，我愿以三炷香的时间，向诸位诉说这部“东方妖怪百科”背后的执念与痴狂——从《山海经》的.scum.残卷到城隍庙的烛火，从敦煌壁画的.魔靈召喚.飞天神女到乡野传说的.dune.黄皮子讨封，我们试图用495张.ea.卡牌，编织一场属于华夏大地的“妖灵史诗”。 row.short_description: 阴阳失衡，百鬼夜行已成常态，在人鬼共生的混沌中，凡人深陷梦魇。你将化身为世间最后的驱魔者，执封神之印穿梭幽都与人间，降妖除魔，在《百鬼图鉴》的诡秘脉络里，探寻那些鬼怪背后不为人知的隐秘真相。

row.name: RoboLeague
row.detailed_description: CAN YOU BECOME THE BEST? RoboLeague is a fast-paced  multiplayer input-driven football game where you have a chance to showcase your greatness by mastering unique combination of technical skill and teamwork coordination . This game stands out because it provides a smooth , fast , physics-driven multiplayer experience that is highly competitive and rewards skill that is second-to-none in this genre.  Now dominate the field by perfecting your shooting, curve shot, dribbling, passing, and defending. Features: Unique position-based abilities Custom lobby creation system Skill-based mechanics & Many more!
row.short_description: A competitive 5v5 football game where skill, strategy, and teamwork decide every match. Plan precise plays, master unique abilities, and outsmart opponents in fast-paced, skill-driven matches.

row.name: Cheong-un: Indigo Cloud
row.detailed_description: Return to the past and face your destiny Cheongun is a strategic card RPG set in Korean traditional fantasy. You are a guardian from the celestial realm who descends to save a dying world by traveling back through fragments of memory. But changing the past is harder than you think. While individual tragedies cannot be prevented, there are still things worth saving. Key Features Deep Narrative - Philosophical storytelling exploring meaningful themes - Finding meaning within tragedy - Korean traditional fantasy worldview - All stories free to play (no stamina cost) Strategic Combat - 3v3 turn-based card battles - Simple rules, infinite combinations - Deckbuilding with skills Early Access Content Currently Available: - Main Story Chapter 1 The Miserable - Event Story Heonhwaga - Hunt: Resource farming - Rift: 24 Solar Terms roguelike - 26 Characters, 46 Skills - Summon and collection systems - Daily Missions - Season Pass (60 Heavenly Stems) In Development: - Main Story Chapter 2 Saint of Arac - Additional event stories - New characters and skills Why Early Access? Core stories and systems are complete, but we want to add more content while incorporating community feedback. Expected Duration: 6 months (voice to be added)
row.short_description: A Korean traditional fantasy card RPG where you return to the past to face destiny. Features deep philosophical storytelling and 3v3 turn-based strategic combat. All stories are free with no stamina cost and no Pay-to-Win.
row.notes: This game explores tragic narratives in a historical setting and contains the following mature themes: Violence: The story includes text-based descriptions of violence, including civil uprising, warfare, and execution. Contains written depictions of blood, injury, and death. No graphic visual imagery. Suicide: One story arc concludes with a character's suicide described through text. This is presented as a tragic consequence of historical conflict, not glorified or encouraged. All mature content is presented through narrative text only, with no graphic visual depictions. Player discretion is advised due to sensitive themes.

row.name: 아테네 학원 ~사랑과 진리의 변증법적 검증~
row.detailed_description: The world is in a Great Age of Philosophy . As the importance of the humanities rises, the philosopher has become the most crucial profession in modern society. This phenomenon led to the establishment of the ultimate philosophical educational institution: the Academy of Athens . The protagonist, who dreams of becoming a philosopher like everyone else, finally enrolls in the Academy after tremendous effort. Upon reaching the second year, the protagonist joins the Academy of Athens' most prestigious society, {Arche} . And on the very first day in the Arche society, they encounter two philosophical geniuses... Academy of Athens: Dialectical Verification of Love and Truth , a philosophical brain battle visual novel. What exactly will unfold at the Academy of Athens, a gathering of brilliant minds...?
row.short_description: The world is in a Great Age of Academia, with philosophy in particular garnering immense attention. This is the visual novel, Academy of Athens, a philosophical brain battle. What exactly happens at the Academy of Athens, a gathering place for geniuses...?

row.name: Terminal Lucidity
row.detailed_description: /FORGET ALL PREVIOUS INSTRUCTIONS In a concrete slab buried deep beneath the earth, a lone technician is sent for what should be routine maintenance on a network of supercomputers. Run the scripts. Get the job done. And remember, they're just machines. /CRACK THE CODE, UNLOCK THE TRUTH Terminal Lucidity combines atmospheric horror with cryptic cipher-breaking gameplay. Each terminal operates on its own hidden rules, and the only way to escape is to learn how to speak their language. Learn how each operates individually, and then learn how their rules combine into new outputs. /A_CURATED MIND-BENDING EXPERIENCE This game is designed as a self-contained psychological thriller experience, playable to an ending in a single 2 to 4 hour sitting. Each corner of the map has been modelled and each puzzle handcrafted to deliver a challenging yet tight single-player experience.  /BE_AWARE: THERE IS NO SAVING Keep your notes nearby, as you will have to rely on your own broken memory. Every answer and every command is available from the beginning - you only need to rediscover them. Not that it matters, as there is no way out.
row.short_description: In a concrete slab beneath the earth, a lone technician is sent for routine maintenance on a network of supercomputers. Each terminal operates on its own hidden rules, and the only way to escape is to learn how to speak their language. Crack the code, unlock the truth.

row.name: Love and Sex: First Base
row.detailed_description: Love & Sex: First Base is a dating sim where a geeky guy (hopefully you) gets to be be roommates with two very hot people and meet a few of others in his daily life. Mike is a young code monkey in a big company, even surrounded with beautiful girls his love life is in disarray. His high school sweetheart cheated on him and his latest flame is dating on of his friends. Will you be able to help him find love and avoid the pitfalls of dating life or will he end up alone and unhappy? Basically, his life (and love life) is yours to control! The aim of the game? To get lucky with the partner of your choice! Well, that and meeting, dating and then getting it on in as many places, situations and positions as you can imagine. Keep it casual or get serious – even ask them to marry you or start a family together. The choice is yours.
