row.name: 深夜観光TASOGARE
row.detailed_description: 物語 「深夜観光TASOGARE」はクリック式のホラーアドベンチャーゲームです。 「夜物（よもつ）市」という聞いた事もない観光地へ、一人旅に出た大学生のソウヤは 様々なミニゲームによる観光を楽しみながら、出会った人々と思い出を作ります。 しかし町には不気味な伝説があり、夜が進むにつれて街には異変が現れて……。 概要 クリックでコマンドや選択肢を選んだり、調べることで物語を進める探索アドベンチャーゲームです。 物語は全13話、選択肢によって結末が変わるマルチエンド。 トゥルーエンドクリアでさらに１話が解放されます。 特徴 選択肢で結末が変わるマルチエンドの探索アドベンチャーゲーム リアルな日本の旅を感じられるグラフィック、音楽、演出 緊迫していくストーリーと魅力的な登場人物たちとの交流
row.short_description: 架空の日本観光地を旅するマルチエンドの探索アドベンチャー 緊迫していくストーリーと豊富なミニゲーム、魅力的な登場人物たちとの交流が楽しめます。

row.name: Manchester's Crimes: The Beginnings
row.detailed_description: IT'S TIME TO START THE INVESTIGATION... Manchester's Crimes: The Beginnings is the Nordic Cats Studio's debut. This game is the chapter one of an ambitious project developed by a talented team of passionate game lovers. The game is placed in United Kingdom in 1889. During the Victorian times, the British society faced increasing criminal activity, caused by the growing inequalities among the social classes. Among the numerous crimes, the amount of murders snowballed... In this game, you will be playing as a 21-year-old Wilson Hellberg, who grew up in a small town on the outskirts of Manchester. The Hellberg family is leading their ordinary life as a merchant family, untill... his older brother is murdered by an unknown criminal. The crime is disregarded and dismissed by the local authorities. Desperate Wilson decides to try and deliver the justice himself in the big, unknown city. Find clues in the foreign, hostile Manchester, full of outcasts and criminals. Explore both the dark streets and ornately decorated interiors, shown in detail thanks to an unordinary graphic design. Talk to the Mancunians (people living in Manchester), but remember that every word can bring Wilson closer to his goal. Keep a diary/journal. It will help you get to know Manchester with Wilson, and find out the identity of the killer.
row.short_description: Manchester, United Kingdom, 1889. 21-year-old Wilson Hellberg is looking for his brother's killer in a big, histile city. Explore rich neighborhoods and dark corners, conducting an investigation, which will lead Wilson closer to the long-awaited justice.
row.notes: This game may contain content that is not suitable for all age groups: - profanity and vulgar language - violence, description of murder - references to prostitution

row.name: FOGGY Golf
row.detailed_description: Use chess pieces as golf clubs to try and find the hole in a fog-covered golf course. But watch out for hazards like bunkers or water. Can you stay under par? FOGGY Golf is   One Part Golf One Part Chess One Part Minesweeper (Sort Of) and One Part Wordle (Kind Of) And now it's available on Steam! Features New Course Every Day Backlog of Past Courses Stats Tracking and Sharing. Free! No Really, it's Free.  No Un-skippable Video Ads No Microtransactions.
row.short_description: Daily Chess + Golf Based Hybrid Puzzle Game.

row.name: Clockwork Cleanup
row.detailed_description: Goo creatures are running amok in the spell factory and its up to you and MAC (Magical Automatic Custodian) to stop them! Guide MAC through five waves of creatures with a boss at the end of each wave. Choose a reward after each fight to craft an unstoppable spell arsenal!  Clockwork Cleanup is an auto-battler where MAC's actions are defined by spell tiles placed in the central grid. The spell tiles are powered by elemental sources located on the perimeter of the grid. You must use pipes and splitters to route the energy to the tiles. Some tiles require multiple elements which can quickly create congestion. Space is limited, but there will be opportunities to expand the grid as you progress. Modifier tiles can be attached to spell tiles to modify their behavior. A tile that may seem weak could shine with the right mods. Mix and match to find useful combinations. Once per wave, the workshop offers you a chance to further modify your grid and tiles. Fuse two elements together to create a dual-element tile. Cut a tile into two smaller tiles. Re-arrange the location of input connectors on tiles. Increase the mod limit Heal up or just scavenge for resources in the recycling bins. You must manage the grid space carefully to craft the right mix of offense, defense, and routing to save the factory! Features: 34 spell (action) tiles 17 modifier tiles 5 special routing tiles and 4 pass-through tiles 35 fights split into 5 waves with a total of 22 enemy types
row.short_description: Clockwork cleanup is a auto-battler game where your actions are dictated by tiles of various shapes placed in a grid. Defeat waves of enemies to save the factory!

row.name: MindEscape
row.detailed_description: Discover Who You Really Are MindEscape is not your typical personality test. Instead of endless questionnaires, you'll navigate through beautifully crafted 3D rooms filled with puzzles, mysteries, and unique scenarios. Your choices, reaction times, and problem-solving approaches create a comprehensive behavioral profile based on the Big Five personality model (OCEAN). How It Works Explore interconnected rooms, each featuring carefully designed challenges that naturally reveal your: Personality Traits : Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, and Neuroticism Problem-Solving Style : How you approach challenges under pressure Behavioral Patterns : Your authentic reactions without social desirability bias Communication Preferences : Leadership tendencies and collaborative instincts Why MindEscape Differs ✓ No Bias : Real behavioral data from gameplay, not self-reported answers ✓ Engaging Experience : Enjoy 10-minute sessions in visually immersive environments ✓ AI-Powered Analysis : Advanced machine learning provides objective, scientifically-validated insights ✓ Authentic Results : Designed to minimize manipulation—your gameplay reveals your true nature ✓ Comprehensive Reports : Detailed personality profiles you can download and share Perfect For Self-discovery : Understand your personality and strengths Career planning : Identify roles that match your natural style Team building : See how your personality complements others Research : Contribute to ongoing behavioral science studies Features 3D escape room environments Multiple interconnected rooms with unique themes Puzzle-solving challenges designed by psychologists and AI scientists Behavioral tracking and analysis Get Started Today : Play MindEscape, unlock your personality insights, and see how you compare. The only question is: are you ready to discover who you really are?
row.short_description: Step into immersive 3D escape rooms and reveal your true self. MindEscape uses cutting-edge AI and scientifically-backed gameplay to assess your personality, problem-solving style, and behavioral patterns—all while having fun

row.name: Stories Adrift: Wake - Prologue
row.detailed_description: Game 'Stories Adrift: Wake - Prologue' is a 2D point-and-click narrative-driven puzzle adventure game.  As the new owner of a book boat, you are entrusted with returning a single page of a book and embarks on a journey through a world both mysterious and familiar. By solving intricate puzzles and piecing together scattered clues, you uncover the truth of the world - and of yourself. Features 100% hand-painted visuals  delivering a deeply atmospheric experience Narrative-driven puzzles where you investigate with a detective’s intuition Original and multilayered worldbuilding inspired by diverse ancient cultures A parabolic tale  crafted in homage to Jorge Luis Borges
row.short_description: As the new owner of a book boat, you are entrusted with returning a single page of a book and embarks on a journey through a world both mysterious and familiar. By solving intricate puzzles and piecing together scattered clues, you uncover the truth of the world - and of yourself.

row.name: Song of Twilight
row.detailed_description: A horror adventure where you control two sisters trapped in a twisted otherworld, fleeing from the insane ruler known as 'Father'. Explore the realm of madness and find your escape. Your choices shape the story in this multi-ending experience. ============ **Escape from a World of Madness** The protagonist and her sister are dragged into an otherworld consumed by insanity. The ruler of this realm, known as 'Father', seeks to become a god by sacrificing the sister. Trapped in desperate terror, the two attempt to escape this nightmare——. **Chase-Based Horror** Mysterious entities called 'Fu' and 'Eien' attack you. **Exploration** Explore the insanity-filled otherworld and uncover clues to your escape. **Multiple Ending System** The story branches based on your choices. Can you free the girls from the otherworld's curse, or will——? Multiple endings await you. **Diverse Characters** Interactions with various characters you encounter in the otherworld will make the story deeper and more terrifying. ============ This game was created using RPG Maker MV.
row.short_description: A horror adventure where you control two sisters trapped in a twisted otherworld, fleeing from the insane ruler known as 'Father'. Explore the realm of madness and find your escape. Your choices shape the story in this multi-ending experience.

row.name: Your Canvas
row.detailed_description: Your Canvas is a Text-Based Adventure  game set during three therapy sessions with different time periods where the player will be presented with various choices for deciding the outcome of the story. Every choice the player has made throughout the game will culminate in 1 of 4 different endings. The main method that Your Canvas  uses to judge you is by letting you play its various mini-games, during which it will remember your decisions and change according to them. Your Canvas has various features and mechanics such as: Letting you customize your own environment. Random loot and items, making every playthrough unique. A journey through psychological psyche. RPG elements like stats, magic, weapons and buffs. Tactical turn-based combat. Story-Rich worlds buried within the mini-games. Different and interesting ways to approach every encounter. An overarching plotline. An original soundtrack.
row.short_description: Your Canvas is a Text-Based Psychological Horror game set during three therapy sessions with different time periods where the player will be presented with various choices for deciding the outcome of the story.
row.notes: Contains depictions of depression, anxiety, self-harm and a few sexually suggestive scenes. Viewer discretion is advised.

row.name: Dumbubu
row.detailed_description: Some mild amusement for your desktop. Throw desktop pet across screen Unlock weapons Idle loot drops for Steam Market Drop rates: 90% common, 9.9% Uncommon, 0.1% Rare (subject to change). This game is open source. Code in the 'Visit the website' link. This is a parody satire work inspired by toy-collecting trends.
row.short_description: You will own nothing and be happy. You can't afford a house, but you can afford Dumbubu Desktop Pet. Interact with Dumbubu and receive random skins tradeable on Steam Market.

row.name: Pigment
row.detailed_description: Something has taken all of the color and it's up to Huey to investigate! Make your way through ONE level and ONE boss to bring color back to the world. Pigment is a platformer with a big focus on air mobility. Moving through the world will add color to the hand-drawn backgrounds and environment. Over the course of your adventure you'll obtain the ability to jump and dash multiple times in the air and also refresh your aerial mobility options to stay airborne as long as you like.  Use of a controller is highly recommended.
row.short_description: All of the color has been wiped from Huey's world! Run, jump, dash, swipe, and pogo your way through this hand-drawn platformer to restore color to the land.

row.name: Tokë III
row.detailed_description: Tokë III is a platformer game inspired by classics of the 32-bit and 64-bit generation. You will take control of the mysterious Doke in his search for his dear friend Tokë, who was kidnapped by the evil Tako-san! After chasing his friend through a sinister portal, Doke is transformed into a skeleton... Discover your new abilities in this strange, bony form and conquer four wacky levels to climb Tako-san's tower and free your friend! Doke's abilities include throwing his own head, and then magically teleporting to it to overcome platforming challenges. As the levels become more difficult, the player must combine these abilities with other moves, such as sprinting and double jumping to collect spoompkins , unlock doors and conquer each level. This game was created by students of the Universidade do Vale do Itajaí, from Santa Catarina, Brazil.
row.short_description: Take control of the mysterious Doke in his search for his dear friend Tokë, who was kidnapped by the evil Tako-san! Doke was transformed into a skeleton while chasing his friend into a sinister portal. Discover your new abilities and conquer four levels to free your friend from the villain!

row.short_description: 南派三叔正版授权！化身摸金校尉，探秘七星鲁王宫、青铜门等经典场景，解开千年谜题！选择奇门、摸金或淘沙职业，与吴邪、张起灵并肩作战，挑战团队副本惊险刺激！强化装备、培养宠物，参与九门家族争夺战，在盗墓冒险中书写你的传奇！

row.name: MINOS: Home A-Labyrinth
row.detailed_description: MINOS: Home A-Labyrinth is a limited-time festive holiday special. Use improvised defenses, handcrafted tricks, and a full arsenal of festive hazards to prevent clumsy intruders from invading your labyrinth in this (almost) cozy spin-off that reimagines the trap-building gameplay of MINOS in a familiar holiday setting. Design and chain together traps, lure intruders into slapstick disasters, and protect your home from room to room. Expect quick sessions, chaotic encounters, and a playful celebration of defensive strategy. This project was created as a lighthearted seasonal promo and released entirely for free. If you enjoy the experience, wishlist MINOS, our full-scale trap-building labyrinth roguelite coming soon. Happy holidays!
row.short_description: A free MINOS spin-off inspired by everyone's favorite holiday film. Build festive traps, defend a snow-covered home from clumsy intruders, and unleash winter-grade mischief in this legally distinct seasonal homage.

row.name: Out of Order zero
row.detailed_description: Try Out of Order for free! Colours rise up from the ground, unordered, on spawner towers. You must quickly sort them and make sure they don’t go down into the wrong tower. Once arranged correctly, you’ll be rewarded with coins. Use these coins to buy items from the shop. Items make completing levels much easier. Higher rounds yield cheaper items and more coins. How many rounds will you survive? Features: Up to 4 players shared screen locally Any combination of keyboard and gamepad is supported Endless Procedural Gameplay Upgrade skills Discover Pets Purchase Items Map editor included Custom colour schemes Alternative keyboard layouts supported Controls There are several control schemes, of which you can combine in any way you like. - AZERTY / QWERTZ keyboards are supported. - Controls prompts for xbox / PS available (press left shoulder) - Connect up to 4 controllers Mouse: RMB + LMB + Scrollwheel Keyboard: WASD + E + SPACE IJKL + O + ENTER Arrow keys + SHIFT + M Controller: Axis + START + A Accessibility features - Ability to entirely customise the palettes used ingame - Can disable camera shake, rapid camera movements, photosensitive mode, plus change camera speed in settings - 4 Different volume controls to give further control to filter out any particular noises that are bothersome
row.short_description: Shout at up to 4 friends in this chaotic colour sorting game. The towers are constantly rising, so you must sort them quickly. Purchase items and discover pets.

row.name: Pet-That-Vtuber!
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the ultimate headpat experience! Dive into a cozy, interactive tribute where your simple goal is to show your appreciation through the universal language of headpats. How it Works: Gentle Pats: Click on Zentreya's head to give her gentle, appreciative pats. Each pat earns you points! Unlock Goodies: Spend your well-earned points in the shop to unlock a delightful collection of outfits and backgrounds. Customize Freely: Change her outfits and the scenery at any time during gameplay to create your perfect, comfy scene. This is a lightweight, free-to-play fan game. It's a simple, relaxing digital space where you can kick back, destress, and enjoy some wholesome interaction. No complicated goals, no pressure. Just pure, patting relaxation. Features: Satisfying headpat mechanics A variety of cute outfits to unlock Multiple scenic backgrounds to collect Instant outfit and background switching A chill, positive vibe
row.short_description: A brutal and honest look into the reality of petting a cute girl on her head. Enjoy the digital warmth of simulated physical affection. Pet Zen on her head. Try different cute outfits. Having fun is encouraged.
row.notes: Game contains revealing and sexualized outfits.

row.name: Legitimate Space Corp Simulator LLC - Prologue
row.detailed_description: In  Legitimate Space Corp Simulator LLC Prologue, you are the sole human employee of an intergalactic Space Station. Your job is to operate, build, manage, and expand the most questionable business empire in the galaxy, Space Corp LLC.  The Prologue is the first chapter in the long journey ahead when you move into the full version of Legitimate Space Corp Simulator LLC. Get indoctrinated into your new life as the manager on board the Station in Sector 7-G. As Earth has been destroyed, what choices do you really have? Full Job Description: NOW HIRING: Intergalactic Station Manager (Temporary*) What can you do as the newest member of Legitimate Space Corp?   *This position is part of the “Sorry We Destroyed Your Planet, Rehabilitation Initiative” Customise your Space Shop & the whole Station! Refuel questionable spaceships with fuel that WASN’T cut with interstellar debris! Maintain the teleporter (i.e., making sure nobody gets turned into a goop slime.... again) Repair Asteroid Damage with technically functional equipment! Manage the Day-to-Day operations of a Legitimate Station Outpost—ordering products and fuel, stocking shelves, serving customers, and, coolest of all, picking up trash! Upgrade your shop, hangers, fuel tanks, and build in-station teleporters. Try your hand at Lucky Gorblash and more! Cultivate entirely legal, non-contraband crops in our semi-sentient greenhouse. Play with unofficially approved, human recreational items and tools. This is your chance! Take a leadership role, make a name for yourself in the outer rim, and maybe make enough credits to upgrade from 'intern with oxygen privileges' to 'franchise owner.' Apply today!
row.short_description: NOW HIRING: Station Manager! Run a totally-legit* space biz in Sector 7-G. Farm alien crops, refuel shady ships, and sell dangerously edible snacks. Perks: gloves, oxygen insurance**, and mild relevance. No exp needed. Apply today! *Legit status not valid in all sectors. **Terms apply.
row.reviews: “This game is fricken awesome! Such a good game. Can’t wait for the release!” Sturbex Gaming “Qué chulo, tío. Muy muy guapo, el juego, tío. Muy muy guapo.” DeTester Gaming

row.name: Not For You
row.detailed_description: DO NOT PLAY THIS GAME IF YOU DO NOT LIKE NARRATIVE GAMES     NOT FOR YOU is an album of short, narrative experiences, which you can play through in any order you would like. Each one delves further into the thoughts and feelings of the games developer, Thomas Hunt, and the struggle that is the video game industry. Founder of award-winning indie studio InkForge Studios, Thomas Hunt is just another developer, making just another game. What makes him any different from the 100 other developers out there? Nothing. Apart from a great sense of humor of course. (This is written by Thomas, if that wasn't clear already). Look this description is getting too long already. I COULD sit here and tell you about the socio-political skateboarding cow, but where would be the fun in that. Play the game, or don't. It's your decision, and after all, its NOT FOR YOU.
row.short_description: Narrative experience from the mind of Thomas Hunt. Skateboarding Cows? Sentient boxes? A deep, emotional melodrama about the video games industry? Yep, it's got it all!  NOT FOR YOU is a collection of short experiences, which you can play in any order you would like!
row.notes: References to suicide

row.name: Empyreus
row.detailed_description: A short, free bullet hell following two gun-wielding angels as war unfolds in Heaven. Paradise fractured when many celestial beings turned against God, falling as demons and plunging the realm into chaos, an incident that reshaped the heavens. In this retro-styled bullet hell, you’ll shoot, dodge, and weave through dense curtains of fire as angels wield rifles, demons channel forbidden knowledge, and Paradise itself becomes a war-torn battlefield. Medieval iconography mixes with Great War grit as chiptune hymns drive the action, pulling you through absurd theological drama and encounters with bizarre demons. The tale follows Ariel, a clumsy angel who gets separated from her squadron, and Cassiel, who soon sets out to find her. Demonic experiments, ridiculous confrontations, and chaotic skirmishes unfold as the pair tries to reunite. Short, focused, and skill-driven, the game features two main levels and an extra secret stage for players who want an extra challenge. This is a complete, ad-free game released for free. Survive the bullet hell and restore the bullet heaven!
row.short_description: A short, free bullet hell following two gun-wielding angels as war unfolds in Heaven. Dodge dense patterns, face demanding boss fights, and uncover skill-based secrets in this tight retro experience. Survive the bullet hell and restore the bullet heaven!
row.notes: This game contains minor profanity and sort of violent deaths.

row.name: N0-V4
row.detailed_description: You receive an email from an unknown sender. Attached is a .ZIP folder containing a single .exe. The subject line presents a question: Are you Human or Robot? Play as N0-V4, Dr. (Mari) Machina's latest creation and magnum opus, who undergoes several... bizarre experiments to test its capabilities before the World Robot Conference. Will it escape the mad scientist's sadistic trials, or will this greatest accomplishment become the greatest detriment? WHAT DOES N0-V4 OFFER? A limbo race against a (handsome) Roomba  A torture chamber full of pesky magnets A chemistry-based slide with moving segments 3 endings depending on your performance for each test  2 secret endings (Shh...) 7 completion stars Many, many 4th wall breaks  Marisol 'Mary' Susie Machina Obeying Marisol 'Mary' Susie Machina Obeying Marisol 'Mary' Susie Machina again Obeying Marisol 'Mary' Susie Machina even more Obeying Marisol 'Mary' Susie Machina forever Gamepad is supported, though keyboard is the ideal input method for the best experience! 4F 6E 6C 79 20 69 66 20 79 6F 75 20 4F 42 45 59 2E
row.short_description: N0-V4 is a science fiction/psychological horror art piece that treads along the lines of the '.exe' genre while taking inspiration from RPGMaker classics. You're a robot undergoing beta-testing. Is the end goal to ESCAPE THE GAME... or is it to OBEY Dr. (Mari) Machina, your creator?

row.name: Isagi's Bartending Diary
row.detailed_description: After a three-month leave of absence, bartender Isagi returns to work at the 'Blue Lock' bar. Together with his 'partner' Bachira, he will serve various customers, prepare drinks, and listen to their stories. In the game, you will interact with the patrons of Blue Lock from Isagi's perspective. As conversations deepen, fragments of the past regarding '■■' gradually come to light... Mix drinks, change lives. Welcome to Blue Lock! Special Notes This is a fan-made derivative game set in a VA-11 HALL-A alternate universe, inspired by Blue Lock . The main pairing is 'Isagi x Bachira,' though relationships between the protagonist and other characters, as well as dynamics among other characters, may also be explored. The game's outline was finalized in November 2023. Some character portrayals may differ from the official recent developments. Please kindly understand! The game's worldbuilding is adapted from VA-11 HALL-A with creative liberties. Prior experience with VA-11 HALL-A is not required to enjoy this game. Characters from VA-11 HALL-A will be briefly mentioned in the storyline but will not appear directly. Game Overview This visual novel includes 1 fixed ending + 3 hidden endings . In-game choices only affect the unlocking of hidden endings and do not alter the main storyline. Music Licensing The composer of VA-11 HALL-A's soundtrack, Michael Kelly (@Garoad Music) , has granted permission for the use of VA-11 HALL-A's original soundtrack in this free fan game. Special thanks to him! Production Credits Original Works: Blue Lock & VA-11 HALL-A Original Teams: Muneyuki Kaneshiro / Yusuke Nomura, Sukeban Games Story & Art: 戏言Bobo Programming: Aaron栩生阿龙 Music: Michael Kelly (@Garoad Music) Store Promotional Art: 伞蜥蜴 Library Promotional Art: Clarent
row.short_description: This fan game, set in a VA-11 HALL-A alternate universe and centered around the 'Isagi x Bachira' pairing from Blue Lock, tells the story of bartender Isagi returning to work at Blue Lock after a three-month leave of absence...

row.name: Ablossomreddish
row.detailed_description: Ablossomreddish is a fast-paced platforming and parkour game focused on precise movements and time-based challenges. Run, jump, and use your dash to overcome demanding stages filled with platforms, deadly falls, and secret shortcuts that only the most skilled players will master. The story begins when your sister is kidnapped by a powerful corporation. Now, only you can rescue her. But the mission is far from simple: prepare to face brutal obstacles, unpredictable challenges, and enemies determined to stop your progress. Each level demands quick reflexes, complete mastery of movement, and the ability to improvise under pressure. Time is your greatest enemy — every second counts, and any mistake could cost everything. As you advance, the difficulty ramps up, new dangers emerge, and the corporation reveals just how far it will go to stop you. Will you be fast enough to reach her before it’s too late? The fate of both is in your hands. Story On an ordinary day, the company Ablossomreddish discovers a very valuable area for sale in a certain forest. However, Keplifabcel (you) and your sister live in that place. Upon learning this, the company goes to your home to talk, but both of you refuse to cooperate. Even so, the company insists on taking possession of the land and, as a last resort, ends up capturing your sister. Keplifabcel only discovers what happened after waking up and, desperate, immediately sets out to find her. Now, Keplifabcel will try to intercept the corporation’s employee on the way to the company headquarters in an attempt to stop their plans and rescue his sister. Commands UP – Interact DOWN – Move Down LEFT – Move Left RIGHT – Move Right C – Jump X – Enable/Disable Sprint Z – Dash (forward)
row.short_description: A challenging platform and parkour game where every second counts. Run, jump, and perform precise moves to overcome intense and dangerous levels as you try to rescue your sister from the clutches of the powerful AblossomReddish corporation. Only the fastest and most skilled will make it to the end.

row.name: The Joy of Putting
row.detailed_description: Relive the era of Flash mini-golf games on more than 54 holes based on real courses! And do it... for The Joy of Putting! What are you getting ? Arcady putting physics 54 different holes Online leaderboards 3 different courses Challenging achievements Chill and relaxing soundtrack Based on real-life courses! This is the only online game with the official competition holes from the Mini-Putt leagues from Québec. Master them all from the comfort of your home. Gotta Ace them all! Every hole is built with this principle in mind :  If you can putt it, you can sink it. Will you be able to Ace all 54 holes ? Retro-gaming goodness Sit back, relax and revisit the early 2000 world of simple fun 'Flash' games. With only the good parts!  Nice retro graphics and gameplay with modern resolutions and audio bitrate.  A variety of classic obstacles Conquer every realistic obstacle the game has to offer Slopes Bumps Hills Sand Water Gravel Rebounds Fine-tuned physics The physics have been carefully crafted to bring you a fair but challenging experience.
row.short_description: Relive the era of Flash mini-golf games on more than 54 holes based on real courses! And do it... for The Joy of Putting!

row.name: Operation: Outbreak
row.detailed_description: ❗Important Notice❗ This is a short 10–20 minute game, developed solo in a few weeks as a student exam project for a game development course. Due to budget limitations, AI was used for the voice-over. Please keep this in mind when playing and reviewing! Have fun! After your squad’s vehicle is destroyed during a routine patrol in the war-torn streets of Karzekistan , you wake up as the sole survivor. As Nomad , you must navigate a city overrun by the undead to reach the extraction point on the far side. Comms are down, but through the radio, Sentinel , your squad’s coordinator, guides you toward survival: the city is crawling with fast, relentless zombies, and the only safe passage may be through the dark, narrow underground tunnels. Equipped with only a pistol, you’ll face tense, survival-focused combat. Resources are scarce. Ammunition, healing items, and night vision are limited, making every shot and every decision crucial. Encountering large hordes of the undead can quickly turn fatal, forcing you to think strategically as you push forward through the decaying urban landscape. The environment is cinematic and immersive: derelict buildings, abandoned streets, and flickering lights set the stage for relentless suspense. The tunnels below are tight, dark, and suffocating, while the city above teems with threats, culminating in a final, desperate push across a zombie-infested bridge to reach the landing zone where your extraction awaits. Built in Unreal Engine 5 , this short but intense 10–20 minute FPS horror experience blends adrenaline-pumping action with survival horror, delivering a cinematic journey through a city teetering on the edge of chaos. Originally developed as a final exam project by DREADMITH Games , this game challenges your nerves, precision, and tactical thinking. Will you survive, or become another victim of the outbreak in Karzekistan?
row.short_description: Your squad's vehicle exploded during a patrol, and you're the only survivor. The enemy is unusual this time. A virus has turned the city into a warzone of the undead. Get to the exfil in time or die trying. A free-to-play short and intense FPS zombie survival horror game.
row.notes: The game contains fictional zombie violence, including shooting enemies and blood and gore visual effects. There is no sexual content or other sensitive themes.

row.name: 勇者之灾 Calamity from the Yongzhe
row.detailed_description: This is a unique experimental RPG game built upon a fantastical imaginary worldview. This work is created based on an imaginary worldview, where all characters, plots, locations, and events are purely fictional. Any coincidences are purely accidental. At the core of this game lies an epic adventure story filled with both laughter and tears, narrating the roller-coaster experiences between the king who unified the world and the brave team that sets out to defeat the king. The entire game consists of ten chapters, cleverly incorporating numerous internet meme-inspired plots. Although limited production costs may result in some minor bugs, the game's overall unique style and rich gameplay are sure to offer players a distinctive gaming experience. Detailed Introduction: In the year 572 of the New Calendar, a human hero slew the Demon King. In the year 653 of the New Calendar, the Demon King resurrected, and the brave warriors and adventurers jointly defeated him, an event known as the 'Calamity of the Demon King.' In the year 673 of the New Calendar, the world was unified, marking the first time in recorded human history that such an achievement was made. Eventually, that adventurer became the king of all humanity. In the year 715 of the New Calendar, a young brave warrior emerged, embarking on a journey of destiny... In this world plagued by monsters and villains, players can assume the role of the king who unified the world, governing with authority and leading the people; or they can transform into members of the brave team set out to defeat the king, using their courage to defeat villains and help others. During the adventure, players will gradually uncover the hidden sorrows and truths behind this absurd world, ultimately facing the final boss and ushering in a happy and fulfilling ending. The game features a wide variety of meticulously designed scenes. ranging from bustling towns to eerie caves, from mysterious forests to treacherous mountains, each filled with exploration opportunities. Additionally, the game is equipped with a diverse range of special items and skills, allowing players to flexibly combine and utilize them according to different combat scenarios and enemy characteristics, formulating their own exclusive combat strategies. The game boasts a rich and diverse array of gameplay mechanics and unique systems. Among them, the item crafting system provides players with in-depth exploration and creative enjoyment. Players can collect various basic materials throughout the game world and, through careful research of crafting recipes, skillfully combine these materials to create powerful weapons, armor, and items with special effects. These self-made items not only play a crucial role in combat, helping players defeat formidable enemies, but also satisfy players' pursuit of personalized equipment, making each character unique. In terms of combat, the game adopts a real-time turn-based combat mode that relies on speed bars. In combat scenarios, each character and enemy possesses an independent speed bar, with the filling speed determined by the character's own speed attribute. When a speed bar is filled, the character can take action, with the order of actions arranged according to the completion sequence of the speed bars. This combat mode retains the strategic nature of turn-based combat, requiring players to carefully consider each move and plan skill releases and attack targets reasonably; at the same time, it incorporates the tension of real-time elements, with the dynamic changes of the speed bars constantly tugging at players' heartstrings, demanding quick decision-making at critical moments to grasp the rhythm of combat. Characters with high speed can attack more frequently, seizing the initiative in combat, while those with slow speed must rely on powerful skills or defensive abilities to turn the tide in limited action opportunities. And the name of this tale is 'Calamity from the Yongzhe.'   In addition, the game may contain content that is uncomfortable for some, such as adult themes and graphic violence. Players are advised to choose to play the game with caution based on their own levels of acceptance. The game is still under development and is completely free. Thank you all for playing.
row.short_description: This is an experimental RPG game. The work tells an adventure story set in a fictional world, revolving around the conflict and journey between the King who unified the world and a brave team of Yongzhe(Hero) on a quest to overthrow him. It's a grand adventure filled with both laughter and tears.

row.name: Операция "Гость"
row.detailed_description: Get ready for an exciting adventure set against the backdrop of what seems to be an ordinary Russian small town at the end of the 1990s. You are a young student returning home for the holidays, seeking peace and quiet. But your expectations shatter when a terrorist group invades the area, prompting a counter-terrorism operation. What begins as a local conflict quickly escalates into something much more sinister. You find yourself in the center of a conspiracy, confronting soldiers, gangsters, ruthless terrorists, and supernatural forces. As the plot develops, the boundaries between reality and the supernatural become dangerously blurred, revealing shocking secrets from the past and present. Will you be able to save your home and uncover the dark secrets it hides? KEY FEATURES Original storyline An open-world location covering 16 km², including the main character’s town and the surrounding villages Travel around the location on foot, skateboard, vehicle, or watercraft Secrets and Easter eggs A storyline mission system in the style of GTA, where the main character completes tasks for local residents Side activities Combat against various enemies using hand-to-hand combat and firearms The ability to use substances that alter consciousness
row.short_description: Operation Guest is an action-adventure game set in Russia in the late 1990s. Explore an open world, complete tasks from local residents, battle enemies, find secrets and uncover a terrifying conspiracy as you embark on an exciting journey.
row.notes: The game may contain scenes of violence and alcohol/drug use.

row.name: Hidden Cats vs Zombies 2
row.detailed_description: Help save the kitties from the zombie apocalypse!!! huge map 100 objects to find (cats and zombies) 10 special objects (milk bottles) Hint system Progress saving Progress reset Hand-drawn graphics Hidden Cats VS Zombies is a hidden object game – the player's task is to find cats hidden on the map and eliminate the zombies. The game is designed in a zombie apocalypse style, but with a touch of humor. Due to contamination, an epidemic has broken out – zombies have taken over the entire military base and are wreaking havoc. You are the last survivor, once a member of an elite cat sniper unit. The cat army has dropped ammunition supplies – these can be found in wooden crates. Your mission is to eliminate all the zombies and rescue the cats. Go, cat soldier! Meow!
row.short_description: Hidden Cats VS Zombies is a hidden object game – the player's task is to find cats hidden on the map and eliminate the zombies. The game is designed in a zombie apocalypse style, but with a touch of humor.

row.name: The Silence After
row.detailed_description: **A student team project designed to deliver a ~10 minute experience. The Silence After is a first-person atmospheric horror experience where you step into the role of a survivor wandering through the ruins of a world swallowed by stillness. Drawn forward by a faint and intermittent distress signal, you must navigate an apocalyptic landscape using only touch, intuition, and your rare synesthetic ability, transforming sound into shifting colors that paint brief, fragile shapes in the darkness. Your surroundings are never fully visible. Instead, the world reveals itself through echoes: the creak of distant metal, the impact of broken glass, the crunch of debris beneath your feet. Each sound becomes a splash of color, outlining paths, obstacles, and hidden dangers. But in the suffocating quiet, you are not alone . Twisted monsters roam the world; guided not by sight but by instinct and sound. To survive, you must stay quiet, stay low, and use your synesthesia to detect threats before they detect you. Avoid them by slipping through tight spaces, timing your movements, or using environmental noises to misdirect their attention. Every encounter is a test of nerve and awareness; make one wrong sound, and the silence will continue forever. As you follow the mysterious distress signal, you’ll uncover fragments of what happened to the world, who sent the call for help, and what truly waits at the end of your journey.
row.short_description: The Silence After is a first-person atmospheric horror game where you play as a blind sole survivor following a distress signal through an apocalyptic reality, interacting with the environment and using your synesthetic ability to perceive sound as color to progress and avoid death.

row.name: Grenzgänger - Aus der DDR in den Westen
row.detailed_description: [Only available in German!] 'Grenzgänger – Von der DDR in den Westen' tells the story of three different protagonists who try to shape their lives in East Germany according to their own needs. They encounter all kinds of obstacles and puzzles along the way, and they need your help! Immerse yourself in Jena's punk scene, experience the city from the perspective of a young school graduate, and seek help for your sick daughter. Run or Stay? Art style: A vibrant game world full of dynamic, expressive, and colorful characters awaits you. Three protagonists: Assel, Hanna, and Micha offer you three different perspectives on life in the GDR. Historically inspired: There are many interesting stories from the GDR, some of which served as inspiration for the game's three protagonists. Each chapter offers a unique insight into life in the GDR. Stress management: Even the right decision can cause stress, and this is also true for the characters in Grenzgänger. Excessive stress can influence the twists and turns in the game and should therefore be reduced through the targeted use of items. Twists and turns: Not everything in life is predictable, and in Grenzgänger, too, chance determines the course of the story. Fully voiced: The game has been completely dubbed by professional voice actors.
row.short_description: Jena, GDR. Assel, Michael, and Hanna live in the same neighbourhood and fight against state surveillance. Can they bring about the necessary changes, or will they have to flee? Help them find their way! [Only available in German!]

row.name: Janky Golf with Stream
row.detailed_description: Janky Golf with Stream turns mini golf into a fully interactive Twitch experience. Streamers can host games where viewers take control of the ball using chat commands like !rot, !aim, and !hit, or use the Twitch extension for drag and click aiming. Players can design their own maps and share their creations! Set up rotations for automated, unattended play sessions. It’s lighthearted, unpredictable, and designed for laughs. The physics aren’t perfect, but they are free! Features: Twitch integrated viewer controls (!rot, !aim, !hit). Optional Twitch extension with mouse based aiming. Custom map creation. Auto rotation for unattended streams. Completely free to play (Twitch account required to host or join).
row.short_description: A chaotic Twitch integrated mini golf game where your viewers control the shots. Design maps while Twitch chat aims, rotates, and swings using commands or the interactive extension.

row.name: Astro Party EX
row.detailed_description: Astro Party EX is a chaotic local multiplayer space brawler. Blast enemy ships, run over pilots, and laugh while you do it. The twist? Ships can only turn right. (whaaaaa?) Up to 4 players Two-button controls Fully destructible arenas Stylish pixel art & music
row.short_description: Astro Party EX is a chaotic local multiplayer space brawler. Blast enemy ships, run over pilots, and laugh while you do it. The twist? Ships can only turn right. (whaaaaa?)

row.name: Hivefront TD
row.detailed_description: Pick a side to fight for—Ants or Bees—and defend your colony against the other! Collect your insect army and use it to defend the hive in an awesome tower defense adventure, brought to life with hand-drawn visuals. With several interesting tower combinations and over 22 towers to choose from, enjoy endless gameplay in a unique hand-drawn art style with Hivefront TD! 22+ Powerful Ant and Bee Towers! Each with two strong upgrade paths where you can always see the upgrades you bought. Play Anywhere! Single player offline works even when your WiFi doesn’t! 6 Hand Drawn Maps! With more planned to be added in the future. ********* Super Ant Studio Notes We are a team of two developers that, frankly, should be studying for finals, but we felt like making a game instead. We really think that everyone who is willing to give our game a shot is CERTIFIED AWESOME. Feel free to drop in our Discord server and say hi, or recommend new content! You can also contact us via email if you want to reach out. Hivefront TD contains in-game DLC that can be purchased with real money. Your purchases fund our development updates and new games. SERIOUSLY. Right now we are broke college students. Every vote of confidence you give us encourages us to keep going and make our game better than it ever has been. Super Ant Studio Community We love hearing from our players, so please get in touch with us whether it be on Discord, Email, or on social media with any feedback—positive or negative. Now the hive is not going to defend itself… Put together your team of ants or bees and make sure nothing gets past!
row.short_description: Collect your insect army and defend the hive as either Ants or Bees in this awesome tower defense adventure, brought to life with a hand-drawn art style!

row.name: Ascendancy
row.detailed_description: Watch a hundred AI-controlled characters, each with randomized stats, drop into a chaotic, obstacle-filled arena in an intense simulation. Scavenge weapons, armor, and loot scattered across the map while observing thrilling battles unfold in real time. Players can choose to control any AI character they find most promising and try to survive until only one remains. Features: Dynamic AI battles with 100 characters, each behaving differently based on stats and equipment Procedurally generated loot scattered throughout the arena Multiple obstacles and environmental hazards to navigate strategically Full player control of a chosen AI character, allowing skillful play to influence the outcome High replayability: each match offers unique scenarios, outcomes, and strategies Spectator-style simulation mode to watch the AI fight it out
row.short_description: Watch a hundred AI-controlled characters, each with randomized stats, drop into a chaotic, obstacle-filled arena in an intense simulation. Scavenge weapons, armor, and loot scattered across the map while observing thrilling battles unfold in real time. only one can remains.

row.name: Where We Went
row.detailed_description: In Where We Wen t you venture through an ancient tomb and solve puzzles by commanding its 3 guardians. Throughout your journey you uncover the reason of your visit to this ancient tomb while steadily puzzling your way to this conclusion. Enter the tomb. An unnatural feeling washes over you to go visit this tomb, arriving there you question what it is even meant for. A strange fog, giant crystals and illegible runes cover these ancient halls. Traversing deeper, you find ancient guardians that help you complete the puzzles and challenges you come across. Meet the Guardians. Utilize the special abilities of all these ancient guardians like the heat-conducting properties and crushing weight of the Metal Beetle, the Slippery trail secretion of the Oil Owl and the light re-directing ability of the Crystal Bat. Command their movements by recording your own at a Recording Plate, then let them all play out at once in amazingly satisfying conclusions.
row.short_description: Where We Went is a narrative driven puzzle game. Step into the role of a mysterious character that can control ancient guardians to solve puzzles. Uncover the story behind your visit to the tomb and the reason for its existence!

row.name: Chronomaze: Gravity Maze
row.detailed_description: YOU DO NOT CONTROL THE HERO. YOU CONTROL THE UNIVERSE. Welcome to Chronomaze: Gravity Maze , a study in minimalist precision where the only thing you can influence is the laws of physics themselves. In most games, you move the character. Here, the character is helpless—a particle at the mercy of momentum. Your only tool is gravity. Change its direction to navigate tight corridors, build lethal velocity, and solve intricate physics puzzles before the clock runs out. THE EXPERIENCE Chronomaze is not about luck; it is about flow. Clinical Aesthetics: A high-contrast 'Glow' visual style designed for pure clarity. No visual noise. Just the maze and the goal. Curated Challenges: 8 hand-crafted levels that escalate from simple navigation to complex, reflex-heavy puzzles. Zero filler content. Immersive Soundscape: A hypnotic soundtrack and responsive sound design built to keep you in the 'zone.' Respect for Your Time: No loading screens, no ads, no bloat.Pure focus. CONTROLS Simple to learn. Difficult to master. Arrow Keys: Shift Gravity (Up, Down, Left, Right) DESIGN PHILOSOPHY 'The concept is simple. The execution is everything.' Chronomaze is the debut release from Gift Bytes Productions . We built this game as a reaction against modern gaming bloat. We stripped away the microtransactions, the daily logins, and the noise to leave only what matters: A clean, honest, and challenging physics experience. Whether you have 5 minutes or an hour, the maze is waiting.
row.short_description: Control gravity, not the player, in Chronomaze: Gravity Maze—a 2D minimalist physics puzzler. Can you navigate 8 challenging, high-speed levels to beat the clock? A stylish, free game with a hypnotic soundtrack and a high-score chase.

row.name: Recyclamation
row.detailed_description: About this game Recyclamation  was lovingly crafted in ten weeks by a small team as part of Threeclipse's Junior Program — an initiative created for recent graduates and individuals wanting to pivot into the gaming industry. It's the first project & portfolio piece for most of the cohort's developers! Obey and recycle You play as Unit 481202, a mindwiped drone put to work in a reclamation facility.  You must identify recyclable items by sight or with devices and place them in the correct chutes.  You must keep the various stores above a critical level, lest you be sent back for further “retraining”. Reclaim your memories As you perform your task, some items you find trigger suppressed memories.  You begin to recall who you are, where you are, and what lies beyond the facility’s walls.  A friend’s cause A strange creature claiming to be a friend from your past asks you to secretly acquire specific items to aid in their cause.  It’s up to you whether or not to help... but if you do, don’t get caught by the Supervisor!
row.short_description: Recyclamation is a gritty sci-fi job simulator. The victim of a mind-wiping process, you sort trash as you regain your lost memories and uncover the truth of who you are and the world around you. Will you learn who you were and how you came here, or will you continue your life as a mindless drone?

row.name: 攻城.三国.志

row.name: 梅计划MeiErWo Plan
row.detailed_description: Steam Game English Description At the start of the game, you can choose one of 6 gameplay systems. All systems share the same save file, items, and various bonuses. Note: The numbering of game systems is irrelevant to their unlock order. Special thanks to the game that inspired this project: Melvor Idle.However, we are two distinct games. 1. Lumber System Keywords: Logging, Fire-MakingA classic idle game opening.Gameplay:Select a plot to chop down trees and gain proficiency. Each plot has multiple types of trees, yielding corresponding wood.There are a series of wood processing processes, such as using it as fuel for combustion. 2. Mining & City System Keywords: Mining, CityA Monopoly-style idle gameplay.Gameplay:Roll dice to move on a circular goods between different cities for gold coins and discover mineral veins.There’s also an interdimensional pocket base city that can be developed. 3. Crafting System Keywords: Blueprints, AlchemyGameplay:Use your creativity to complete blueprint crafting.Research mysterious potion formulas.Fulfill corresponding orders. 4. Travel System Keywords: Combat, Exploration, ChallengeGameplay:Challenge dungeons, steal resources, and train yourself. 5. Profession System Keywords: UniqueGameplay:Unlock farming, animal husbandry, and fishing.Choose a specialized profession.Permanently alter part of the game’s rules.Content from other professions will not be restricted. 6. Summoning System Keywords: AnomaliesGameplay:Summon powers from beyond the world—forces even the developer cannot fully comprehend. 0. AFK System Some universal content falls under this system.Examples include the inventory and orders, which are used across multiple systems.
row.short_description: This is a highly freeform idle game centered around placement mechanics—no need to wait through long periods during gameplay. Each game node unlocks new content, and you can choose one of six gameplay systems to start with, all sharing a single save file Early access version does not support English

row.name: Dramons Warriors
row.detailed_description: Collect, click, and trade your way to the top! Get ready for an addictive experience that combines the thrill of clicker gameplay with the excitement of collecting. Discover unique characters and powerful Dramons as you progress with simple mouse clicks — every click brings you closer to rare rewards! Build your ultimate collection and show it off… or sell it on the Steam Market . Your creatures aren’t just collectibles — they’re valuable assets other players are hunting for. Key Features 🖱️ Clicker-style gameplay: Fun, simple, and perfect for playing at your own pace. 🧩 Character and Dramons collection: Find creatures with distinct styles, rarities, and personalities. 💰 Real trading system: Buy, sell, and trade through the Steam Market to expand your collection. Click, collect, and dominate the market. Become the ultimate Dramon collector!
row.short_description: A clicker game of collection and trading: gather Dramons, expand your lineup, and profit on the Steam Market.

row.name: Medieval Merchant
row.detailed_description: Medieval Merchant is a medieval game of commerce and trade where small villages depend on you to grow. Buy and sell goods, supply towns with what they lack, and watch them develop and thrive. Use the supply-demand based economy to your advantage to build your own prosperity and make a profit in the process. Key features Town growth through trade Each town has its own resources, production chains, shortages and demands. Supplying what they need unlocks upgrades, new goods and lets you tap into higher-value markets. Build your trade network over time by developing more and more towns. A dynamic economy system Prices in the supply-demand based economy fluctuate with shifting world conditions. Temporary events, regional trends and other economic pressures can raise or lower the value of your goods, creating new opportunities or disrupting established routes. Plan your journeys, adapt to changing circumstances and take advantage of openings in the market. Upgradable Caravan and Retinue Grow your caravan as you travel and trade. Improve carrying capacity, speed and efficiency, and recruit specialists who add bonuses to your journeys. A stronger retinue lets you take on longer routes, handle more goods and adapt to the challenges of a growing trade network.
row.short_description: Guide a caravan through scattered medieval villages, supply them with goods, help them prosper ... and profit yourself as much as you can.

row.name: I Sell Lemonade: Prologue
row.detailed_description: I Sell Lemonade — Prologue A summer without screens. A sidewalk. A kid with a sign. You’re 10 years old. It’s the 1980s. Your dad just sold your console, and your mom told you to go outside and “do something useful.” So you grab a pitcher, a few cups, and start selling lemonade on the curb. Not to get rich. But because it’s the only thing that feels like yours. What begins as a way to pass time becomes a summer-long journey through childhood, friendship, and quiet bravery. You’ll mix drinks, charm neighbors, and slowly figure out how to stand your ground — with a paper sign and a plastic cup. But this isn’t just about profit. It’s about: Facing the local basketball king for a boombox and respect. Earning your way into the underground RC car races. Learning how to talk to the girl next door. Learning how to talk to your dad. Every day brings new choices. Sometimes you win. Sometimes you spill the lemonade. But with each cup sold, you grow a little. Prologue note This is a limited game showcasing an early slice of the game. Some locations, quests, characters, and features are unavailable here and will appear in the full version. Content, balance, and progression may change; saves from the Prologue may not carry over.
row.short_description: You’re the boss of the block. Sell lemonade, make cash, get a bike, impress the girls — and live the summer you’ll never forget.

row.name: Fall Asleep
row.detailed_description: Game Overview – Fall Asleep Fall Asleep is a tense first-person climbing game where you’re trapped inside a nightmare and the only way out is up. With limited sight from your flashlight, platforms materialize just a few steps ahead, leaving you blind to the greater path and forcing you to trust your instincts. Every jump elevates you closer to escaping the dream. . . or further into the void. The nightmare unfolds across three haunting levels : Village Neighborhood Island Dev Tips:   Press  F   to access your Flashlight and hold shift to Sprint and make those hard-to-reach jumps. Fall Asleep makes every step a gamble. There are no checkpoints. No saves. Reaching your bed is the only way to wake yourself from the nightmare. Do you have what it takes to escape?
row.short_description: Fall Asleep is a tense first-person climbing game where you’re trapped in a nightmare and the only way out is up. See only the platforms in front of you, make every jump count, and try to escape before the dream swallows you whole.

row.name: Herofrenia Infinite Hyperdeath
row.detailed_description: Herofrenia Infinite HyperDeath is a top down shooter in the universe of the multimedia RPG Herofrenia! Follow the path of violence anda discovery of Murasakibara Nakamoto, on his way to find out the truth behind the man behind the mask! This game contains violence with multiple weapons and sugestive violent acts. With an intense gameplay focused on killing the most enemies in the time set, the game benefits agressive playstyle, counting with 8 levels and a variety of enemies! The more blood around you the slower things become!
row.short_description: Herofrenia Infinite Hyperdeath é um jogo top down shooter do universo do RPG multimidia Herofrenia! Conte com um arsenal variado de armas para compor seu arsenal em um estilo de jogo frenético com movimentação veloz, dash e mortes frequentes! Quanto mais sangue as coisas ficam mais lentas ao redor

row.name: In Bloom: Prologue
row.detailed_description: In Bloom: Prologue is a free version of In Bloom . Experience the core gameplay and get a taste of the experience that awaits in the full game. Drawing inspiration from masterpieces such as The Last of Us and Amnesia, In Bloom is a survival-horror game. You play as a farmer waking up, abandoned by his family and unfamiliar with his surroundings. All you can see around you is that what once was owned by man has now been retaken by nature. Your only hope of survival is following the instructions of a mysterious stranger whose voice you hear over a radio, instructing you to go to Save Haven base and join the rest of the survivors. Will you survive? Will you manage to fight your way through? Or will you allow nature to overtake you as well? PROLOGUE FEATURES: 3 areas dark ambience SFX voice-overs with subtitles gun and enemies In Bloom is a collaboration project made by Swedish and Polish students of Futuregames, completed in seven weeks of development. It is made for an audience that enjoys horror elements as well as puzzles and survival when playing their games. Blood, sweat and tears have been put into this project, and we hope that anyone who is about to experience it enjoys it as much as we enjoyed making it.
row.short_description: In Bloom is a survival-horror game where you awaken alone in a world overtaken by nature. Guided by a mysterious voice on a radio, you must solve puzzles, survive the dangers around you, and reach Safe Haven before the wilderness consumes you.
row.notes: There is a gun in the game; you shoot enemies, and instead of blood, flowers and vines appear.

row.name: How To Bike
row.detailed_description: Do you know how you actually keep your balance on a bike? Most people don’t. You do it with small, deliberate, but unconscious steering movements. So prepare to learn how to ride a bike again, only this time doing it consciously. Get ready for the most relaxing experience of your life, as this small calm (absolutely not enraging in any way) cycling game is featuring: 1 frame, 1 fork, 2 wheels 0 training wheels, no fall protection or automatic balance a realistic simulation of bike physics and movement  1 custom map to explore around 15 minutes to many hours of playtime, if you're stubborn enough save and load game functionality  relaxing music
row.short_description: Ride a bike the hard way - the REAL way!

row.name: Murmurs of the Mist
row.detailed_description: Murmurs of the Mist  is a short psychological horror story where you play as Bunni , the stuffed toy of a 7-year-old girl, Sofia. She struggles to speak about what happened to her but in therapy, Sofia speaks through you, the only one she trusts.  As Bunni, you explore the mysterious landscape of Sofia’s psyche, where her innocence, fear and childish state of mind blur together. What you see , hear , and touch slowly reveals the dreadful truth. This 20–30 minute experience invites you into a quiet descent through memory, trauma, and the first steps of healing. A short unraveling of a story that is waiting to be heard. PHOTOSENSITIVITY/EPILEPSY SEIZURES READ THIS NOTICE BEFORE PLAYING This game contains flashing lights or light patterns that may be harmful for certain individuals. If you have an epileptic condition or have had any kind of seizure, consult your physician before playing any video game. Immediately discontinue use and consult physician if you experience any of the following symptoms: dizziness, altered vision, eye or muscle twitching, involuntary movements, loss of awareness, disorientation, or convulsions.  TRIGGER WARNING  Murmurs of the Mist touches upon highly sensitive subjects involving child abuse, please absent from playing the game if you may find such themes triggering.
row.short_description: In this game, you’ll encounter puzzles which require you to use your environment in order to solve them. Take note of every detail, they can help you in uncovering Sofia’s story.
row.notes: TRIGGER WARNING Murmurs of the Mist touches upon highly sensitive subjects involving suicide, insinuated sexual assault and abuse towards minors. Please absent from playing the game if you may find such themes triggering.

row.name: The Maze: L'ultimo soldato
row.detailed_description: Your nation is on its knees, the war nearly lost. The weapon that guaranteed your superiority, a strategic supercomputer, is dark. The only power source capable of reactivating it lies in a Maze in the middle of the ocean. You have one task: restore power to your nation. You must find and reactivate 8 generators. They told you the mission is vital. They told you you're the best. But no one told you why those who came before you never returned. Soldiers. Scientists. Entire teams sent before you, swallowed by the silence. Their last communications were only screams and static. Now you are there, and the silence is deafening. But you are not alone. Don't turn around. Don't listen to the noises in the corridors. Every step echoes. Every generator you activate makes a sound that draws unwanted attention. Something is hunting you in the darkness. It's not a soldier. It's not an enemy you can understand or fight. It is the embodiment of this place. As you try to survive, you will find the traces of those who died before you. You will find their notes, their desperate logs. You will discover the truth your superiors hid from you. Your mission is clear. Your fate is not. Be quick. Do it, before the Maze takes you too.
row.short_description: You have been chosen to descend into the abyss. No one told you why those before you never returned. Do not turn back. Do not listen to the noises in the corridors. You have one task: restore power to your nation before the Maze takes you. The mission is clear. Your fate is not.

row.name: Los Pilarcitos
row.detailed_description: Los Pilarcitos is a third-person game where the player must complete search missions and help other characters in the city. From a third-person perspective, the player can move, fight in melee combat, and drive vehicles.
row.short_description: Los Pilarcitos is a third-person game where the player must complete search missions and help other characters in the city. From a third-person perspective, the player can move, fight in melee combat, and drive vehicles.

row.name: Foreign Orc
row.detailed_description: Learn a new language by whacking assassins! Every enemy displays a foreign word — but only one matches the correct target. Identify the right assassin, strike fast, and level up your fluency through gameplay instead of flashcards. 🗡️ Gameplay Overview You play as an Orc mercenary hired to eliminate rogue assassins. There’s just one twist: ✔ Every enemy is labeled with a foreign-language word ✔ Your target word appears at the bottom of the screen ✔ You must read, recognize, and react before time runs out 🌎 Learn While You Play - 4 Languages : Russian, Spanish, French, English (more planned) - Difficulty Tiers : A1 → B2 word banks based on CEFR levels -  Categories : Verbs & Food (More soon) -  Adaptive Tracking : Words you fail appear more often next run Reach out and give feedback if you run into any vocabular errors, bugs, or glitches . I appreciate it! Keep in mind, this is for beginners. It might be quiet easy if you already know a thing or two. Though, I still you hope have fun.
row.short_description: Learn a language while whacking rogues in a foreign land! Read, decide, and strike before time runs out. Improve your vocabulary through gameplay instead of flashcards and choose between multiple languages and categories.

row.name: Dice In You
row.detailed_description: Dice In You is a roguelike deck builder that uses dice. Synopsis You wake up in an unfamiliar room and realize you’re trapped in a sealed space with a mysterious girl. The only way to escape is to operate the device in front of you and clear the game. Dice Fusion At the end of each round, you can obtain dice with special abilities. Newly acquired dice can be fused with one of your existing dice to create your own powerful custom die. The Girl’s Emotions The girl’s emotions change depending on how you play. Her shifting feelings may end up helping you. Reach the end together with the girl— and ESCAPE .
row.short_description: A roguelike deck builder with dice. Fuse dice to create your own powerful custom dice, and aim for even higher scores!
