row.name: Обо: Шоу Теней
row.detailed_description: Андрей - четырнадцатилетний мальчик, переехавший с родителями из бурятской деревни в Москву. Прошло три года, но город так и не стал для него домом. Прошлое тянет его обратно - к Байкалу, к детству и манящим огням на воде. В поисках друзей, себя и правды Андрей всё глубже погружается в шоу теней. Незаметно для себя он становится частью сценария — где роли распределены задолго до выхода на сцену. Зритель он - или марионетка? Какие выборы откроют путь к истине, а какие затянут на дно самого глубокого озера в мире? И если шоу понравится... можно ли аплодировать мёртвым ? 🎭  Обо: Шоу теней  - мистическая визуальная новелла о взрослении, доверии и правде, которая может утопить, если заглянешь слишком глубоко. ✨  В игре: Атмосфера Байкала и северной мистики История взросления и выбора, который перепишет финал Авторские тексты и визуальный стиль Полностью на русском языке
row.short_description: Байкал зовёт. Прошлое возвращается в форме теней, и Андрей должен решить - играть по чужим правилам или переписать сценарий судьбы.
row.notes: The game contains psychological themes, stylized blood, scenes of tension, and disturbing imagery. No explicit sexual content is present. The story touches on topics such as emotional stress, manipulation, and dark atmospheric elements. Sensitive themes are presented in a narrative, non-graphic way.

row.name: Seoul Bridge
row.detailed_description: As you cross the Seoul Bridge, you begin to witness subtle and unexplainable changes in your surroundings. If any element around you—signs, vehicles, structures, or people—appears different from usual, You must immediately turn back. If no abnormalities are detected, Continue forward and cross the bridge to the end. Seoul Bridge is a short driving simulator inspired by Exit 8, the Han River, driving experiences, and the Backrooms.
row.short_description: You are trapped on the Seoul Bridge. Whether you move toward the exit or return to the entrance, you remain trapped on the Seoul Bridge. Observe your surroundings carefully and find a way to escape.

row.name: Eternal Core
row.detailed_description: Eternal Core is an action platformer in which you control ROB , a robot created by a group of rebels with the goal of destroying the Tower that’s draining the planet’s life. You’ll have to fight your way through enemies to advance and reach the top, encountering Bosses along the way who are far more powerful than the rest, each with unique abilities. Use your powerful fists to take down enemies and your dash to tackle and dodge your opponents. Remember that your abilities consume energy— it will recharge over time, but if you run out completely, you’ll be left defenseless. However, you can fully recover it along with your health by collecting the crystals scattered throughout the level. Survive until you find them. Meet your enemies: the grounded maintenance bots and the flying hunters scattered across the levels. Turn them into scrap.
row.short_description: Eternal Core is an action platformer in which you control ROB, a robot created with the goal of destroying the Tower that’s draining the planet’s life. You’ll have to fight enemies to advance and reach the top, encountering powerful Bosses along the way.

row.name: Night School
row.detailed_description: Night School is an educational RPG where a player answers questions to level up and take on bosses. In Night school a player explores a haunted school at night and answers educational trivia questions to level up and take on several bosses. The boss fights play out similarly to old school Final Fantasy. There are also mini games that a player can play to get bounces items. The School can be explored from a top down perspective.
row.short_description: Night School is an Educational RPG which features trivia as well as Final fantasy style boss fights.

row.name: EvoSprout
row.detailed_description: In EvoSprout , you can plant , grow , and harvest different fruits and vegetables. You can try combining them and cross-breeding their genetics to get even better yields. Level up, get more insight into the genetics of your produce, and see if you can claim the trophy ! Full Disclaimer: This game is just a private, game development side project I wanted to share with the world. Do not expect any future updates or support beyond critical fixes. Please feel free to share your opinions and suggestions.
row.short_description: EvoSprout is a casual, stress-free, small-scale farming simulator in a cozy low-poly environment. Manage your character's private garden-farm from a top-down perspective: Buy crops and upgrades, plant and harvest from your plots, and use your different stations to process and analyse your yield.

row.name: Pocket Lint zero
row.detailed_description: A deceptively hard little game of deduction. I’ve emptied my pockets onto the table, and I’m now thinking of a specific combination of those items. Can you guess it in as few guesses as possible? How it plays Each guess you make, information will be revealed about what you got right. By combining divide-and-conquer, with process-of-elimination, you should be able to quickly figure out the answer. Each round, you'll get a new selection of items to play with and a new colour palette to keep things interesting. What's included? This version contains the first 5 levels from the campaign of Pocket Lint, so you can try it for free!
row.short_description: Play for free! A deceptively hard little game of deduction. I’m now thinking of a specific combination of pocket items. If I give you hints about what you’ve got wrong, can you guess it in as few guesses as possible?

row.name: The Eternal Mines
row.detailed_description: Experience a world were others do all the work for you. Use your minions, varied and plentiful, to excavate through the mines. Thanks to the Powerful Bevy engine, witness hundreds of autonomous agents all at once! Journey deeper and into the mines. Unlock different upgrades along the way See multiple areas See some witty dialog
row.short_description: Upgrade your minions as you journey deeper into the mines. Explore different areas. Witness tens of miners at once.

row.name: The December Job
row.detailed_description: You've been good, You know you've been good. But for years the only thing you've had waiting under the tree is a lump of coal, black coal. You've had enough. You've tracked down this supposedly jolly man and his unsettling workshop. It's time to take back what is rightfully yours! Key Features PSX-Era deign : Low poly models with the clunkyness to match Santa: A hunter that hulks over you, he patrols his workshop and will give chase if he sees you Stealth : You must hide and use blindspots to your advantage Jumpscares : Don't get caught or you are in for a fright Now go get what you deserve.
row.short_description: The December Job is a short first-person horror stealth game built with that classic feel. Navigate a maze like workshop filled with dimly lit hallways and storage rooms as you attempt to collect a target number of deserved gifts.
row.notes: This game contains depictions of violence, including blood, gore and animal cruelty.

row.name: Escape Game: Camper 2
row.detailed_description: This is an escape game set inside a camper. Explore the interior, collect items, find hidden clues, and try to escape from the camper. This PC version is an upgraded redesign based on the original smartphone release. Graphics have been rebuilt in high resolution for a horizontal layout, and the UI and controls have been improved for PC play. Both auto-save and manual save are supported for a more comfortable experience. Features 🧩 Classic escape-game style (exploration, item collection, puzzle solving) 🌄 Clean and realistic visuals 🔍 Plenty of item-search elements 🔀 Multiple endings 😌 Relaxing and calm atmosphere 🖱️ Optimized for mouse controls 🌐 Supports 10 languages Play Time ⏱️ Approximately 20–40 minutes (varies by player)
row.short_description: An escape game set inside a camper trailer. Search for items, gather clues, solve puzzles, and find your way out in this short, casual experience.

row.name: Arena : Run And Hit
row.detailed_description: A 10-player battle unfolds on a rooftop. Enjoy the simple game of 'Arena: Run & Hit'—hitting and running away. How to play? After starting the game, wait for Steam to automatically log you in. Once logged in, you'll enter the lobby. In the lobby, create your character using the character customization system. Fight with others in a group or matching system. If you prefer a scoring system, select Competitive Survival Mode. How do I win? In Survival Mode, the last survivor wins. In Respawn Mode, the player with the most kills wins. How do I achieve good results? Strategically, mastering running and attack timing is crucial. All characters have identical hitboxes, so there's no disadvantage or advantage to using different characters. Participate in battles that are fair and equal. What are the control keys? By default, attack is with SPACE, and movement is with WASD (or the arrow keys). You can customize the controls by clicking the gear icon in the upper right corner of the lobby.
row.short_description: A 10-player rooftop battle. Enjoy the simple game of 'Arena: Run & Hit,' where you simply hit and run away. The last player standing among the 10 players wins. You can battle on the rooftops with friends through the group, or compete with others through the competition to determine rankings.

row.name: EXODUS2
row.detailed_description: EXODUS2 is a high-velocity movement-shooter following CPL CHAI on his vengeful assault against the Zephari homeworld after their failed invasion of Earth. Wall-run, slide, and blast yourself through the air with shotgun-powered knockback jumps as you carve a path across Planet Zephari. Trigger bullet time to reflect incoming fire, dodge lethal attacks, and reposition with style. Dismember enemies to disrupt their behavior and evolve their attack patterns as every fight turns into a dynamic, cinematic brawl. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: A high-velocity movement-shooter following CPL CHAI on his vengeful assault against the Zephari homeworld after their failed invasion of Earth.

row.name: Stereoscopy
row.detailed_description: The Ultimate Immersive Home Theater for Desktop and VR Step into your own private cinema where every movie feels larger than life. Stereoscopy plays ordinary video and 3D-formatted video files in an immersive 3D experience - whether you’re seated at your desk with classic anaglyph glasses or fully immersed inside a virtual reality headset. Stereoscopy isn’t just a player – it’s the private, jaw-dropping cinema you’ve always wanted. Turn any video into an unforgettable 3D spectacle, tonight. Overview Native playback up to 8K resolution with 4K texture sampling Real-time ray tracing, global illumination, dynamic shadows, volumetric fog, god-rays, particle streams and screen-space reflections Free roam and theater seating Eight powerful 3D modes: Anaglyph, Half/Full Side-By-Side → Anaglyph, Top-Bottom → Anaglyph, Half/Full Side-by-Side, Top-Bottom, and Standard 2D In VR: perfect left/right-eye separation for flawless stereoscopic 3D with zero crosstalk On desktop: real-time anaglyph rendering (red-cyan, amber-blue, green-magenta and more) Cinema-Quality Audio Supports up to 10.2-channel surround sound (including 7.2, 5.1, 2.1, stereo) Dolby, DTS and THX pass-through decoding Up to 192-bit depth for pristine clarity Audio modes: • Direct – faithful passthrough of the original audio tracks • World Spatial Audio – true 3D positional sound placed throughout the virtual theater with intelligent downmixing across low, mid and full-range virtual speakers A Living, Breathing Theater Walk, jump, sit or stand inside stunning virtual environments that react to your movie. Realtime Lighting and Volume level controls Projection screen and projector emit realistic light that spills into the room Auto-dim/restore theater lighting when you hit play or pause (fully configurable) Optional projector beam with visible particle rays and cinematic god-rays Seat beacons to help you find the perfect spot to watch – just walk in or teleport (VR) and your view instantly snaps to the screen Door beacons to exit the Theater - – just walk in or teleport (VR) to a door and you are prompted to exit Two beautifully detailed theaters included: an intimate Screening Room and a massive, atmospheric Army Warehouse Change your theater on the fly using the Theater Browser Designed for Comfort and Control Compatibility: Windows 11, desktop monitors, and OpenXR compatible XR/VR/AR headsets (with or without controllers) Partial input support: keyboard + mouse, gamepads, and VR motion controllers Intuitive Video Remote (desktop or VR) for play/pause, seek, restart, volume, 3D mode, audio mode and repeat Built-in file browser Theater selector Auto-Play resumes your last video exactly where you left off Auto-Repeat for endless loops
row.short_description: A virtual theater experience for Desktop PC with VR support - capable of playing Standard and 3D Video files. Supports Keyboard/Mouse, Gamepad, and XR Controllers.

row.name: Battington Manor
row.detailed_description: Do you have what it takes to defend the Battington Manor from the invading swarm of nefarious bats? Step right into this immersive guided VR experience and blast away! Evil bats have taken over the manor and locked up the Battington family. Equipped with a garlic bazooka and holy water blaster, you will explore the haunted halls, blasting evil bats along the way in this carnival-style arcade first-person shooter game. You will make it to the dungeon arena, where you must free the good bats from the cages and restore peace to the manor. Battington Manor is a solo project developed by Natasha Patel for the 2025 VR Haunted House Event at Ringling College of Art and Design. Suitable for users of all ages new to virtual reality.
row.short_description: Battington Manor is a kid-friendly VR first-person shooter guided experience where you will embark on a journey through haunted halls shooting evil bats with your holy water blaster and garlic bazooka to save the Battington family!

row.name: Soglia
row.detailed_description: Soglia explores the connection between video games and musical composition, investigating how interactivity can become a creative tool for music through the gamification of sound. The project consists of a video game that is almost entirely sound-based, in which visual elements are reduced to a minimum and the experience is guided by listening and spatial orientation. The gameplay is based on exploration and sound collection, allowing the player to interact with and modify the acoustic environment in real time, which evolves like a dynamic and immersive composition. Soglia attempts to describe the phenomenon of creativity and intuition that occurs within a dream. It seeks to answer a question: who is the one who creates and generates the idea? Is it us, or is it an “independent” creator that resides within our unconscious? In Soglia, the player embodies this creator and does everything possible to capture and organise the sound of the environment to generate the embryo of a composition.
row.short_description: 'Like all psychic life, creativity also comes from the unconscious. If you identify with the creative process, you end up believing that you are the creator.' Soglia is a game based entirely on sound. A dreamlike journey into our unconscious to discover where ideas are born.

row.name: Summer Delicious Simulator: Prologue
row.detailed_description: 🍦🌭  Summer Delicious Simulator The ultimate city street-food experience! Start your journey as a humble hotdog or ice cream vendor , roaming through the lively streets of a vibrant summer city. Earn money, upgrade your cart, and turn your small food stall into one of the city’s most popular hangout spots. During special events and crowded festival days , seize the opportunity serve faster, earn more, and rise above your competition. But you’re not alone in the city. Compete with other players and friends who run their own food carts in the same area. Use your strategy, timing, and upgrades to attract their customers and dominate the marketplace. Can you become the most famous street food master in town?
row.short_description: Start your career on the bustling city streets as an ice cream or hotdog vendor! Upgrade your cart, outsmart your rivals, and compete with friends to become the most popular seller in town!

row.name: BrownDogGames
row.detailed_description: BrownDogGames is a growing low-poly game universe packed into one cozy launcher. Jump between multiple bite-sized worlds—each with its own style, mechanics, and chaos. Whether you want to build, blast, defend, or duel, BrownDogGames is designed to be simple to hop into and fun to master. Explore a charming low-poly hub world where each game appears as its own themed island. Walk up, click in, and instantly drop into fast-paced mini-games or full standalone modes. More games are planned, and the world of BrownDogGames will continue to expand over time. 🐕 Features A cozy low-poly hub world with themed portals to each game A growing library of games bundled together Easy pick-up-and-play design Light-hearted visuals and simple controls Fun for casual players and short quick sessions Humor, personality, and an ever-present Brown Dog mascot Welcome to the dog-powered multiverse. 🐾 Pick a game. Jump in. Have fun.
row.short_description: A low-poly universe of mini-games! Build, blast, defend, and duel across multiple worlds—all inside the BrownDogGames hub.

row.name: 蛙爷的进化之路
row.detailed_description: You, a brave soul, unexpectedly travel to a challenging fantasy world and become possessed by a weak little frog. Creatures in this world can evolve by absorbing evolution cards and fusing them with Mona energy. On the path of evolution, you will face challenges from powerful enemies. Fortunately, you are a soul wearer with unlimited potential. With each evolution, your appearance changes, gradually evolving from a frog to a more advanced species. This world ranges from mysterious underground mazes to towering skyscrapers, and there are many unknown places waiting for you to explore. By collecting materials, synthesizing equipment, and improving skills, you can enhance your own strength. In the process of continuous growth, you will encounter dragon slaying warriors and evil dragons, who may become your friends or enemies. You can choose to explore alone or team up with other players to fight together. As a soul that has traveled through time, you have infinite possibilities, and every evolution will make you stronger and more unique. Please embark on an adventure, unveil the mystery of the fantasy world, and embrace unknown challenges!
row.short_description: This is a multiplayer online word game! By obtaining monster cards, characters who evolve by fusing monster cards will gain new appearances and skills. Experience different professions with different weapons and equipment. Continuously unlocking new systems through evolution.

row.name: Fight Poker
row.detailed_description: Fight Poker is a turn based PvP card game. You can play 1v1 online or offline, and it is a poker game. You play 5-7 rounds against an opponent, trying to form the best hand you can in 2 offense and 2 defense rows with help from the community cards. There is an online global play option, pass and play, and 5 difficulties of bot to fight against. It is great for any players who enjoy the strategy of poker itself, or want to try to manage cards and allocate them for differing hands with different needs.
row.short_description: Fight Poker is a turn based poker PvP card game. You try to form the best hand you can in 4 rows with help from the community cards. There is an online global play option, pass and play, and 5 difficulties of bot to fight against. It is great for any players who enjoy the strategy of poker itself

row.name: 黑白都市の隐秘恋曲
row.detailed_description: 游戏主要由剧情构成，如同视觉小说一般，其中含有多种剧情元素，多种不同结局选项的选择。 这些分布的剧情走向会像一颗大树一样，绝对的分支绝对的交错，最终的结局永远与玩家的选择有关。 游戏进程中会频繁出现对话应对，决定选择等分支选项，不同选择会导向不同剧情支线。玩家选择和不同角色同行，前往不同地点，都会触发专属事件。
row.short_description: 黑白都市的隐秘恋曲是一款风格独特的文字冒险游戏，讲述主角死后来到一座神秘城市，随后得知每人都有一次转世投胎的机会。但缺失的死亡记忆让他疑惑，在得到灵魂向导的帮助下，他来到档案馆大厦找到了属于自己的死亡记忆，但这份记忆也引出了他死亡的真相。亡灵的复仇、灵魂的转世，以及这黑白都市深渊里更可怕的真相...

row.name: Gemini Rush
row.detailed_description: Gemini Rush is a LAN racing game where each player controls a single-wheel vehicle on a circuit made up of two constantly parallel roads . The player has the ability to switch between the two using a skill. The vehicle is highly amenable and very fast . The Race The race is composed of 3 biomes (neutral, cave and fog) making the entourage beautiful and memorable ! The players drive on these roads in order to stay in first place. However all the players leave a trace behind them on the ground, a speed trail, that remains for 6s on which the other players can follow in order to gain a speed boost as long as they stay on it. There are many obstacles on both roads that the players need to avoid. If they hit them, they crash and respawn instantly where they were a few seconds earlier. The obstacles are different depending on which road is chosen, and it is important to learn your favorite path to save as much time as possible and go as fast as you can. Credits G uilhem  MAZOYER  - Technical Game Designer, Producer & UI/UX Designer J olan  PRAT  - Game Designer, Producer & Level Designer S oline  MAILLARD  - Gamer Designer & UI/UX Designer M argaux  SINET  - 3D Artist B aptiste  GARNIER  - 3D Artist I ris  DUBOIS VERGIAT  - Technical Game Designer X avier  NICOLLE - Developer C amille  TOURNEMOLLE - Sound Designer
row.short_description: Gemini Rush is a LAN racing game where each player controls a single-wheel vehicle on a circuit made up of two constantly parallel roads. The player has the ability to switch between the two using a skill. The vehicle is highly amenable and very fast.

row.name: Dollemma
row.detailed_description: Trapped within the recesses of never-ending dollhouses, up to four terrified surviving dolls will work together to escape from a maniacal doll breaker in a new twist on asymmetrical multiplayer horror.  Solve puzzles Each iteration of survival is through varying versions of dollhouses: Within an abandoned clock tower, the dolls will need to put their knowledge of mechanics to the test to find and fix the missing gears.  Stuck deep within a mysterious dungeon, the dolls need not fear the dark, lighting their way to fix and open a jammed drawbridge. Or, hidden away within a complicated, randomized maze, reminiscent of what could have once been a grand manor, the dolls will search each nook and cranny for keys to unlock their path out. Hunt down your friends Ever wish you could’ve played rough with your toys as a child? Well, now’s your chance to try. In Dollemma, you can play as a doll hunter, dolls that weren’t treated well when they were played with, and have decided to force the other, weaker dolls to join in with their pain.  With in-game proximity voice-chat, the survivor dolls can choose to communicate and work together to escape the doll hunter, but the doll hunter can also try to listen in and thwart their plans. As a painful indicator of the doll hunter’s treatment, anything it tries to say will come out unintelligible and terrifying. Collect items There are quite a few items the dolls can use to try and escape. The Needle and Thread allows dolls to heal themselves or each other by reattaching the limbs broken off by the hunter. Keys, cog wheels, levers and lighters can be used to complete the objective. But watch out: some items might be nefarious illusions created by the hunter to fool you! Most players can only carry two items at a time—and you have to be careful. If the hunter smashes one of your arms, you won’t be able to use it. If you lose both your arms, you won’t be able to carry items at all, and you’ll have to find someone who can heal you. Complete quests Every Doll is unique, with each one having their own special skills to learn and unlock. These skills can be unlocked with points earned through playing matches, or by completing quests.  Dollemma has a complete quest system, with varying levels of quests: One-time achievable accomplishments marking your Dollemma journey, or repeatable more focused on just currency-gaining challenges. Escape the dollhouse After the dolls find the keys, repair the clock tower, or obtain the lever for the drawbridge, the chase is on! The dolls will all have to make their way to the exit before the hunter can track them down and smash them apart. Features Four doll characters and one hunter character, each with unique skills and abilities. Three unique maps, each with their own themes and objectives. Two maps are handcrafted, and one changes randomly every time you play it. Minigames to draw the dolls’ focus away and give the hunter a chance to catch up. Dynamic music, which immersively changes intensity as the hunter approaches. Proximity-based voice chat, to hear your friends from a few rooms away. Computer-controlled bots that can take control if a player suddenly disconnects. Ball → While waiting for a match to begin in the pre-game waiting room, you may experience the most fun and engaging item the Dollemma team has been painstakingly developing for a long while: Ball. A new take on horror Dollemma aims to appeal to a wider audience with a cuter, more approachable art style. Most asymmetrical horror games lean heavily into darker themes, which some players may find unsettling. Dollemma’s unique creepy/cute aesthetic ensures a unique atmosphere and makes the genre of asymmetrical horror accessible to more players. Enter the dollhouse… Don’t wait! Dollemma is free to play. Invite your friends to explore these haunting environments and escape—before you get caught!
row.short_description: An asymmetrical multiplayer horror game with a unique appealing aesthetic. Join up to 4 friends and work together to escape the dollhouse! Or play as the Hunter and shatter the dolls before they can escape.

row.name: THE SCREAM OF DARKNESS
row.detailed_description: You moved with your family to a quiet town… but nothing stayed peaceful for long. Now, haunted by loss, you must explore unsettling places, face terrifying encounters, and piece together fragments of mystery. THE SCREAM OF DARKNESS combines atmospheric storytelling with psychological horror, where every choice nudges you closer to one of many endings. Will you discover the truth… or be consumed by it?
row.short_description: the scream of darkness is a first person psychological horror with multiple endings, it shows the story about one guy that gets his whole life ruined in days. can you discover the truth?

row.name: Skybound
row.detailed_description: Explore, Parkour, Save the world! Skybound is a game about exploration with an Exhilarating movement system. Using Bells abilities to bring the world back together! Skybound is a 3D exploration platformer focused on fun, fluid movement mechanics , parkour and environmental puzzle solving. You play as Bell, a young archaeologist exploring mystical floating islands in search of ancient artifacts. Use Bell's specialized equipment - including a Grappling Anchor , agility boots , and mastery over the magical ' Flow ' - to investigate ruins untouched by explorers for ages. Swing through the sky, traverse the islands and meet its curious and whacky inhabitants. You've got a contract to fulfill and mysteries to unearth! Please note that this is only ACT 1, more acts will be made if the game is positively received! PLEASE NOTE 2: THE GAME IS OPTIMIZED FOR 1920X1080 DISPLAY. FEATURES In Skybound you can EXPLORE  three different islands. By using Bell's GRAPPELING HOOK . And once you've mastered the MOMENTUM and FLOW of the game you'll be FLYING like this: And Most importantly, you can destroy oh so many POTS! Some even contain collectibles! The Story of Skybound Bell wasn't exactly what Professor A. N. Curia - who studies anicent human civilization - expected to receive. Shipped to the Professor  archaeologist as 'Human Remains' , the package contained something far more alive: a baby . Turns out, raising a human is excellent for research (and admittedly, pretty adorable). Growing up, Bell took to her mentor/parent's work in a big way. She spent countless nights under the blanket reading about lost civilizations, and even more time tagging along on excavation trips. Eager as ever, she learned fast by studying artifacts, documenting ruins and decoding ancient texts. By seventeen , she'd shaped into a fine archaeologist in her own right. Now she's got her very first solo job! The client came through Professor A. N. Curia, so they must be reputable. The mission is straightforward: retrieve an artifact from the ancient and mysterious sky islands and prove she's a real archaeologist. This is the beginning of something great! But as Bell explores the floating ruins, something feels... off . Questions keep surfacing that don't quite add up. What exactly does the client want with this artifact ? And why all the secrecy? Controls Movement Use ' WASD ' to move Use the Mouse to aim an look around Use the Spacebar to jump Hold Shift to run Actions Press the ' E ' button to interact Use Mouse 1  to fire/swing the Grappling Anchor , and  Mouse 2  to pull yourself towards the target. Use Mouse 1 to continue the dialogue. Sometimes hitting stuff with your Anchor is a good idea ..! Press the ' L ' button to reset to latest Checkpoint UI ESC = Open pause men Hold TAB = View objectives Cheats / Reset If you ever want to unlock everything and just explore the three islands you can go into 'Game Alterations' inside of the options, here you can unlock everything and travel to specific islands! But if you want to relive the game and rewatch the intro you can also reset all data ! Please note: This is a student demo Skybound is a demo created over 6 weeks by a multidisciplinary team of students from many different universities together for a semester at DADIU (Danish Academy of Digital, Interactive Entertainment). This project brought together aspiring developers, artists, designers and composers, all of whom have never worked on a game of this scale before, and with this tight of a schedule. While we're incredibly proud of what we've accomplished in such a short timeframe, you may encounter bugs or rough edges along the way. We appreciate your understanding and hope you enjoy exploring the sky islands with Bell despite any hiccups! Thank you for playing our game!
row.short_description: Skybound is a 3D exploration platformer focused on fun, fluid movement mechanics, parkour and environmental puzzle solving.

row.name: Survivors: Match-3 Island Adventure
row.detailed_description: After a plane crash, you find yourself stranded on a mysterious tropical island. With no clear way home, your journey turns into an unexpected adventure filled with secrets, discoveries and survival challenges! In Survivors: Match-3 Island Adventure , you explore jungles, beaches, lagoons, ruins and mountains while completing quests and unlocking new areas. Restore and upgrade your camp, gather resources and follow a story that gradually reveals the island’s hidden past. Progress through the adventure by solving match-3 puzzles that drive the story forward and open new locations. Can you survive, explore the island and uncover its secrets? Key Features • Match-3 Progression System Complete hundreds of match-3 levels to unlock areas, clear obstacles, earn boosters and advance the story. • Exploration-Driven Adventure Investigate diverse island locations packed with resources, hidden items and challenges. • Camp Building & Crafting Restore and upgrade your camp, craft tools and improve your ability to survive hostile environments. • Resource Management & Cooking Gather materials, grow crops, find wild ingredients and prepare meals to sustain the survivors. • Quests, Inventory & Treasures Complete structured quests, collect artifacts and caches and manage your inventory efficiently. • Mystery & Survival Themes Face environmental dangers and strange creatures while uncovering the truth behind the island. While this game is absolutely free to play, you have the ability to unlock optional bonuses via in-app purchases from within the game. You may disable in-app purchases in your device settings. You can play this game whether you’re offline or online. ______________________________ Game available in: English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish.
row.short_description: Survive on a mysterious island after a plane crash! Solve match-3 puzzles, restore your camp, craft tools, grow crops, explore jungles and lagoons, uncover hidden treasures and reveal the island’s secrets!

row.name: 幻想三国2
row.detailed_description: 《幻想三国》 我是一个爱喝咖啡的白领青年，一次雨夜离奇的车祸竟然让我穿越了...穿越到三国，成了统领三军的主公。我如何在一个乱世纷争，群雄争霸的世界生存，我要成为曹操般的一代枭雄？还是关羽一样的仁义武圣？还是诸葛亮一般智谋超群的圣人？这都取决于我的选择~ ★STEAM 独家优惠★ 【福利介绍】 登录即送高级武将及丰富新手礼包，活动期间更有超级成长礼包额外获得，助各位英雄驰骋于烽火三国之中。 【线上福利】 客服QQ：939432967 添加客服QQ免费领取各种礼包，助力您的称霸三国之路~ 上线即送武将套装及丰富道具礼包 活动范围：永久 活动规则：登录即送高级武将及丰富新手礼包，活动期间更有超级成长礼包额外获得，助各位英雄驰骋于烽火三国之中。 活动奖励： ★第二大礼遇：3名30级武将！ ★第二大礼遇：50礼金、金月卡×1 ★第三大礼遇：新手礼包 新手包×1，内含：鲁班图纸×1、建筑队×3、神秘防具1×1、升级灵珠×1、盾神祝福×3、木牛流马×10、随军大夫×10、神秘武器1×1、生产天书×1、精玉灵石×2、坐骑智力1×1、建筑草图×1、科技草图×1、募兵令×5、坐骑鉴定书×1、凝神丹×1、神秘物品1×1、元宝券×1、探马×1、红礼盒×1、坐骑防御1×1、凡品鉴定珠×1、锦囊×1、传音符×100、坐骑武器1×1、召唤符×1、武器箱×1、建筑残卷×15、科技残卷×10、义兵令×10、小神丹×30、尚方宝剑×3、神秘兵书1×1、兵书箱×1、物品箱×1、防具箱×1、坐骑体力1×1、未知的珠宝×1、鞋盒×1、古碇刀×1 ★第四大礼遇：新手卡（其中包含1个红礼盒、1个建筑草图、1个科技草图、1个募兵令、1个凝神丹、1个小免战、1个建筑队、10个传音符）联系在线客服领取。 ★游戏特色系统介绍★ 【战役】以组队的形式进入战役副本。体验多人战斗的乐趣，增加游戏挑战性。 【新比武大会】新比武大会是全新自动配对的淘汰晋级赛，玩家通过一对一不断晋级，最后到争夺冠军的宝座，全新的系统让比武更加生动有趣，奖励更丰富。 【军团战】军团战是大规模玩家对战的系统，能为玩家带来更真实更刺激的战斗体验 。 【名城争霸】名城争夺战系统，为各大联盟带来了争夺和占领名城的乐趣。 【王妃】君主可以通过民间选秀的方式，在芸芸女子中挑选出14位心仪的妃子，每位妃子对应不同的属性加成，给妃子们赠送钟意的珠宝首饰，可提高妃子好感度，好感度达到一定数值即可提升妃子品阶，品阶越高对君主的助力越大，宠幸妃子有一定概率怀孕生子哦。 【王城】可免费招募神将、召唤神兽、招募天将、抽取神装、武将修仙、虎象坐骑。 【修仙】武将修仙有十个境界：练气、筑基、结晶、金丹、具灵、元婴、化神、悟道、羽化、登仙，每个境界有10级，每升1级增加一定的加成属性和带兵数量。 【天将】天将吕布、天将左慈、天将曹操、天将马超、天将黄忠，最新现世的五大天将拥有惊人的属性系数，传说全是天命不凡的武将，快把他们收入囊中为您所用吧。 ★游戏十大发展主线★ 想要天下无敌，需要十项全能，游戏十大发展主线： 1、神将魔将：要有好将发展才快，现在还有天将。 2、装备炼化：有了装备，还要炼化，才能属性倍增，装备属性炼化到破千才起步。 3、高级兵种：兵种也要发展到高级，例如大象骑、天兵战车。 4、技能：后期没有好技能，别想出门打怪兽。五个妖术才算数。
row.short_description: 我是一个爱喝咖啡的白领青年，一次雨夜离奇的车祸竟然让我穿越了...穿越到三国，成了统领三军的主公。我要招募神将赵云、神将吕布助阵，邂逅美貌无双的四大王妃。开始吧，与神将和爱妃们开疆拓土，横扫千军，称霸三国！

row.name: Street Vendor's Journey
row.detailed_description: You couldn’t handle the debts in the city, so you returned to your family home. Your father’s old street cart is worn out, your money is limited, and disappointing your family again is not an option. Can you build a stable future for your family? Run your street cart in a living city. Choose what to sell, manage stock, set prices, and serve customers directly on the streets. Sell fairly and earn trust, or cut corners and face consequences. Your reputation affects customer behavior, fines, and future opportunities. Customers have different budgets, patience levels, and expectations. Price awareness and service quality directly affect their decisions. The city changes throughout the day. Customer density, atmosphere, and opportunities shift with time. Upgrade your old street cart to improve efficiency, capacity, and presentation. Better equipment opens new possibilities. Your home comes with unavoidable costs. Rent and basic expenses must always be paid, while your family members create situational and luxury needs. Medical bills, education, comfort, and small pleasures all affect family morale and ignoring them has consequences. New Business Opportunities (Early Access) Street vending is just the beginning. During Early Access, new lines of work, income sources, and business systems will be gradually added. As you build your reputation, you’ll be able to expand beyond your street cart and shape your future through new opportunities.
row.short_description: Street Vendor’s Journey is a life-driven street vending simulation. Start with an father's street cart, sell goods, support your family, and build a better future by managing business, reputation, and daily life.

row.name: Starlit Bottle
row.detailed_description: Starlit Bottle is a cozy and relaxing casual game designed to relieve stress. Its core gameplay is simple yet incredibly soothing: your goal is to pour water of different colors from bottles into separate cups until each bottle contains only one color of water to complete a level. The game features three difficulty modes—Easy, Medium, and Hard—catering to players with different paces. As you progress through the challenges, the number of bottles you need to sort will gradually increase. Whether you want to unwind after a long day or enjoy low-stress puzzles during short breaks, this game is perfect for you.
row.short_description: Starlit Bottle is a casual stress-relief game themed around starry sky bottles.

row.name: エレベーション
row.detailed_description: 片腕の夜間警備員、雜賀（さいが）と粢田（しとぎだ）を操作し、 地下1階から8階までの各フロアを巡回します。 二人は今回発生した異常事態の影響で、互いの腕が複雑に結合しています。 そのため、不審者と対峙する際は防犯用の「エレベーション」を使用します。 ・エレベーションとは 『鎮静剤。一度に3本投与、必ず換気をして使用する必要がある。 錠剤型と防犯用の注射器型があり、投与すると柑橘類のようなかおりが漂う。』 正しく投与することで、興奮状態にある相手を確実に鎮静させることが可能です。 用法用量を守って使用してください。 ・不審な人物に出会ったら 百貨店内には、開店準備の為に早出している従業員のほか、異常事態の影響で現れた幻覚がいます。 雜賀は幻覚に「触れる」ことができます。粢田は幻覚を「探す」ことができます。 基本的には対話が可能な状態ですが、後を追って来る場合はただちに逃げて身の安全を確保してください。
row.short_description: 百貨店巡回ホラーアドベンチャー。かつて奇妙な使用方法で流行した鎮静剤「エレベーション」、上昇を続けるエレベーター、留まる時間。夜間警備員の青年二名が、上階を目指しつつ巡回し、各フロアで異常事態の真相を探る。
row.notes: 流血表現及び架空の薬物の使用

row.name: Cadentia Farnese
row.detailed_description: Roll the dice and discover the history of the iconic Palazzo Farnese: 12 stories as 12 facets of the familiar silhouette that the Romans call the Dice . Learn about the mysterious ancient mosaics preserved underground. Enter behind the scenes of international diplomacy with the French Embassy, which has had its headquarters at Palazzo Farnese for 150 years. Find the graffiti left by young art students in the 18th century on the walls of the famous Carracci Gallery, uncovered during a recent restoration. Throughout your journey, you will meet the genius of Michelangelo, pondering the transformation of the Palace as well as his own life; you will enter the second act of Tosca, Giacomo Puccini's masterpiece and visionary dream; you will experience the most eagerly awaited French summer celebration and the arrival of electronic music in the heart of this Renaissance Palace. Let chance guide you: Palazzo Farnese can be discovered again and again through the 12 stories, with multiple dialogue combinations shedding light on all its secrets. Are you ready to roll the dice? A visual novel dedicated to the Farnese Palace, created by We Are Muesli, in association with and on behalf of the Embassy of France in Italy, supervised by Diego Grammatico.
row.short_description: 12 chances to discover 'the Dice'! Immerse yourself in the history of the Farnese Palace in Rome with this unique narrative video game.

row.name: Diluted
row.detailed_description: Diluted is a narrative-driven 3D side-scrolling puzzle and adventure game where players explore dark environments, solve environmental challenges, and uncover a story centered around fear, control, and nightmares. Players control Archie, a young orphan cursed with a living nightmare entity named Azell. Throughout the game, players navigate interconnected areas, avoid environmental hazards, and confront hostile nightmare manifestations, all while experiencing a linear, story-focused experience. Gameplay emphasizes exploration, puzzle-solving, and light combat mechanics. Players must pay attention to the world around them, interpret the cues from the environment, and use Archie's limited ability and knowledge of the alchemic arts to survive these encounters. Story elements are delivered through environmental storytelling, notes, and journals. As players progress, they uncover the truth behind Percilla’s orphanage, Archie's nightmares, and Azell's role in this whole conundrum. Diluted offers a slightly dark fantasy setting with psychological horror themes, cute visuals, ambient sound design, and narrative tension to create an emotionally driven experience. Key Features 3D Side-Scrolling Gameplay – A linear, story-driven experience focused on exploration and progression Puzzle-Based Progression – Environmental puzzles and obstacles that gate advancement Light Combat Encounters – Face hostile nightmare creatures while managing limited resources Narrative Focus – Story delivered through notes, environmental details, and character interactions Atmospheric Presentation – Dark fantasy visuals and sound design inspired by psychological horror Single-Player Experience – No multiplayer or live-service elements
row.short_description: Diluted is a 3/4ths puzzle adventure-action game where nightmares seep into reality. Play as Archie, an orphan bound to a living nightmare, and uncover the truth behind his matron’s orphanage as you explore twisted forests and corrupted memories.

row.name: Scrap Squadrons
row.detailed_description: Choose your ships, fight it out with another player or a bot, unlock new ships, gather some scrap, repair your ships, repeat. Round-based game. Both players choose actions the ships will make at the same time. When both are ready - actions are executed at the same time, but ordered based on the order and priority of chosen action. You have to plan at least a couple of steps ahead. Deckbuilding elements. The actions that the ships can execute each round are drawn from a deck  stack of actions and it behaves like a regular deck-building game. The actions in the starting stack are influenced by the ships you pick. 26 Scrap Ships with unique actions. Each of the 26 ships does something different when executing an Ultimate action. 1v1 Multiplayer. Start the battle in MP mode to play against another player from start to finish. Or use a MIX mode to start playing against a Singleplayer bot, but allow other players to take control of enemy ships mid-battle.
row.short_description: A round-based spaceships-themed game with deckbuilding elements about squadrons of scrap ships turning each other into scrap.

row.name: 100 Radioactive Cats
row.detailed_description: Feature List About the Game 🐾 WELCOME TO ANOTHER ONE OF 100 CATS SERIES GAME 🐈 Join the cutest adventure in the world full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special themed locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Test your attention and observation skills in this cozy and delightful hidden object game. Each cat is more charming than the last, and every discovery brings a smile to your face. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈 Key Features 🎮 1 Level 🐈 100 Hidden Cats 🎵 Awesome Soundtrack 🎨 High Quality Resolution Artworks 🌗 Brightness Settings 💾 Progress Saves 🔍 Zoom 😺 Real Meow Sounds! 💥 Combo Counter! 💡 Tips 🌐 No Text
row.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

row.name: Giant Snake Girl wants The Burger!
row.detailed_description: MON DIEU! Giant Snake Girl is hungry for The Burger! As a silly Tsuchinoko who's also her best friend, it's Loaf's duty  to find these burgers for her big friend.  Take on many puzzling challenges as Loaf the Tsuchinoko. Find The Burgers and bring them to Giant Snake Girl. But beware, as you collect The Burgers, an impassable trail begins to form behind you.  How many The Burgers can you bring to the wonderful Giant Snake Girl? Solve numerous puzzles across four worlds in your search for The Burgers Unlock skins for Loaf and silly hats for Giant Snake Girl A cast of cute characters await the snakes on their grand journey.
row.short_description: One silly Tsuchinoko's epic journey to feed The Burger to her Giant Snake friend.

row.name: Panel Attack
row.detailed_description: Fast, flashy, and free. A modern twist on classic Panel de Pon / Tetris Attack–style match-3 action. Swap tiles, trigger insane chains, and push your skills to the limit as the board rises beneath you. Easy to learn, hard to master, and built for pure, arcade-speed fun. Features: Combo-driven match-3 gameplay Multiple modes for chill or challenge 100% free Play solo or with challenge your friends Jump in and Chain big
row.short_description: Fast, flashy, and free.A modern twist on classic Panel de Pon / Tetris Attack–style match-3 action. Swap tiles, trigger insane chains, and push your skills to the limit as the board rises beneath you. Easy to learn, hard to master, and built for pure, arcade-speed fun.

row.name: Incremental Dungeon
row.detailed_description: After a 280 year long war with the demon nation, humanity is fractured and on the brink of extinction. Take the role of an optimistic young adventurer and descend into the depths to slay the Demon King. You will encounter ever greater adversaries, with strength you never could have imagined. To stand against them you must train, find equipment, and more.
row.short_description: Incremental Dungeon is an incremental game in which you fight combatants with exponentially increasing strength via an auto-battler system. Each defeated opponent on the main path unlocks new equipment, shops, or other ways of empowering your build!
row.notes: Low-res static sprites with gore or revealing outfits, violence and warfare.

row.name: BND-Legenden: Operation Blackbox
row.detailed_description: BND Legends: Operation Blackbox is a story-driven stealth and infiltration game that places you in the role of AJ, a field agent of the German Federal Intelligence Service. Your mission leads you deep into the high-security headquarters of Warlink.AI, a foreign tech corporation suspected of developing a devastating AI-powered cyber weapon known as T-Cell . Hidden somewhere inside the facility lies the Blackbox, a sealed server containing all research data. Your task is to infiltrate the complex, retrieve as much information as possible, and escape before the enemy security forces can react. Your Team AJ never enters the mission alone. She is supported remotely by two specialists who help shape every decision inside the field. Atlas, the team’s geo-intelligence and tactics expert, scans the environment, reveals camera sightlines and patrol zones, and provides strategic guidance that helps you navigate the facility unseen. Ruby, the team’s hacker, accesses locked systems, manipulates devices, overrides defenses, and leads you through intricate hacking challenges that reach far into enemy networks. Together, the three agents form a tightly coordinated unit whose collaboration is crucial for the success of Operation Blackbox. The Setting: Warlink.AI Headquarters The entire operation takes place in the tech district of Te-Guug, the futuristic capital of Bethulan. Warlink.AI’s headquarters resembles a fortified research citadel made of steel, carbon and glass, guarded by drones, soldiers and cutting-edge surveillance technology. More than a simple office building, this sprawling facility houses experimental AI labs, production halls and deep server layers. Somewhere within this fortress lies the guarded Blackbox – your primary objective and the key to uncovering the T-Cell threat. Gameplay and Mission Your journey spans five atmospheric levels, each offering its own tone and set of challenges. The outer premises serve as a warm-up in which AJ learns to move silently and stay in the shadows. From there, you infiltrate the heavily monitored entrance complex, where disguises, misdirection and careful observation are the only ways to advance without raising suspicion. The mission then leads you into a pitch-dark production hall, a maze filled with patrolling drones, industrial noise and a massive ceiling crane that you must carefully maneuver through a dangerous obstacle course while trying to restore the power supply. Pressure intensifies as you reach the Quantum Layer, a high-tech server zone filled with patrols, platform puzzles and a temporary identity cloak that can collapse at the worst possible moment. After a security alert, every second counts while you fight your way toward the data vault before the entire area locks down. The operation culminates inside a virtual data stream, where Ruby dives into a surreal digital environment, races through endless data corridors, evades firewalls and defensive protocols, and extracts the final pieces of intelligence needed to expose the full scope of the T-Cell weapon. Atmosphere and Tension BND Legends: Operation Blackbox blends stealth, strategy, dynamic environmental challenges and cinematic storytelling into a concentrated, high-tension experience. The world of Bethulan, infused with high-tech espionage, political intrigue and the looming threat of an AI catastrophe, creates a gripping backdrop for AJ’s mission. Working together with Atlas and Ruby, you must stay silent, stay hidden and stay in control. Every step in the shadows brings you closer to the Blackbox – or straight into danger.
row.short_description: BND Legends: Operation Blackbox is a tactical stealth adventure where you guide agent AJ through a fortified tech compound, infiltrate enemy systems, steal critical data, and complete clever minigames with support from your elite BND team.

row.name: Elemental Battle: Eclipse
row.detailed_description: Dive into a fast-paced anime-style arena fighter where every battle erupts with color, personality, and raw elemental fury. Developed entirely by a solo creator , Elemental Clash Arena blends stylish action with deep combat mechanics to deliver an experience that’s easy to pick up—but endlessly rewarding to master. Unleash your power through a combo-driven combat system designed for creative expression. Chain aerial juggles, dodge-cancels, elemental finishers, and character-specific techniques to overwhelm your opponent. Every fighter wields unique elemental abilities that shape their playstyle—burn foes with blazing rushdowns, freeze the battlefield with precision ice traps, shock enemies with lightning-fast mix-ups, and more. Choose from a roster of distinct, hand-crafted characters , each with their own fighting philosophy, special skills, and explosive super attacks. Whether you’re battling solo or facing off against friends, the game’s local multiplayer makes every match a spectacle. Featuring striking anime visuals , dynamic effects, and smooth animation, Elemental Clash Arena brings every punch, blast, and combo to life. Key Features 🔥 Anime-style arena combat full of personality and flair 🌪️ Elemental powers that define each character’s playstyle ⚔️ Deep combo system with cancels, launchers, and finishers ✨ Unique special abilities for every fighter 👥 Local multiplayer for intense couch battles 🎭 A diverse cast of original characters 🎨 Beautiful visuals and effects crafted by a solo developer Prepare to enter the arena—master your element, perfect your combos, and claim victory in Elemental Clash Arena .
row.short_description: An anime-style arena fighter with elemental powers, unique characters, and combo-heavy combat. Built by a solo developer, featuring striking visuals, unique abilities, responsive controls, and fast local multiplayer battles packed with style and energy for all skill levels and endless replayability.

row.name: Fruit Fusion!
row.detailed_description: Help Aira, Rinka and Yuri merge fruit and unlock new cards in this sweet and charming Suika x Deckbuilder! Merge Fruit Merge fruit of increasing size to win the game! Try to get the biggest fruit as possible. Look out for the stars to complete the stage.  Don't let the cabinet overflow! Use abilities and smart merging to avoid overflowing the arcade cabinet! Make friends  Meet the girls of the arcade, learn their stories and unlock unique endings.  Customize your deck Unlock new cards, abilities and items to build stronger decks and synergies!
row.short_description: Help Aira, Rinka and Yuri merge fruit and unlock new cards in this sweet and charming Suika x Deckbuilder!

row.name: Encore!
row.detailed_description: Begin your career at the Multiversal Institute for the Rhythmic Arts (MIRA), an interdimensional school where music, magic, and friendship collide.  Recruit new friends from across realities and times to form a band that will rival the ages and unlock the power of rhythm with your bonds. Can your band make the audience scream Encore!? Encore! is a rhythm game and a visual novel where you play as a new student at the Multiversal Institute for the Rhythmic Arts (MIRA). Practice your performance skills by tapping the arrow keys in time with songs, and gain access to new music and instruments by making friends at school. Curate your band from a slew of unique characters: a wild-western alien guitarist, an edgy angel harpist, a Victorian bassoonist, and many more. Learn more about each character’s story and play well with them to gain their affection. Win the Battle of the Bands at the end of the school year and make the audience yell Encore! The game features a 45-minute main campaign and a free-play mode to try out any song in the game. This game was made by a student team, many of whom are first-time developers, at Amoriem Labs, the game development club at Yale! Follow us  for more updates.
row.short_description: Begin your career at the Multiversal Institute for the Rhythmic Arts (MIRA), an interdimensional school where music, magic, and friendship collide.  Encore! is a rhythm game and visual novel hybrid, where you must curate a band from wacky characters to win Battle of the Bands!

row.name: 梁山传奇
row.detailed_description: 授权编码：CQZD20251219183646 《梁山传奇》游戏介绍 耗时两年！呕心沥血！诚意之作来袭！💖🔥 《梁山传奇》 = 原创剧情📜 + 超级大陆🌏探险 + 不肝不氪😌轻松玩！ 上线即享豪华大礼：专属自动回收🔄便捷、自动拾取🧤高效、自动经验📈飞升！ 专属法师单职业🧙‍♂️，特色剧情自由探索🔍，专属BUFF随心搭配🛡️，玩法多样百玩不腻🎮💥！ 1-6大陆为初级探险地🗺️初，7-10大陆则是高级挑战区🗺️高，所有装备全靠打怪掉落💥爆！ 无隐藏消费🚫，无毒点设计🚫，公平公正玩到爽！ 全大陆开启多刷怪模式👾，爆率全开💥，光速升级不是梦🚀，经验倍率地图助你一臂之力📈！ 更有专属超级分身👥，让你实力倍增；专属护身🛡️护，血量翻倍💪血，战斗更无忧！ 专属宠物地图🐶🗺️，捕捉转换专属宠物，与你并肩作战🐾！ 专属魔法速度 +9999%💨💨💨，释放技能快如闪电，畅享战斗快感！🎉🔥

row.name: Samburger's oddballs
row.detailed_description: Samburger's oddballs is a 3-game collection of my best games from 2025. (listed in order of release) Athena's higher wire: An arcade platformer with high difficulty and multiple modes including: Classic mode: collect stars to advance levels with increasing difficulty. Level select mode: play thorough a single level until you fail. Hailstorm mode (a subsection of level selects mode): dodge unrelenting cannonfire for as long as you can! Anncceleration: Collect hearts under a strict time limit by platforming through five open levels with slippery controls! Blastin blocks: Line up combos based on the color of your arrow and shoot bombs for a high score in both classic and infinite modes!
row.short_description: A block boomin, cannon blastin, heart grabbin combo! play games such as: Anncceleration: Collect hearts while you race against the clock in multiple levels! Athena's higher wire: Dodge cannons and collect stars for a high score! Boomin blocks: Line up combos in a puzzle shooter!

row.name: Little Smiles Daycare
row.detailed_description: A peaceful daycare once filled with laughter and children… now left abandoned, silent, and hiding something twisted. You play as a lone investigator exploring the ruins of Little Smiles Daycare. Uncover hidden clues, recorded memories, mysterious artifacts, and a truth that was never meant to be found. But you’re not alone. Something else is watching. And smiling. Explore. Listen. Investigate. Will you uncover what happened here? Or will Mr. Smiles find you first? Features Fully voice-acted cutscenes Psychological horror and secret lore Hidden clues, endings, and twists to discover 10-15 minutes of gameplay per run Multiple outcomes, choose carefully 🗝️ Voice Talent Ms. Harper – Hannah Willhouse Instagram: @HannahWacting YouTube: HannahWillhouseVA Mr. Smiles – Kobe Van Bogaert Twitter: @KobeVB_VA 🧩 Gameplay Explore at your own pace, solve environmental puzzles, follow the clues, and reveal the daycare’s darkest moments. Every step draws you closer to the truth, and to something watching from just beyond the halls…
row.short_description: A short psychological horror experience set inside an abandoned daycare. Explore, uncover hidden notes, solve eerie mysteries, and discover what happened to Little Smiles Daycare, before something finds you first.

row.name: KUMASAMA
row.detailed_description: “KUMASAMA” is a horror adventure set in the present day. ◆Story Recently, bear attacks have been occurring all over the country. I saw something about it on the news, but I was sure it had nothing to do with life in my town. …Or so I thought. Someone spotted a large brown silhouette lurking in the darkness, at night, in an abandoned factory. There’s no doubt that something terrifying and enormous is hiding in this town. …and eventually, I came to understand that the “something” was her. I think of her—and of the days I can never return to. ◆Gameplay Features A walking simulator where events unfold as you explore. Inspect objects to progress the story. No quest markers or time limits—play at your own pace. “She” is timid, but her claws are sharp. Playtime: 10–40 minutes ◆Guidelines for Video Streaming Both individuals and organizations may stream the game without prior permission.
row.short_description: A large brown shadow lurks in the abandoned factory; the night hides her form.Something terrifyingly massive is concealed within this town.I think of her, and of the days I can never go back to.“KUMASAMA” is a horror adventure set in the present day.

row.name: Space Aces
row.detailed_description: Space Aces is an indie browser-based space shooter that plunges you into an online universe full of action, strategy, and fierce competition. Step into the cockpit and evolve from a rookie pilot into the most feared Ace in the galaxy! Battle through thrilling encounters against more than 30 unique alien threats and test your skills against others in intense Player versus Player space dogfights. Choose and customize your ship from an expansive arsenal featuring 10 distinct ship types with over 100 possible configurations, each capable of turning the tide of battles! Acquire elite gear, ships, forge powerful alliances and create and manage your own clan to become feared by all other aces! Build battle stations with multiple defence and offence capabilities, ranging from good old reliable Space Nukes, to hi-tech plasma beams and enforce your control over all space sectors in exciting and entising PvP battles! So, do you have what it takes? Your spaceship is waiting for you pilot!
row.short_description: Space Aces is an indie space shooter that plunges you into an online universe full of action, strategy, and fierce competition. Step into the cockpit and evolve from a rookie pilot into the most feared Ace in the galaxy!

row.name: Putrid Snow 2: House of Yule
row.detailed_description: You woke up late this Christmas day to find all of your family members suddenly gone. But that's not the only surprise... Christmas presents are scattered everywhere! What a pleasant surprise. But wait, what are those items inside? A crowbar ? Machine oil ? A glue gun ? Banana peels ? Well... while those might sound like awful presents, they sure can come in handy to prepare for the Christmas Siege party that's about to unveil. Explore the Family Mansion: From the cozy Living Room and long, eerie corridors to the dark basement, dusty attic, and small  hedge labyrinth in the backyard ! Survive the Holidays: Manage your 6-slot inventory and take care of your Christmas Mood . Find sweets and food to keep your energy up! Fight Back: Use household items as weapons and traps . Stun your foes, inflict damage, and slow them down with injuries to make them less agile. Atmospheric Horror: Experience an eerie retro-style atmosphere and immersive sound design. The house is well-lit, but you'll never know what's hiding behind a corner. Short & Replayable: A tight, intense experience (30-60 mins) with three difficulty settings - for those wishing to relax and enjoy the holidays as well as those who wish to experience the true survival horror. Dynamic AI: Face off against an intelligent (but comedically stupid) AI that will pursue you relentlessly. He gives you just enough room to breathe, but never lets you feel safe. You are the only one who can protect the house now. So get to it! Plays great on Steam Deck! In our testing, the game runs smoothly with a stable framerate and offers approximately 4 hours of battery life on a full charge!
row.short_description: Trapped alone in a mansion with relentless holiday monsters, you must scavenge for presents to find weapons and traps. Outsmart the AI, manage your inventory, and turn the holiday hunter into the hunted. Free to play!

row.name: Denpa Nightmares
row.detailed_description: This is simply a visual novel game about reminiscing the past. You and the girl named “ Dirtie ” stay together in this forgotten world. There are no goals to reach, nothing you must accomplish. You simply keep each other company, chatting idly about the old days — and that’s all there is. Gameplay Click on the screen to advance the story. Choose the options you want. Think about what Dirtie says. Sometimes, Dirtie may say things that break the fourth wall, but you don’t need to worry about it. Streaming of this game is welcome (whether monetized or not).
row.short_description: No matter how long you’re gone, there will always be a girl waiting for you in the same place. This is a story about forgetting, and about waiting. After countless restarts and countless memories lost… how long will you stay with her this time?

row.name: Ktrl Smash
row.detailed_description: Ktrl Smash is a chaotic and fast-paced multiplayer arena brawler where every second counts. Jump into a bright 3D arena, choose your fighter, and battle players from around the world in short, intense matches. Your goal is simple: get the most kills before the timer hits zero. The arena is packed with weapons and stat boosts, turning every match into a wild scramble. Pick up anything you can find, swing a baseball bat , throw a baseball , or smash someone with a chair . Each weapon changes how you fight, letting you surprise opponents or rush straight into the action. Scattered around the map are useful pickups like Speed Boost , Damage Boost , and Health Boost . Grabbing them at the right moment can help you survive longer, strike faster, or turn a losing fight around. With players racing toward the same boosts, every pickup becomes a small battle of its own. Matches are quick, lively, and unpredictable. One moment you are chasing someone with a bat, the next, you’re scrambling to grab a boost before someone else does. Simple controls make it easy to jump in, while the fast pace keeps every round exciting and competitive. When the timer runs out, the player with the highest kills claims the win and becomes the ultimate champion.
row.short_description: Krlt Smash is a fast-paced multiplayer arena game where anything can become a weapon. Pick your fighter, grab bats, baseballs, or even chairs, collect stat boosts, and fight to get the most kills before time runs out. Stay alert, keep moving, and defeat as many players as you can.

row.name: White Memories
row.detailed_description: Take the mantle of a postman who refuses to give up his job, even after death, in order to hold on to the only memory he has of his past. Fly away to the world of the forgotten to deliver your letters to the ghosts trapped there and allow them to reach the afterlife, while protecting your mail from those who, consumed by loneliness, pursue you relentlessly. Fly through the streets of Lunhac Use the gravity of the world of the dead to navigate between the buildings of a small French village. Soar into the skies or sink into the depths of the world of the forgotten and navigate while dodging enemies and obstacles alike. Switch between the dark and frightening world of the forgotten and the more poetic and soothing world of Lunhac and its surroundings.  Free troubled souls Explore the world between deliveries and chat with the various inhabitants of the village. Uncover their stories and, if you make the right choices, ease the regrets of those you can help. Master the flight system to enjoy the poetic and soothing landscape of Lunhac and its surroundings. White Memories is a student project carried out by a team of 14 fourth-year students at the Interactive Art & Design 3D school in Montpellier.
row.short_description: Take the mantle of a postman who refuses to give up his job, even after death. Clinging to your last memory, take off into the world of the forgotten to deliver your letters to the ghosts that are stuck there, allowing them to reach the afterlife. Protect your mail from those who are pursuing you.

row.name: Motarium
row.detailed_description: 🌊 Motarium, the aquarium of words Motarium blends the world of words with the tranquility of the ocean. A peaceful, immersive experience where letters float among fish and bubbles. Each game is a unique journey through language, combining fun, focus and a touch of poetry. From anagrams to SUTOM, from word searches to original ideas, Motarium offers a rich and evolving collection of word games wrapped in an elegant underwater atmosphere. Whether you play for a few minutes or dive deep into challenges, the experience is designed to relax and engage. 🎮 A variety of word games for every type of player Play casually or chase the perfect score with flexible game modes Enjoy a smooth, animated oceanic setting filled with fish, bubbles and motion Discover both classic and original gameplay built around language ⭐ Key features Daily challenge shared with all players Over 35 Steam achievements to unlock Three difficulty levels to suit every skill level Available in both English and French Virtual keyboard included for added comfort Share your results with stylish emoji grids 🧠 Who is it for Word game lovers looking for a fresh experience Casual players seeking quick, satisfying sessions Puzzle fans who enjoy daily challenges Completionists and achievement hunters Anyone who just wants to relax with beautiful visuals and smart gameplay Step into Motarium. The words are waiting for you, just below the surface.
row.short_description: 🫧 Motarium is a free collection of word games set in a relaxing underwater world. Anagrams, word searches, hangman, SUTOM and more. Dive into a sea of words and challenge your brain in a calm, beautiful environment.

row.name: 我的文字修仙世界
row.detailed_description: Game Introduction This is the first commercial game co-created by the author (planner) and another partner (programmer). It includes in-app purchases, but no items that affect game balance are sold. Our original intention is to create a cultivation game that supports idle gameplay, free trading, unrestricted learning and matching of techniques, and free attribute point allocation. Due to limited resources, the game has not undergone professional testing and may contain bugs and other shortcomings. We hope for your understanding. For players who provide optimization suggestions or report bugs, we will offer generous resource rewards. We look forward to working together to make this game even better. Friendly Reminder: This is a multiplayer online text-based game, not a single-player game! The game focuses on idle cultivation while you work. During your free time, you can challenge bosses, and obtain various resources such as equipment and magic artifacts through trials, exploring secret realms, and other methods. It also supports free chat (all pornographic, vulgar, and similar remarks are prohibited; violators will be muted or banned). Players can list and sell their loot freely. Official Group: 764923005 We welcome you to leave valuable opinions. We will add interesting gameplay and fix discovered bugs in a timely manner. We hope to improve this game together with you! Gameplay & Features Joining a Sect There are four major sects in the game. Each sect gives a unique sect heart method as a starting gift (effects listed below). In other aspects such as skill cultivation and equipment development, there is no difference between the four sects. The sect only provides a clear initial cultivation direction for players. Wenjian Mountain: Enhances critical strike rate and critical damage. Chixiao Gate: Boosts fire and thunder elemental attributes and resistance. Liuyun Pavilion: Improves water and earth elemental attributes and resistance. Lingbao Hall: Enhances magic artifact attribute effects. Sect Main Hall Donate resources to the Law Enforcement Elder to upgrade the sect level and earn personal contributions. You can also promote your status in the sect, starting from a handyman disciple and gradually advancing to a core disciple. Complete sect tasks at the Assessment Elder to gain personal contributions. Participate in sect competitions, choosing events like Outer Sect Tournament, Inner Sect Tournament, or Elite Tournament based on your status. Defeat other players to achieve better rankings and win rewards. Sect Treasure Workshop Use personal contributions to exchange for various entry-level mental methods, techniques, medicinal materials, pills, and more. Use premium currency (Xianyu) to purchase functional items, fashion costumes, and other accessories. Sect Alchemy Room Refine needed pills here, which can be used to increase attributes, cultivate cultivation base, and break through realm bottlenecks. Alchemy requires reaching the corresponding alchemy level, unlocking specific pill recipes, and having essential alchemy materials. Sect Cave Mansion This is the core area for players to practice in idle mode. Upgrade the cave mansion level to gain faster cultivation speed (subject to corresponding sect position requirements). For players with limited time, the game offers a 10x Secret Realm function for rapid cultivation. Activating it consumes Sect Secret Realm Tokens, which can be collected for free daily based on your sect position. Sect Trial Area Unlocked when your cultivation reaches a specified realm. Explore by flipping grids to discover resources such as spirit stones, equipment fragments, magic artifact fragments, celestial materials, and medicinal herbs. Encounter monsters during exploration and choose to defeat them for equipment and items. Friendly Reminder: Each trial area has 6 floors; you must clear all monsters on the current floor to enter the next. Sect Spiritual Plantation Each sect disciple initially has 10 spiritual fields (the number unlocks gradually with your sect status). Each field can be upgraded; higher-level fields allow planting higher-grade spiritual herbs. Equipment Gameplay Equipment is divided into 10 stages, with one stage corresponding to each major cultivation realm. Each stage has 16 pieces of equipment, including 6 weapons and 12 pieces of armor. Each item has four quality levels: Low Grade, Medium Grade, High Grade, and Profound Grade. Equipment includes main attributes and sub-stat affixes. Main attributes can be enhanced, and sub-stat affixes can be refined. Players can choose equipment and affixes entirely based on their cultivation direction. For example: Players focusing on earth-element techniques are better off choosing shield weapons, as earth-element damage is calculated based on their own defense. Higher defense deals more damage to enemies, and affixes can be refined to increase health, physical defense, or magical defense. Players learning sword-based techniques can choose swords, broadswords, spears, etc. All choices depend on the player’s cultivation path—there are no in-game restrictions. Magic Artifact Gameplay Magic artifacts follow a similar setup to equipment, with 10 stages and 4 quality levels, supporting enhancement and refinement. The difference is that magic artifacts can only be unlocked at specific cultivation realms and are limited by cultivation base and true essence when used. They are divided into Attack Artifacts and Defense Artifacts: Attack Artifacts consume true essence to actively attack enemies at regular intervals. Defense Artifacts provide players with shield protection. When your Attack Artifact is powerful enough, it can defeat enemies for you without manual combat. Similarly, a strong Defense Artifact may make enemies unable to break your shield. Technique Gameplay The game offers dozens of mental methods and techniques, divided into 5 levels—higher levels provide better effects. Players can learn any technique or mental method without restrictions, allowing full customization. Note: Mental methods are passive and take effect immediately after learning. Techniques need to be equipped to be used in combat; each player can equip up to 6 techniques. Techniques are categorized by attribute: Sword (Physical Damage) Fire (Magical Damage) Thunder (Control) Earth (Defense) Water (Healing & Support) Coordinate with teammates in team mode for strategic battles. All techniques are obtained through in-game systems, while rare techniques drop randomly from world bosses. Market Gameplay All players can buy or sell materials and items in the Auction House, supporting unrestricted free trading and player farming. If you’re lucky enough to obtain rare items (e.g., Profound Grade equipment/artifacts, Heavenly/Godly Grade techniques) from boss fights or secret realm bosses, you can sell them to other players in the Auction House for a large amount of Spirit Crystals—an in-game currency that can be freely traded. Special Note: To protect player interests and maintain a healthy trading environment, any player using studio accounts for large-scale profit will be permanently banned. Other Gameplay Additional features include chat, duel, popularity, charm, titles, fashion, leaderboards, and spirit wheel systems. We won’t detail them all here—welcome to explore freely in the game!
row.short_description: This is a multiplayer online text-based cultivation game (not single-player), co-created by a planner and a programmer. It focuses on the core experience of 'idle gameplay for low stress + high freedom'.
