row.name: Le Petit Raccoon
row.detailed_description: The Game Le Petit Raccoon is a stealth cooking game where you must steal groceries to cook for your hungry guests. Who am I? You play as Rocko the raccoon. You've just moved to the big city of Pettington to open up your dream restaurant! The catch? You forgot to stock up on ingredients! Customers already start pouring into your restaurant, but without any groceries, you'll have to improvise. What do I do? With no groceries initially at your disposal, you have to steal them from the grocery store next door! Steal groceries from the grocery store Evade the geese employees and avoid getting caught! Take orders from your customers Cook  and Serve  food for your guests!
row.short_description: Le Petit Raccoon is a stealth cooking game where you must steal food to cook for your hungry guests! Steal food from the grocery store, but don't get caught! Time is of the essence, and your customers are waiting.

row.name: Reunion Online
row.detailed_description: Reunion Online is a massive multiplayer RPG (MMORPG) where you can fight monsters with your friends in an open world. CROSS-PLATFORM GAMEPLAY: Reunion Online is truly cross-platform gameplay. Whether you prefer to play on PC or on a mobile device, one account allows you to play on all platforms. Functions: √ Player per player (PvP) √ Ally with other players and form a team to defeat strong monsters and gain extra experience √ Hunt lots of different monsters √ Find the best equipment (semi-random loot) √ An ever-evolving open world √ Chat with other players √ Enchanting system (level up your equipment with special Jewels) √ Crafting system How to play: - To move - use ingame joystick or touch the place where you want to go (change in options) - To attack, just choose a target or use attack button - Use the buttons on the right to restore health, mana or use a special skill - Use the buttons on the right to change set - To pick up the loot from the ground, just touch the hand icon or click on loot - Each character level you gain points to distribute in strength, agility, vitality, intelligence or wisdom - Each profession level you gain one point to level up skills
row.short_description: Reunion Online is an open-world MMORPG with full cross-platform play. Fight monsters, team up with players, earn random loot, and grow your character through crafting and enchanting.

row.name: Lo-Fi Haiku: Coffee and Chill
row.detailed_description: Take a sip of coffee and wake up your inner poet. Take a sip of coffee and wake up your inner poet. Let the words flow with the soft waves of Lo-Fi music. Chill, ease your mind and create. Haiku is a form of poetry, originated in Japan. The basic rules are very simple. It consists of 3 lines. Very, very short and compact! 5 Syllables in the first line, 7 in the second line and finally 5 in the last, third line. And it doesn’t even have to rhyme. Quite nice, right? And how relaxing it’s to create one! Especially with calming notes of Lo-Fi Music, magical animations and steam rising from a cup of coffee. Lo-Fi Haiku: Coffee and Chill is a tool which will help you on your journey of becoming the greatest Haiku Master. Use the words we provide, play around with them, change them, form them into sentences and in no time you will have your own poem. Traditionally Haikus describe nature and its wonders, but YOU can make it about anything! You can write about your cat or grandma. Anything goes as long as you have fun! Lo-Fi Haiku: Coffee and Chill features: Solid selection of words, you can use to create poems Tools to help you count syllables Plenty of good vibes coming from chill and nice Lo-Fi music Stunning, magical animations All the good vibes :)
row.short_description: Take a sip of coffee and wake up your inner poet. Let the words flow with the soft waves of Lo-Fi music. Chill, ease your mind and create. Lo-Fi Haiku: Coffee and Chill is a tool which will help you on your journey of becoming the greatest Haiku Master.

row.name: SportsBlitz
row.detailed_description: SportsBlitz is a fast-paced, retro-inspired microgame collection where every second counts. Jump between dozens of bite-sized sports challenges, each lasting only a few frantic moments, as you race to win rounds, avoid elimination, and climb the leaderboard. Every game throws you into a new skill test: fencing duels, top-down dodging, quick-reaction inputs, and more, all wrapped in a nostalgic CRT-TV presentation. Easy to learn but chaotic to master, SportsBlitz delivers classic WarioWare-style energy with a distinct pixel-sports aesthetic. Survive long enough, rack up the wins, and secure your place in the Hall of Fame! SportsBlitz was made by 6 students for our university project.
row.short_description: SportsBlitz, a retro themed micro game collection of sports games.

row.name: ABSØLVE
row.detailed_description: Absølve places the player in the role of an empowered warrior who channels both strength and corruption to face endless waves of enemies. The combat combines precise melee action with dynamic movement mechanics such as dashing, jumping, and ability-based attacks. Each encounter challenges the player to maintain momentum while managing limited-use ability cards that offer powerful attacks or movement options. Monster Waves Face large waves of enemies, where every wave gets harder and harder.. how far will you get? Wheel of Judgement: The Wheel of Judgement  is a unique mechanic where the player draws random abilities from a holy arsenal to empower him during combat, this arsenal grants abilities in randomised fashion causing the player to have little-to-no influence over the abilities that will be granted. Every time an available ability gets used, it will be removed from the player and put back into the  Wheel of Judgement , then the Wheel  will randomly appoint a new ability to the player, replacing the earlier ability. Rage: In order to use these abilities you will need to build the resource called  Rage , this resource automatically builds up when using your light and heavy attacks to hit enemy monsters. Corruption: The corruption adds a risk-reward element, using the Wheel of Judgement  you will gain access to random abilities but not all abilities are created to your advantage.. these are what we call Corruptions  gain and use one these corruptions will activate a negative effect on the player.. so be wise in your decisions on when to active certain abilities. Boss Monsters: Face unique boss monsters (with unique archetypes/mechanics) that each will challenge you in a different way to test your gameplay, tactical and mastery. The player’s journey emphasizes control, spectacle, and skill expression. Every battle rewards mastery, awareness, and creative combinations of attacks and abilities. The experience aims to create a strong feeling of empowerment while still challenging the player to stay composed amid chaos.
row.short_description: Welcome to ABSØLVE, a dark fantasy based hack-and-slash game, where you fight wave after wave of demons hordes using the chaotic Wheel of Judgement system to try and defeat as many monsters as possible in an attempt to gain absolution.

row.name: Cybersoul
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Cybersoul, where high-octane Deckbuilding, glitched-out card games, and a compulsive Souls & Star Power incremental idle system collide in a flash of neon. Jack into the ultimate Cyberpunk Card Battler, launching with 3+ dystopian Factions and over 100 cards. Compiled in the static of a dying world, Cybersoul takes the card battlers you know and hard-wires them into a high-tech, low-life future. Command the scrap-metal juggernauts of the Rust Legion , the chemical-fueled speedsters of the Stim Freaks , and the corporate overlords of the Credit Barons . With over 100 distinctive cards , each surging with cybernetic augmentations and system-breaking hacks, the tactical possibilities are limitless. But the Grid is unforgiving. Engage in visceral, turn-based combat against a ruthless AI that learns your exploits. And when you need to disconnect from the warfare, the Glitch Arcade awaits! Gamble your life away and earn Credits & Energy in corrupted simulations of classics like 9-Player Poker, Blackjack, Pool, Match 3, Chess, Space Invaders, Brick Break, Snooker, and more. Then, set your system to idle farm Soul Coins & Star Power. Spend your ill-gotten credits to upgrade your rig, overclock your cards, and farm resources even while you sleep. 🔋 SYSTEM FEATURES 3+ Dystopian Factions: Master the streets—from the brute force of the Rust Legion to the arcane code of the Stim Freaks and the corrupted wealth of the Credit Barons . 100+ Cybersoul Cards: Compile a deck of cybernetic horrors, viruses, traps, and glitches, each rendered in a visceral analog-horror art style. Neural-Net AI Battles: Test your build against adaptive AI opponents that exploit your weaknesses and show no mercy. Visceral Turn-Based Combat: Fast, brutal, and strategic. Execute combos that shatter the game logic and overload your opponent’s CPU. Deep Deck Optimization: Tailor your loadout with a diverse host of mechs, mutants, and programs. Unlock encrypted data packs to find rare, holographic foils. The Glitch Arcade: Hustle for Credits & Energy in hacked versions of Poker, Pool, Blackjack, Snooker, Chess, and Retro Arcade shooters. Idle Crypto-Mining: Grow your influence and harvest resources from the Mainframe through an expansive idle system. Your wealth grows while you sleep. Acid-Graphic Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in a world of hyper-stylized 'Analog-Glitch' art, neon-soaked environments, and geometric brutalism. 27+ Hour Industrial Soundtrack: Lose your mind to over 27 hours of pounding Synthwave, Dark Techno, and Industrial noise designed to keep your heart rate critical. 819 Corrupted Voiceline Data Logs: Absorb cryptic truths and proverb-packed lore files from a world that has forgotten its own history. Daily Login Rewards: Jack in daily to receive a supply drop of Credits, XP, and Energy. New User Protocol: Learn the systems with interactive tutorials, making it easy for fresh meat and veteran hackers to upload their consciousness. Offline Mode: Hone your skills solo against the machine. No signal required. 💀 UPLOAD YOUR SOUL. BREAK THE SYSTEM. 💀 Cybersoul is a realm where strategy meets static, and humanity meets hardware. Overclock your deck, exploit the code, and engage in neon-soaked battles against the worst the future has to offer. Easier to learn than a firewall, harder to master than the stock market. The System is broken. Exploit it. 💾
row.short_description: Deckbuilding Card Game meets Incremental Data Mining. Command 3+ dystopian factions & 100+ cards in this acid-soaked Cyberpunk Card Battler. Unleash glitch-fueled combos, gamble in a corrupted Arcade, and farm Souls & Star Power in idle clickers. Don't just play the game—break the code and ascend.
row.notes: Cybersoul fully embraces its mature dystopian theme. Players should expect depictions of fantastical violence consistent with a dark, futuristic world.

row.name: LOST IN THE DARK LABYRINTH
row.detailed_description: Can you escape this colossal maze within 60 minutes? Lost in the Dark Labyrinth is a maze-exploration survival FPS set inside a colossal labyrinth built on a near world-largest scale. With only a weak personal light and scattered braziers to guide you, you must navigate twisting corridors and looming chambers and find a way out before time runs out. The maze is huge and deliberately complex. Similar-looking junctions, sudden open spaces, and vertical shifts between floors make it almost impossible to grasp the full layout on your first attempt. The more you challenge it, the more you slowly learn, map, and master the labyrinth in your head. Sneak past threats… or fight for an advantage Dangerous enemies roam the maze, and the tension spikes the moment you sense them nearby. You can try to avoid them and slip past in the dark, or take the risk and engage. Defeating enemies will sometimes cause keys, health items, or coins to drop, giving you a valuable edge in your escape — but only if you survive. Doors, keys, and the path forward The labyrinth features multiple door types and matching keys. As you progress through the stages, new door–key pairs are introduced, and finding the key required in that stage becomes critical to pushing deeper into the maze. If you fail to secure the necessary key, you simply will not reach the exit. Step by step, run by run, you piece together your own personal route to freedom. 60 minutes of pressure and replay This maze is not meant to be cleared on your first attempt. Instead, each run teaches you a little more — a landmark you recognize, a safer corridor, a dead end to avoid next time. The 60-minute time limit keeps every decision sharp, while the enormous scale and branching paths give the game strong replayability and a powerful sense of growth. Evolving structure and difficulty Later stages increase the density of the layout, the danger of threats, and the number of tricks waiting for you. The maze is built so that getting lost, discovering new routes, and gradually understanding the structure is the core of the experience. Explore a massive labyrinth, evade threats, sometimes fight back, collect keys, and escape within 60 minutes. Lost in the Dark Labyrinth delivers simple rules, deep tension, and a huge rush of achievement when you finally break free — a unique blend of maze-exploration and survival FPS.
row.short_description: Explore a colossal labyrinth built on a near world-largest scale in this maze-exploration survival FPS. Rely on a weak light and scattered braziers, collect keys, and decide when to sneak or fight as you race to escape within 60 minutes.

row.name: KhanII M
row.detailed_description: KHAN 2 – The Return of a Legendary Warlord Twenty years after the original KHAN defined an era of early MMORPGs, the legendary world rises again—reborn, renewed, and more powerful than ever. KHAN 2 is the true continuation of a beloved classic, bringing the essence of the original back to life while expanding it for a new generation of adventurers. Step into a vast ancient kingdom shaped by war, faith, and heroic conquest. Become a true “Khan”—a warrior forged in battle, tested by fate, and destined to stand among legends. Experience the Heart of Classic MMORPG Gameplay A Massive World of Myth and War Begin your journey from humble lands and venture through deadly forests, forgotten ruins, sacred temples, and war-torn continents. Discover ancient races, mythical beasts, and dark forces threatening to engulf the realm. Fight, Rise, and Become a Khan Grow stronger through battles, master unique skills, and face powerful enemies in solo challenges, guild wars, and massive kingdom-wide conflicts. An Epic Storyline Continuing the First Game Set years after the original KHAN, the sequel expands the lore with new characters, factions, and sinister threats that push the world toward chaos. All-New Storyline Discover an expanded narrative that follows the events after the first KHAN, introducing new heroes, enemies, and conflicts across the land. Seasonal Battle Pass Progress through monthly seasons, unlock exclusive rewards, weapon skins, costumes, buffs, and special items designed to keep every moment meaningful. Year-Round Events Limited-time quests, special bosses, seasonal festivals, and bonus drop periods ensure the world is always alive and evolving. Tower Challenge (Tae Tower) Climb a multi-floor tower where difficulty increases with each level. Earn greater rewards the higher you ascend—perfect for solo players or group parties. Enhanced Classic MMORPG Combat Faithful to the original KHAN yet rebuilt for smoothness and modern playstyle. Master class abilities, gear upgrades, and fast-paced battles. Modern Gear & Rarity System Collect equipment of various rarities, build your character’s stats, and customize your power progression to suit your playstyle. Strong Community & Guild System Join guilds, participate in massive battles, defeat world bosses, and compete for ranking dominance across the kingdom. Privacy Policy This game requires acceptance of a third-party EULA
row.short_description: The legendary MMORPG returns. KHAN 2 M brings back the classic experience with modern systems—story content, seasonal battle pass, events, and a challenging tower climb filled with escalating rewards.

row.name: SlimyLeap
row.detailed_description: SlimyLeap is a fast-paced pixel-art infinite runner where you play as a brave little slime trying to go as far as possible without dying. Cute, colorful, and just a little chaotic – how far can your slime go? As you go farther, new environments appear: from grassy fields to deep jungle and tall mountains. Each run feels slightly different, with handcrafted level designs and new challenges waiting ahead. But beware – a creeping red fog is always behind you! The farther you go, the faster it moves, leaving no room to stop. Keep jumping, dashing, and moving forward – or be consumed by the mist! Jump, dodge, survive… and collect gems to unlock new skins that let you show off your style!​ Features: • Control your slime with simple swipe gestures: drag your finger/mouse to aim and release to launch • Master the unique dash mechanic: dash mid-air, bounce off enemies, and stay airborne longer • Retro pixel-art style and smooth animations • Fun sound effects and colorful visuals • Unlock new slime skins to customize your look​ • Local best-score system – beat your own record • No ads, no internet required Can you keep the slime alive long enough to become a legend? Challenge yourself and see how far you can leap! This game includes both original assets created by the developer and third-party assets, which were used under their respective free asset licenses.​ Asset Credits: Tilemaps, backgrounds, and some spritesheets by Ansimuz Chest spritesheet by Admurin
row.short_description: SlimyLeap is a fast-paced pixel-art infinite runner where you play as a brave little slime trying to go as far as possible without dying.

row.name: A Father's Growth Spurt
row.detailed_description: Enjoy this short 15-minute first chapter of A Father's Growth Spurt. Which includes:  Resource Management:  Choose each day between maintaining the water and fertilizer levels, or weeding out the bonsai pot. If you don't keep the water and fertilizer levels at each weeks random level for three days, the bonsai will die from malnutrition.  Ensure that weeds never encroach on the bonsai's stem; otherwise, no matter how well you've been mai ntain ing the bonsai, the weeds will ultimately kill it.  Purposeful Limited UI:  Just like in real life, there is no UI to help keep track of the water and fertilizer levels. This is an intentional design; you need to be aware of the bonsai yourself. You can keep track of any way you seem fit and use in-game clues to help you along the way.  Storytelling:  Enjoy a story based on reality between a grandfather, father, and grandchild as they work through the intricacies of life together. Over the span of four weeks, you will talk with both your father and son as the first chapter of A Father's Growth Spurt unravels.
row.short_description: Juggle the tasks of taking care of a bonsai by monitoring the water, fertilizer, and weeds in the same pot, all while witnessing the short linear narrative between the 3 generations of the same family.
row.notes: The topic of death and the grief that comes after is a heavy plot point in the story of A Father's Growth Spurt.

row.name: Escape Games World vs Escapers
row.detailed_description: Welcome to 'Escape Games World vs Escapers' by HFG ENTERTAINMENTS! Immerse yourself in an intricate puzzle adventure, where you'll unlock secrets, solve mysteries, and crack codes. Explore hidden chambers and navigate through cryptic corridors in this thrilling escape game. Can you unravel the enigma and escape in time? Game Story 1: A climber’s peaceful mountain ascent turns into a deadly fight for survival. As darkness closes in, hidden clues and mysterious room objects reveal betrayal, a corrupt climbing agency, and a shocking conspiracy buried deep in the mountains. Game Story 2: During a Christmas vacation, a disabled boy discovers a magical world with his talking penguin and snow fox friends. When they vanish the next year, he returns alone to uncover a chilling truth—a devil queen has captured them. Solve snowy puzzles, unlock hidden doors, and rescue the magical kingdom. Game Story 3: A boy from a Himalayan village sets out to conquer Mount Everest at Christmas, only to be pulled into a frozen mystery world. Battling blizzards, ice creatures, and ancient riddles, he must uncover hidden clues and stop the Winter’s Wreath before it destroys the mountain—and Christmas itself. Game Story 4: After receiving a mysterious book, a young boy is transported into a magical Christmas world as an elf. With Santa’s help, he must explore dangerous escape rooms, solve puzzles, and uncover hidden clues to defeat a monster threatening the Reindeer World. ESCAPE GAME MODULE: Embark on exhilarating escapades delving into unsolved mysteries awaiting your keen detective skills. Each meticulously crafted room invites thorough investigation, promising a unique puzzle-solving challenge. With every clue deciphered, inch closer to unraveling the overarching truth behind each thrilling case. LOGIC PUZZLES & MINI-GAMES: If you thrive on the thrill of cracking codes and unraveling mysteries, our escape room adventures are tailor-made for you. Dive into our immersive games where each puzzle serves as a mental workout, promising both challenge and gratification. Engage in a quest where deciphering cryptic clues and uncovering hidden secrets propel you towards the ultimate truth. GAME FEATURES: *Immersive 95 challenging levels. *Puzzle walkthrough videos are now available. *Play and enjoy the new casual games! *Challenge with friends feature added *Request and share coins with your friends! *Exciting 4 chapters & 4 different stories. *Daily rewards available for free coins . *Enjoy daily free spin rewards. *Attractive 100+ variety of puzzles! *Step-by-step hints on features available *Localized in 26 major languages. *Gather tools and items to aid in your escape! *Find hidden objects that help you escape! *Dynamic gameplay options available. *Suitable for all gender age groups Available in 26 languages---- (English, Arabic, Chinese Simplified, Chinese Traditional, Czech, Danish, Dutch, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Vietnamese)
row.short_description: Unlock the world! Solve 95 thrilling escape room levels & hidden object puzzle

row.name: Cube Dodger 3D
row.detailed_description: Cube Dodger 3D is a high-speed, neon-soaked arcade runner about pure survival. You pilot a glowing cube ship down an endless highway while waves of enemy cubes get faster, larger, and smarter the longer you stay alive. Simple controls, brutal difficulty, and a ridiculous rank ladder make every run a tight, score-chasing challenge. Features Fast, responsive left/right movement and a one-button shield Dynamic difficulty: cubes speed up, grow, and gain moving / homing behavior as you progress Ship Garage with score-unlock ships, premium cosmetics, and a legendary shield-heavy ship Road Garage and Enemy Garage to customize the look of the highway and cubes Local saves only: high scores, unlocks, and equipped cosmetics live on your machine Steam achievements for ship-specific score milestones and an extreme 1000-point goal There are no ads, no online accounts, and no grind passes—just you, your reflexes, and an endless wall of cubes trying to end the run.
row.short_description: Cube Dodger 3D is a fast, neon arcade runner. Slide along a glowing highway, dodge smarter and faster cubes, charge your shield, unlock ships, roads and enemy skins, and chase brutal score-based Steam achievements

row.name: Untold Story
row.detailed_description: Synopsis Rover Wilson had a pretty simple life; he went to school, learned about using the Elements, did his homework, and spent time with friends. Then one day a strange group of people appear near a mysterious monument. After the encounter, Rover's entire world as he knew it is about to get flipped upside down. After being teleported away from his home, Rover finds himself in unfamiliar lands, stranded and alone. What begins as a simple search to find his friends and his way back home will become a quest to save the world. His life will be anything but simple from then on.  About Untold Story is a turn-based, party-based RPG with an emphasis on characters and story. Players will follow Rover Wilson on his journey, gaining new allies, completing quests, and learning the history of the world in the process. Manage your actions in battle well, and strategize the best approach to take down the fiercest of foes!  Explore the world, meet the characters, complete their quests, earn rewards, and hear their stories! Every single NPC is unique, with their own design, behavior, personality, and story!  Almost 200 Quests to complete! From mandatory story quests, to a plethora of side stories that explore the characters and unravel the history of the world of Atomous.  Friend Conversations explore inter party relationships and boost stats. Hidden Items are found throughout, and always present a visual cue to their location. Observe your surroundings, and be rewarded for it! Hundreds of collectibles! From Friend Conversations, to Hidden Items, to books about the world itself. Find them all and get to 100%! Nothing is missable! Every single quest and every single collectible can be obtained from the first opportunity all the way until the no going back point. Doing quests at different points in the story may even offer different dialogue as well!  Many Monsters and fierce foes are abound as well. Master the combat and take down even the hardest of enemies! Each character gets a single action per turn--the order they take those actions, and what they do, is up for you to decide! Strategize the best plan, and win! Every action requires Energy, with more powerful skills requiring more Energy to preform. Characters naturally gain Energy each turn. Equipment can alter this gain, or change the Energy cost of skills. Find the perfect balance! Every character has their own unique skill set. To exploiting weaknesses, inflicting statuses, and even changing the battle field, everyone has a use. Synergize with other party members and efficiently win each battle. Unleash Decisive Skills at pivotal moments to change the tide of battle. Every character gets a unique skill, while several others can be taught to anyone at your choosing.  Swap party members mid battle! Every turn you are free to switch the party however you like. Think carefully, once an action is taken, the party is locked for that turn! There are three additional difficulty modes for players to enjoy: Beginner Mode reduces damage taken & increases EXP earned. Hard Mode  limits the party max to 3 members [Opposed to 5], requiring more precise action management in battle. Story Mode  boosts the stats of all characters, reduces damage taken, grants regen, and doubles EXP earned, so players can focus more on the story, and less on the battles and combat.
row.short_description: A modernized turn-based RPG. Go on an adventure with your party, battle tough monsters and fierce foes, and save the world! A large cast with unique skills creates strategic turn based combat, with plenty of challenges to face.

row.name: Oh Balls Merge
row.detailed_description: Drop, merge, score - 'Oh Balls' is an addictive game. Merge matching balls to create bigger ones and aim for high scores. Stay alert to prevent the stack from reaching the top. Challenge your skills, chase the highest score, and enjoy the ball-merging frenzy of 'Oh Balls'! Install now for endless fun 🙂
row.short_description: Drop, merge, and score! Immerse yourself in the addictive ball-merging mania of Oh Balls and see how high you can go.

row.name: Dreadmyst
row.detailed_description: Dreadmyst is a fantasy online MMO with tab-target combat and deep build customization. Combine abilities from multiple skill trees to craft unique playstyles, conquer dungeons and bosses for powerful gear, and prove your strength in competitive arenas through both PvE and PvP gameplay.  Four playable classes Paladin : Divine warriors devoted to honor and piety. They live to defend, protect and serve all believers. Can use Shields and Melee weapons. Mage : Powerful arcane spellcasters born with magic in their blood who gradually learn to harness their innate abilities over time. Can use Staves and Wands. Ranger:  A wanderer in the wilds, their fierce independence makes them well suited to adventuring and mischief. Can use Bows and Daggers. Cleric : Best known as healers, they are members of the divine faith who have the ability to cast priest spells from the gods they worship. Can use Shields, Staves and Maces. Character Customization Allocate points across core attributes like Strength, Agility, Willpower, Intelligence, and Courage to shape your playstyle. Each stat impacts combat effectiveness, weapon proficiency, and survival capabilities. Level up abilities for enhanced power. Dungeons Team up with three other players to tackle challenging dungeon content. Groups need one tank, one healer, and two DPS to succeed. Face deadly boss mechanics that require coordination and timing. Earn powerful loot and rare materials exclusive to these encounters. Higher difficulties offer better rewards but demand tighter execution. Or, run dungeons on your own. Face elite packs and mini-bosses while collecting loot in classic ARPG-style dungeon crawling action. Arenas Test your skills in competitive arena brackets. Quick matches where coordination and ability timing determine victory. Chain your crowd control perfectly and punish opponents' cooldowns to climb the ranks. Combat That Feels Right Crisp, responsive controls. Classes built around clear, powerful feedback. The kind of polish that just feels good to play. Dreadmyst was built with a custom C/C++ engine written in OpenGL. Gameplay is balanced through strength, not weakness. Every class is packed with abilities that feel good. Truly Free This game is non-profit in nature. There are no plans to introduce paid content or monetization.
row.short_description: Dreadmyst is an online fantasy RPG running on its own engine. Customize your stats and abilities as you slaughter the aberrations plaguing a cursed land. Choose from four playable classes, level up, farm gear, run dungeons (PvE), and fight other players (PvP). Tab target combat.

row.name: Whistle1 - Retro Football Manager
row.detailed_description: THE ORIGINAL IS BACK Anpfiff1 is a retro football manager in 90s style. Manage a German 1st league club. Handle transfers, training, tactics and lead your team through league, cup and European competitions. ⚽90s GAMEPLAY Feels like classic managers Transparent systems, charmingly presented Football management with humor ⚽USER FILES Import community databases The community creates, you play 🏆ONLINE LEADERBOARD Compare your career with players worldwide Global highscores for every difficulty level 📊10-SEASON CAREER Your goal: Survive 10 seasons Collect titles, expand your stadium, become national team coach ⚽COMPETITIONS 1st League (18 teams) DFB Cup (64 teams) Champions League Europa League Conference League Relegation & Playoffs 📈MANAGEMENT Player transfers 9 training areas Stadium expansion (5 levels) Finances & sponsoring Interviews & press conferences ⚽MATCH SIMULATION Live events with commentary Lineup & tactics 5 intensity levels Text mode with humorous surprises ⚽CAREER Multi-season progression Form system (0-20) Team morale (0-8) Manager reputation 🌍LANGUAGES Deutsch, English, Türkçe 💡DEVELOPMENT Indie project with AI assistance (Claude Code). Developed on Shadow PC. Passion over perfection.
row.short_description: Whistle1 is a retro football manager in 90s style. Manage a German 1st league club, handle transfers and training, and lead your team through league, cup and European competitions to glory.

row.name: Brother Hai's Pho Restaurant
row.detailed_description: A TASTE OF VIETNAM, A SLICE OF HORROR. Brother Hai's Pho Restaurant is a story-driven psychological horror game, deeply inspired by Vietnamese culture, real-life events, and the unique atmosphere of Hanoi's suburban villages. Made with the Godot Engine, the game offers a glimpse into the everyday life of Vietnam that often goes unseen in media—mixed with a chilling, unfolding mystery. If you enjoy narrative-rich games, unique cultural settings, and a blend of cooking simulation with true psychological dread, step into Anh Hai's kitchen. 📜 STORY: THE DARK SIDE OF DAN PHUONG Step into the shoes of Anh Hai , the new owner of a small pho restaurant in a seemingly peaceful village in Dan Phuong District, Hanoi. Your day starts simple: run a thriving business, serve steaming bowls of pho, and socialize with the local townsfolk. But the serene facade quickly cracks. As you settle in, Anh Hai gradually uncovers a dark and unsettling mystery shrouding the village. To keep his restaurant running, protect what he holds dear, and survive the strange occurrences, Anh Hai must confront unexpected, harrowing events and the haunting secrets of his own past. Every interaction, every decision, and every bowl of pho served holds a clue to the truth. ✨ KEY FEATURES 🍲 Unique Pho Restaurant Simulation: Experience the authentic process of making and serving traditional Vietnamese Pho. Handle customer orders precisely, from the cut of meat (tái/chín) to the garnishes (quẩy, bò viên, cơm nguội). 🔪 Gripping Psychological Horror: A rich and thrilling storyline filled with plot twists, building genuine suspense and atmospheric dread, culminating in intense final moments. 🇻🇳 Immersive Vietnamese Setting: Explore a rural Vietnamese village with highly detailed retro graphics, bringing to life local culture and relatable, real-world inspirations. 🐾 Protect Mr. Gold: Interact with and protect your loyal canine companion, a surprisingly emotional and pivotal part of the storyline. Don't forget to pet the dog! 🎬 Cinematic Presentation: Features cinematic cutscenes and a compelling narrative to draw you deeper into Anh Hai's disturbing reality. 💀 Multiple Endings: The choices you make determine Anh Hai's fate, leading to one of 4 distinct endings. ⏱️ Compact & Intense Experience: A focused playtime of approximately 30 minutes to 1 hour allows for high replayability across different ending paths.
row.short_description: A story-driven psychological horror game where you must balance cooking authentic Vietnamese Pho with surviving chilling, unexpected events in a quiet, mysterious village.

row.name: Potion Knight
row.detailed_description: Potion Knight is a first person 'shooter' with intense and up-tempo elements. This game combines the need for speed with tactical potion throwing in this endless satisfying yet chaotic fast runner and faster slider experience. Set in the coldest days of medieval times in a harsh snow ridden village of Cronenberg. A place where every creature is out to steal that last bit of warmth out of your body. Your goal is to defeat all enemies and kill the corrupt alchemist to free Cronenberg from its grasp.  Step into the cold, wintery world of PSX inspired graphics filled with strange and unsettling enemies straight from the ‘illuminated manuscripts of old’ and try your hand at conquering this strange menagerie. Luckily you can kill these gut-wrenching creatures with your trusty weapon, the ancient art of alchemy! Throw potions at the right enemy or get faced with the consequences if you throw the wrong elixir.  Made for everyone who wants to play challenging levels that are procedurally generated to make every run different from the last.
row.short_description: Potion Knight is an intense and up-tempo first-person shooter that combines the need for speed with tactical potion throwing. Set in the harsh snow ridden village of Cronenberg where an unorthodox alchemist has been fusing animals with weapons to fight under his command.
row.notes: The game includes the killing of mutated animals, nothing too graphic, but the animals itself can read as gore. There are non-descript corpses in the game.

row.name: Running Beehind
row.detailed_description: Running Beehind is a speed-based third-person platformer set in the buzzing city of Waspington , where fast deliveries and fluid movement keep the Hive alive. As a delivery worker at Co. Hive, you can sprint, swing, and bounce through an insect metropolis, master expressive traversal, and plan the most efficient delivery routes before the clock runs out! The city is built like a living playground, offering shortcuts and hidden routes in every zone. Using grapples, sticky honeycomb walls, and trampolines, players are encouraged to explore and refine their movement, turning each delivery into a fast-paced puzzle of speed and flow! Along your delivery route, you’ll meet all sorts of diverse characters, each with their own fears and stories. But one pattern quickly becomes clear: the further you stray from the Hive, the more you see the sticky, not-so-sweet impact that Co. Hive has on Waspington. Its citizens are cornered into two choices: work with the corporation… or push against it. But you , the player, don’t have to pick just one. Using your company-issued gear, you can access hidden nooks and crannies, using them to send a very pointed message back to the big bees upstairs. Players can secretly disrupt production lines or leave messages across The Hive . Vandalism slows down corporate operations and reveals hidden paths the company tries to keep buried. Through exploration, dialogue, and choice-driven gameplay, Running Beehind allows players to decide whether to serve the Hive or sting it from within. FEATURES Speed-based third-person platforming focused on expressive movement; Fluid traversal using grapples, sticky walls, and trampolines; Multiple delivery routes that reward exploration and mastery; Distinct zones to explore, including the Hive, the Butterfly Farm, and the Roachlands; A choice-driven narrative with dialogue and multiple endings; Vandalism mechanics that tie player action directly into story outcomes; A colorful insect city filled with memorable characters and environmental storytelling.
row.short_description: Run fast, take risky shortcuts, and deliver food across Waspington or choose to rebel against your Hive; after all, nothing says job security like a perfectly timed landing.

row.name: Uninvited: Security Service
row.detailed_description: A butler, a mansion and missing people , you don’t need to be Sherlock Holmes to guess what’s happening, but someone has to look into it, and its going to be you! In this simple stealth/exploration game with graphics inspired by ASCII games, you’ll have to search around the mansion for keys and notes while you hide and, overall, just try to not be broken in half by the butler. Play as Ricardo , a foolhardy teenager that after an incident in his summer job, involving him being dragged around a forest, finds himself in front of a mansion that has a murderous butler inside, he sure has a great 'luck' , but don’t worry about him! He's used to this stuff. Go for a stroll around the mansion, search for notes that tell you some employees gossip, or maybe find a key to open a closed door. You can also go greet the butler if you want, but I wont take responsibility for what happens. If you decided to go greet the butler, then I can introduce you to the main game’s mechanic, evading the butler is your main focus, since, to your misfortune, if he grabs you he’s not going to comfortably let you outside the mansion, this guy is not that nice to intruders. Run. Hide. And move silently. Because even if he’s not the most brilliant, he’s still the one who knows how to move around the mansion. Some employees unhappy about their bosses not listening about their concerns with the new butler and a Ricardo that is trying to find out what happened to the aforementioned employees, it’s not a story worth of a Noble Prize in Literature, but my boy Ricardo and the events that happens to him in the mansion will try to make you laugh so at least you’ll have a good time. And who knows! Maybe you’ll get a peek to an actual story and all. Around 1 to 2 hours of content . A stealth/exploration gameplay inspired by horror games (this is not a horror game, don’t worry, the only scary thing here is the game’s code). Comical story and dialogues. Pixel Art inspired by ASCII games and their graphical editions. A Green Hat, to your misfortune.
row.short_description: Uninvited: Security Service is a really simple stealth/exploration game where you sneak around a mansion while avoiding the butler that lives in there. Learn about the foolhardy protagonist and the stupid chain of events that led to the situation that’s happening there.

row.name: Everyday Devil
row.detailed_description: Ah, what's a devil to do in this day and age... Looking back at the past, I'm not sure if I learnt anything. Was there something to, in the first place? May you be my judge, jury and executioner, dear player, as you venture through my mind and life. Through my mistakes and plights. Welcome, to my everyday~ A short, linear story game revolving around fragments of a random demon guy's life. The scattered pieces of memory are short, and somewhat disjointed... it's mostly a lot of walking and talking. The style of it may be a little different between each vignette, depending on Cecil's feelings at the time. It's a strange world, full of darkness. But it's just everyday life for him. I hope you understand. FEATURES About an hour long experience Atmospheric levels of varying styles Characterization of creatures to both love and hate A feeling of despair, but also of coziness CONTENT WARNING Contains themes of abuse, alcoholism, animal harm, blood/gore, violence and has flashing/eyestrain
row.short_description: A short, linear story game of a random demon guy's life.
row.notes: WARNING: Contains themes of abuse, alcoholism, animal harm, blood/gore, violence and has flashing/eyestrain

row.name: Geenius : Cupid Dough
row.detailed_description: Sprint to the rhythm in this fast-paced runner game featuring GEENIUS’s new single, Cupid Dough . Freely Customize Your Vocal Parts Run to the right, collect glowing point orbs, and switch between five playable characters in real time. Each character change instantly swaps the song’s vocal part, letting you experience the track in a dynamic and interactive way as you play. A Song That’s Truly Yours—Unavailable on Streaming Platforms After each run, your score is converted into gold, which you can use to unlock instrument parts . Rearrange and combine these instruments to rebuild the song and create your own unique version of Cupid Dough . Short, fast-paced runner gameplay with simple controls Real-time character switching that changes vocal parts on the fly Score-based progression and instrument part collection Music editing system to rearrange and customize the song Based on the official music from 5-member K-pop group GEENIUS
row.short_description: A fast-paced runner game powered by GEENIUS’s new single Cupid Dough. Run, collect orbs, and switch between five characters to change vocal parts in real time. Earn gold, unlock instruments, and remix the song to create your own version.

row.name: What the Healer Left Behind
row.detailed_description: How many times have you used resurrection in an RPG? A party member falls in combat. You open the menu and use a spell, an item, or an ability. And then the character returns as if nothing had happened, and the mission continues. But… what if something had happened? In What the Healer Left Behind, you take on the role of a swordsman sent on a common guild mission. Just retrieve an item, return to the village, and maybe give a report. The mission fails. Not everyone returns. And someone is brought back. The village is still there. The houses are still standing. The streets look the same. But something doesn't fit. The silence lingers. The healer's presence becomes unsettling. Fragments of information emerge where they shouldn't. As the night progresses, the world begins to behave strangely, and little by little, it becomes clear that the resurrection was not a neutral act, it was a choice. Everything points to a single isolated place, far from the village. A place where something was left behind. And that shouldn't have been brought back. What the Healer Left Behind is a first-person psychological horror experience about faith, trust, and the unseen consequences of accepting miracles without question. A short game, focused on atmosphere, environmental narrative, and growing unease where the horror doesn't come from death, but from what insists on remaining alive. Features First-person narrative experience Psychological horror focused on atmosphere and tension Structure divided into acts, with clear narrative progression Retro visual style inspired by games from the early 2000s Short and experimental game, focused on sensation over combat
row.short_description: Welcome to what's left behind. Explore a silent village after a failed mission and discover, little by little, that not every cure is a miracle. What the Healer Left Behind is a short, atmospheric first-person psychological horror game where unease grows with every step.
row.notes: This game contains implicit violence and themes related to death, resurrection, and psychological horror. There is no explicit depiction of murder, but some scenes may be unsettling for sensitive players.

row.name: Dunjinn
row.detailed_description: Dunjinn is a deliberate, turn-based crawl where every step advances enemies, so stealth, noise, and light control matter. Procedural floors mix rooms, winding halls, traps, mimics, locked doors, and loot that drops to the ground if your 20-slot pack is full. Combat runs off a gear-driven action bar: melee, ranged, shields, augments (teleport, cloak, barrier), accessories, and consumables add abilities with cooldowns and status effects; durability can shatter weapons or armor mid-fight. Light sources burn fuel and affect vision and detection. Between dives the Free Quarter is your safe loop: rest at the inn, shop only common gear, craft/repair/upgrade with salvaged essence, appraise unidentified finds, and stash extras in a 50-slot vault. Death wipes what you carry but not your vault or progress—push deeper for rarer drops, essence, and nemesis encounters.
row.short_description: Turn-based dungeon crawl, every step advances foes; stealth, noise, and light matter. Procedural rooms mix traps, mimics, locks, loot; combat is gear-driven with augments, consumables, and breakable durability. Between runs use town to shop, craft/repair, vault gear; death drops your pack.

row.name: リベンジ・ハート
row.detailed_description: 「４日後に、俺の心臓を撃ちぬいて殺して欲しい」 リベンジ・ハートはワガママな殺し屋ケヴィンと、心臓を狙われた少年ルカが繰り広げる一本道ノベルADVです。 ――引き金が引かれるその時まで。 復讐を願う少年と、それに加担した殺し屋の４日間が始まる。 ■ストーリー 殺し屋ケヴィンの元に来た、少年からの不可解な依頼。 「４日後に、俺の心臓を撃ちぬいて殺して欲しい」 報酬１億に釣られて引き受けたケヴィンは、依頼人の少年ルカを狙うマフィア、ルートヴィヒ・ファミリーに追われる身となってしまう。 彼らの狙いはルカの心臓。 ルカの双子の兄・エリックは人気アイドルグループ「ミスティック・コメット」のセンターで、心臓に重い病を抱えていた。 助かる方法はただ一つ、弟・ルカの心臓を移植すること。 「コンサートが終わった後、俺の心臓はエリックに提供される。だから逃げて来た」 「なぁケヴィン。俺の復讐に、手を貸してくれよ」 ワガママな殺し屋と心臓を狙われた少年が辿る、復讐の４日間 ■概要 ・プレイ時間６時間前後 ・END数１ ・スチル枚数１４０枚以上 ・OPムービーあり ■実況について ・実況歓迎、収益化関係OKです ・個別で許可を取る必要はありません ・タイトルor説明文にゲームタイトル「リベンジ・ハート」の表記をお願いします ・ゲームファイルからの画像の抜き出しはNGですが、スチルをサムネに使う・必要に応じての加工はOKです ・誹謗中傷目的など、見てる人が楽しめない内容はダメです。楽しく実況してね！ ・クリア後のエクストラのみ実況NGです ・これ以外にも作者が不適切と判断したものは削除申請をする場合があります
row.short_description: 「４日後に、俺の心臓を撃ちぬいて殺して欲しい」 リベンジ・ハートはワガママな殺し屋ケヴィンと、心臓を狙われた少年ルカが繰り広げる一本道ノベルADVです。 ――引き金が引かれるその時まで。復讐を願う少年とそれに加担した殺し屋の４日間が始まる。
row.notes: このゲームは全年齢層向けではないコンテンツを含んでいる、または職場での閲覧に適してない可能性があります：暴力表現やゴア表現の頻出, 大人向けコンテンツ全般

row.name: S.P.E.C.T.O.R 01
row.detailed_description: You are a soldier in the distant future on a solo rescue mission codenamed S.P.E.C.T.O.R 01. Aliens have taken over certain areas around earth and have taken one of your fellow soldiers hostage. You are tasked with finding your fellow soldier and bringing them to safety. Features to expect: 3rd Person Shooter Gameplay Multiple Weapons Gun/Melee Combat Exploration Hover Vehicle Driving Short Mission Briefing Cutscenes QuickTime Events Stealth Included in download: Base Game
row.short_description: S.P.E.C.T.O.R 01 is a Third-Person SCI-FI action shooter. You are a soldier in the distant future on a solo rescue mission codenamed S.P.E.C.T.O.R 01. Aliens have taken over certain areas around earth and have taken one of your fellow soldiers hostage. Your task is to bring them to safety.

row.name: Just Kill It
row.detailed_description: About This Game Just Kill It is a top-down survival shooter focused on pure combat intensity and build-driven progression. Endless waves of enemies approach from all directions, growing exponentially over time. What begins as scattered foes quickly turns into dense encirclement, and eventually an overwhelming flood that nearly fills the screen. Every second tests your movement, positioning, and build decisions. Relentless Enemy Pressure Enemies attack from all sides with increasing density From small groups to full-screen swarms in the late game Multiple enemy types: Close-range swarmers High-health enemies Mixed wave compositions Terrain and paths affect kiting, positioning, and crowd control Late-game “red tide” moments deliver pure survival pressure Kill. Level Up. Become Overpowered. Defeat enemies to gain experience and level up. Each level presents a random upgrade choice , allowing you to shape your build run by run: Increase damage or attack speed Boost critical chance and critical damage Hit more targets per attack Improve movement speed for survival Clear, stackable stat growth ensures every upgrade has a visible impact on combat flow. Global Leaderboards Built-in online leaderboards let you compete with players worldwide: Player name and country tracking Total kills ranking Survival time ranking You are not just challenging the game — you are competing against other players’ best runs.
row.short_description: Just Kill It is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter.Shoot, survive, level up, and build your own playstyle as endless waves of enemies close in — then push your limits on the global leaderboards.

row.name: Green Tea Field Mayhem
row.detailed_description: Teatime Tussle: Defend the Leaf! (Game Description) Set against the beautiful Boseong Green Tea Fields of South Korea, this is a thrilling multiplayer psychological hide-and-seek game. Choose your role: become an adorable Tea Fairy protecting the tea leaves from mischievous Dokkaebi, or be a Dokkaebi tasked with stealing them. Gameplay This game reinterprets the Boseong Green Tea Fields into a sprawling, intricate multiplayer maze focused on strategic hide-and-seek, psychological warfare, stealth, and collection. The Tea Fairy Vulnerability & Stealth: The Fairy's figure is easily exposed over the maze walls, making their position quickly visible. They can crouch to conceal their appearance, but this significantly reduces their movement speed. Mission: Chase and catch all the Dokkaebies, before they manage to steal the required tea leaves. The Dokkaebi Concealment & Risk: Dokkaebies are completely hidden by the maze walls. They can Jump to secure vision beyond the maze, but this action risks being instantly spotted by the Fairy. Mission: Collect all the mission tea leaves without being caught. Core Feature The key enjoyment lies in the strategic choice and execution of actions by all players, utilizing the constant risk-reward structure between concealment and exposure. Despite the cute graphics, experience the thrilling psychological battle that feels like a combination of hide-and-seek and Whack-A-Mole through momentary exposure.
row.short_description: Set against the beautiful Boseong Green Tea Fields of South Korea, this is a thrilling multiplayer psychological hide-and-seek game. Choose your role: become an adorable Tea Fairy protecting the tea leaves from mischievous Dokkaebi, or be a Dokkaebi tasked with stealing them.

row.name: EmuDevz
row.detailed_description: A game about building emulators! In the year 32767, the world suffered a massive cyber attack which destroyed the entire Internet. Since then, you and an online friend are trying to understand the sparse pieces of documentation about the NEEES , an ancient game console released in 1983. With your programming skills, you'll have to build an emulator that runs those old games, helping preserve video game history. Key features Full 🕹️ NEEES emulation guide from scratch, in JavaScript Interactive 🔨 6502 Assembly tutorial Implement 🧠 CPU, 🖥️ PPU, and 🔊 APU in any order Play 👾 homebrew games to unlock ROMs 🧪 Unit tests, video tests, and audio tests are provided 💻 Unix-style shell and code editor 🎶 Original retro-synthwave soundtrack 📃 Included documentation and in-game dictionary 🗣️ Fully localized into English and Spanish 🐞 Powerful debugger with Memory Viewer , Disassembly ,  Name tables , CHR , Sprites , Palettes , APU Channels ,  Controllers , and Emulator Logging 🔭 Free mode to use the IDE to develop emulators for other systems! This game requires programming knowledge. If you can't write code yet, turn back while you still can 😅
row.short_description: A game about building emulators! Implement your own NEEES core in JavaScript, get instant feedback with unit/video tests, build the graphics unit in real time, learn 6502 assembly, debug test ROMs, and have fun with the included homebrew games!
row.reviews: “EmuDevz is Literally a Software Game” Hackaday

row.name: Orbital Fighter
row.detailed_description: Dodge! Deflect! Unleash! Take control of a fighter ship in this space-themed flight action game. Master the game’s signature mechanics— Just Dodge and Just Parry —to suppress the planetary fortress that serves as the rebel army’s stronghold. Dodge enemy attacks at the very last moment to store energy , then release it all at once with a powerful parry ! Experience the thrill of narrowly avoiding relentless enemy fire and the exhilarating rush of perfectly timed parries. Supported Controllers Xbox Controller Controls MOVE : Left Stick REFLECT (Parry) : RB Button DODGE : LB Button
row.short_description: Take control of a fighter ship in this space-themed flight action game. Master the game’s signature mechanics—Just Dodge and Just Parry—to suppress the planetary fortress that serves as the rebel army’s stronghold.

row.name: The Physical
row.detailed_description: **ARE YOU THE PERFECT PHYSICAL? ** The massive doors open to a blinding white stadium. Inside, thousands of identical low-poly clones are stretching, running, and preparing. You are one of them. **The Physical** is not just a game; it is a clinical examination of your gaming capabilities. Your goal is simple yet brutal: Outperform every other clone and prove you possess the **No.1 Physical** . * THE TRIALS * Prepare to test every limit of your hands and brain across a variety of punishing game modes: * SPLIT-BRAIN COORDINATION * Hand Eye:  Sync left (ZASX) and right (Arrows) inputs to the beat without error. Lateral Drill:  Independent agility test—control two agents via Keyboard & Mouse. Box Jump:  Control 4 characters simultaneously across varying speeds. * REFLEXES & TIMING * Ghost Step:  Switch Black & White stances instantly to phase through attacks. Wall Ball:  Account for gravity to hit the teleporting target. One miss fails. Cadence:  Run to the beat, then mash keys frantically for the final sprint. * ENDURANCE & WILLPOWER * Sisyphus:  Fight gravity to push the boulder using raw button-mashing speed. Dead Hang * Hold complex key combinations for 60 seconds without letting go. * KEY FEATURES  * Scientific Ranking System: Every run is recorded. Compare your 'Physical Score' globally. Escaping Conformity: Earn currency to unlock skins and stand out from the white clones. No RNG, Just Skill: No luck involved. If you fail, your physical wasn't good enough. **Welcome to the exam. Good luck, Subject.** * Credits * Icon made by Freepik from Icon made by verluk from Icon made by Any Icon from Icon made by The Icon Tree from Icon made by Smashicons from Icon made by Pixel perfect from Icon made by Md Tanvirul Haque from Icon made by Fahmi Yahya from Icon made by Mayor Icons from Icon made by lalawidi from Icon made by VectorPortal from Icon made by littleicon from
row.short_description: Enter the white void. Compete against thousands of clones for the title of 'No.1 Physical.' This is a ruthless examination of your reflexes, precision, and endurance. Master punishing trials—from split-brain multitasking to button-mashing agony. Customize, survive, and dominate the leaderboard.

row.name: RK Override
row.detailed_description: **INCOMING BROADCAST** For 50 years, Synergy Corporation has secured our prosperous nation and saved us from tyranny. Today, under the landmark Preservation Statute, the art of modern warfare has changed for the better. Our compliant mechanical mission systems contain our threats at no risk to human life. Our 4th generation Mecha systems have now been accepted into service by your government. 10,000 new units will be delivered over 5 years under a 50 billion dollar contract, creating thousands of jobs at the newly expanded Synergy Central Plant. We have sworn to defend our way of life, and will do everything in our technological power to defeat anyone standing in the way of progress and peace. Reverence to Synergy Corp and glory to our pilots. **END BROADCAST** The only hope against the Scrapper’s endless onslaught has always been Synergy Corp. They have defended the country for years, and managed to convince the Scrappers to agree to the Preservation Statute, ensuring that neither side kills the other. Conflicts are carried out using Mecha, with each Synergy Mecha Captain being assigned an RK System, an Automated Replicant Knowledge System that helps copilot their Mecha and ensure the statute is maintained. Assume the role of Chimera, a Mecha Captain of Synergy Corp, as they fight in this endless war. They have never truly believed in the statute, trusting neither the Scrappers nor Synergy Corp. They believe the only way to end the war is to break the statute and wipe out the Scrappers once and for all. Chimera’s RK System “Ki”, who is optimistic and hopeful about the world, disagrees with their outlook, and tries to convince them to see value in the statute. When Chimera's Mecha Squadron is deployed on a mission to defend the Synergy Central Plant from an invading Scrapper force, the status quo unexpectedly changes, and the fate of the conflict is put in Chimera’s hands. KEY FEATURES Immerse yourself in an hour-long fully voiced narrative Assume the role of Chimera as they fight in the ruthless conflict between Synergy Corp and the Scrappers Experience 2D animated cutscenes and 3D in-engine cinematics as Chimera attempts to alter the course of the war When in breach of the Statute, your RK System will interfere with your Mecha’s controls - fight back to ensure you achieve your goals
row.short_description: RK Override is an hour-long fully voiced interactive narrative following Chimera, a Mecha Captain fighting in an endless war for their country’s future. Fight for control against your Mecha’s AI copilot (RK System) as you attempt to end the conflict - no matter the cost.
row.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages. It contains Mild Profanity and General Mature Content.

row.name: PlaneShift
row.detailed_description: PlaneShift is a Role Playing Game immersed into a 3D virtual fantasy world! A medieval world, with many cities to explore, monsters to fight, weapons and equipment to find and craft. Old school as we are one of the first free MMOs! Made and maintained by volunteers (as a hobby!) Original setting and lore 9 playable races with unique traits Professions and crafting through a skill system Original magic system with six Ways of magic Hundreds of quests Many cities and outdoors to explore Open development approach, anyone can contribute Available for Windows, Linux and Mac
row.short_description: PlaneShift is a Role Playing Game immersed into a 3D virtual fantasy world! A medieval world, with many cities to explore, monsters to fight, weapons and equipment to find and craft. A skill based progression system, magic and many quests.

row.name: Cubicle Cats
row.detailed_description: Welcome to WhiskerWorks LLC, where cats manage emails, attend meetings, and navigate corporate drama in this hilarious 8-bit office life simulator! WHAT YOU'LL DO Sort emails, master rhythm-based meetings, fix printer jams, ace compliance quizzes, make strategic decisions, and climb the corporate ladder through a series of engaging mini-games. Each day brings new challenges as you balance productivity, reputation, and burnout. INBOX SORTING - Sort emails into folders before time runs out MEETING SIMULATOR - Hit buzzwords in this rhythm-based challenge PRINTER JAM - Fix the office printer through multiple repair games COMPLIANCE TRAINING - Pass corporate quizzes to advance PROMOTION REVIEW - Navigate dialogue choices to earn promotions CEO DASHBOARD - Make strategic decisions managing company KPIs FEATURES • Multiple engaging mini-games with unique mechanics • Career progression system with promotions and stat management • Office humor and satire throughout • Charming 8-bit pixel art aesthetic • Strategic decision-making that affects outcomes • Random events and AI coworker interactions • Replayable gameplay with varied challenges Whether you're sorting emails at breakneck speed, surviving endless meetings, or managing company crises, Cubicle Cats captures the absurdity of office life with humor and style. 🐱 CONTROLS: Currently supports mouse and keyboard. Controller support coming soon!
row.short_description: Survive the 9-to-5 as a corporate cat! Sort emails, master rhythm-based meetings, fix printer jams, and make strategic decisions in this humorous 8-bit office simulator. Complete mini-games to earn promotions!

row.name: A Seagull Game
row.detailed_description: A seagull with existential wisdom, is heading toward the pier to get some fries. Unfortunately, amid the forest of high-rise buildings, it accidentally crashes into a glass window and falls into the ventilation system of an office building. In this overlooked world, a diverse array of creatures live, each with its own unique perspective on life... A self-developed 2.5D puzzle game that delights the senses with its hand-drawn visuals, cute animation and vibrant sounds. Proceed at your own pace in figuring out the routes to carefully designed levels, explore the vent world and meet new creatures. Trying to confront the meaninglessness or nihilism of life through an existentialist approach. Playtime: 15-30 mins. Features: Black & White, Hand-Drawn Art Style. Sudoku-Inspired Puzzle Mechanics. Meet new Friends! Each of them has a witty quote. Casual philosophy ideas.
row.short_description: This is a short casual 2.5D platform puzzle game with a unique hand-drawn art style. A wee seagull who wants to get some chips at the pier, but accidentally falls into a vent system of an office building…

row.name: How Smart Are You? IQ Test
row.detailed_description: How smart are you? Take this IQ test and find out! Features include a detailed IQ breakdown, question generation that allows for retesting, and a full length 50 question test. FEATURES - Detailed IQ report, with a breakdown of 5 intelligence categories . - Full length 50 question test gives greater IQ accuracy. - Question generator makes every test unique , making it possible to retake the test multiple times and diminishing gaming of the test. NOTE This IQ test is for entertainment purposes, but has been normalized in an attempt to give more accurate results. Therefore, the most important part of the test is the IQ category breakdown, which can highlight your areas of strength and weakness. The 5 categories are Mathematics, Spatial Reasoning, Short Term Memory, Logic, and Mental Efficiency. This test is especially good when you compare against someone else who was also took the test, as it works well as a comparison tool. Challenge a friend and see how you compare! ADDITIONAL INFO This game is part of the GZ Storm legacy series and was originally released on the Xbox 360 on July 22nd 2010. This version runs on PC and has some improvements.
row.short_description: How smart are you? Take this IQ test and find out!

row.name: Woodswalker
row.detailed_description: Woodswalker is an entirely solo-developed first-person survival horror game in which you've just been hired as a night ranger in the Cook County forest preserves. You must frantically balance your own survival with saving the lives of the innocent campers under your domain. Features Frantic Gameplay - Throughout the night, the monster will become increasingly aggressive. You will have less and less time to read your messages, decide its importance, and make it to the light before your fate is sealed. Many Secrets  - Explore a detailed story through puzzle-solving. Use environmental clues and good thinking to unlock boxes, find new cassette tapes, enter hidden areas, and locate secrets. A Dark, Wintry Atmosphere  - Immerse yourself into the surroundings with attention to detail on sound and lighting. Replayability - With 18 hidden achievements, a rich, secret-filled storyline, and maybe even a hidden difficulty, there is plenty to keep yourself busy with.
row.short_description: Woodswalker is a strategy-based survival horror game in which quick thinking is key. Listen closely to your surroundings, defend yourself with your searchlight, budget your limited power, and solve environmental puzzles to discover the truth of the forest.
row.notes: If I did a good job, then it should be scary. There are jumpscares and some cartoonish blood.

row.name: SIM Election
row.detailed_description: About This Game SimElection is a turn-based political simulation where you take control of a political party and face the entire road to election day. Manage your strategy, respond to media pressure, survive televised debates, control your finances, and decide how far you are willing to go to win. Every decision matters. Every turn can change the course of the campaign. A deep yet accessible political simulator In SimElection, players experience a full political term from the inside. Unexpected news, uncomfortable interviews, rumors, internal tensions, negotiations, and major media events will shape the pace of the game. Winning is not just about making promises. You must manage resources, protect your public image, control your party, and read the social climate to avoid losing support. Dynamic campaigns and realistic elections Take part in different types of elections: General Elections Regional Elections Municipal Elections Each election type has its own rules, rhythm, and consequences. Vote counting unfolds progressively, territory by territory, recreating the tension of a real election night. Decisions, consequences, and strategy The game is played in turns, where you will: Respond to political and media events Manage your party headquarters Deal with lobbies and pressure groups Make key economic decisions Face televised debates and interviews Organize campaign events and final rallies Nothing is ever completely safe — even good decisions can have unintended consequences. Total political freedom You can play with existing parties or create your own party from scratch, defining: Ideology Political positioning Territorial strategy Communication profile The system adapts to major parties, small movements, regionalist groups, and emerging political forces alike. Key Features Turn-based political simulation Full political party management Dynamic events and campaign news Interactive electoral debates Interviews and media pressure Economic and reputation systems Territorial strategy with interactive maps Progressive and realistic vote counting Multiple election types High replayability — every campaign is different Recommended for players who enjoy Management and strategy games Political and social simulators Decision-making with real consequences Emergent narrative experiences
row.short_description: Take control of a political party and compete for power in this turn-based simulation. Manage strategy, face media pressure, debates and critical decisions, negotiate alliances, and lead your party to electoral victory.

row.name: 镜之境
row.detailed_description: 游戏特色 　　 一款无需网络联机的双人合作解密游戏。 玩家需要口述交流游戏内场景中的线索，互相配合解决难题。游戏内两个可选视角的难易度与内容有所不同。 游戏玩法 　　 这是一款双人合作游戏，需要两位玩家在不同设备上同时进行游玩。玩家扮演不同角色进行探索，通过交流来交换线索。 　　游戏本身无需联网。请务必选择不同的主角。操作角色在各自游戏中的场景中移动从各自的视角寻找彼此需要的线索。您和伙伴可面对面沟通或通过社交软件、会议软件进行远程沟通。如果感到游戏较有难度或在某处沟通存在问题时，可以分享一下彼此视角下的游戏画面以降低难度。 　　 在不同时刻开始新游戏，部分场景中的某些细节可能会发生变化。 若需要探索这些细节，可尝试在不同时间与其他玩家重新开始一次游戏。 操作说明 　　键盘：方向键移动，ENTER键或Z键确认和调查，ESC键或X键取消和返回，PGUP键或PGDN键特殊互动。 　　手柄：方向键或左摇杆移动，A键确认和调查，B键取消和返回，L或R键特殊互动。 　　触屏或者鼠标：点击画面移动，点击面对的物件调查，点击屏幕左下角的镜进行特殊互动。 　　本游戏使用RM引擎制作，大多数界面的操作方式与该引擎制作的其他游戏基本相同。 背景故事 　　某个清晨，林铭与娜比收到了一个神秘的包裹，包裹里面静静地躺着一面古铜镜。 　　两人同时触碰镜面时，镜面发出了耀眼的光芒……回过神时，林铭发现自己身处一座奇怪的大房子中，而娜比似乎也在此处，却处于不同的空间，无法与林铭相见。在这里，只能听到彼此的声音。 　　就这样，平静的日常，被一面奇妙的镜子打破。这份来自未知发件人送给娜比的生日礼物使两人的冒险由此开始。 　　镜中的世界似乎由看到这面镜的人的记忆构成，充满让人熟悉的场景与事物，但也出现了许多从未见过的障碍。 　　一路上经过河谷、神殿、绘本世界，接下来能否离开这里？究竟是回到现实世界还是迷失在幻境？ 角色简介 　　 娜比 　　小时候镇子被洪水冲毁，娜比被自己的哥哥拼命救了出来。多年后独自搬到城中生活的她仍因体质较弱经常生病。 　　 林铭 　　独自一人来到城中工作的少年林铭，喜欢安稳的生活。在某次交通事故中帮助并结识了娜比。 流程与时长 　　单次游玩约45分钟左右流程。实际所需时间会因您和伙伴的游玩方式的不同而有所浮动。游戏并非单一结局。游戏中某处的选择可能会影响故事的结局。 关于我们 　　欢迎加入官方群：887884044，一起交流或寻找玩伴。
row.short_description: 某天，林铭和娜比意外掉入了一个由神秘古镜创造的世界。他们无法看到彼此，但可以听到对方的声音。现在，需要您和伙伴一起，通过交流沟通来交换彼此视角的线索，共同帮助他们离开这里。

row.name: PCUBES
row.detailed_description: This game is a 3D puzzle action game where players generate and manipulate blocks using special abilities to clear each stage. Players control a character and can create, stack, and rotate blocks. By combining these abilities, they overcome various gimmicks placed in the stages. If there is an obstacle blocking the way, players can use blocks to create a path. If a shape does not fit, they can rotate blocks to place them perfectly. If a place is too high to reach, players can stack blocks to create a foothold. Each stage contains keys and an exit. By solving gimmicks and collecting keys, players can move on to the exit. The main feature of this game is that there is no single solution. Depending on the player’s ideas and actions, the same stage can be cleared in different ways. As the game progresses, new types of blocks and gimmicks appear. This allows players to enjoy more freedom and strategic gameplay. Observe. Think. Try. Finding your own solution through repetition is the greatest fun of this game.
row.short_description: This is a 3D puzzle action game where players create and manipulate blocks using special abilities to clear stages. By stacking and rotating blocks, players overcome obstacles and gimmicks. Each stage has keys and an exit, and there is no single solution, allowing creative and flexible gameplay.

row.name: C
row.detailed_description: A game where a number goes up.  Features:  1. Open game 2. Number go up 3. Game doesn't save (infinite replay value) 4. Leave open to collect Steam items 5. Close game 6. PROFIT?!?!?!
row.short_description: A game where number goes up

row.name: Glyph Chess
row.detailed_description: Glyph Chess is a strategic board game infused with magical fantasy elements, derived from the Tales of Tarsylia . On a board where the four elements of wind, fire, water, and earth intertwine, you will command mages with distinct abilities. Your goal is to escort your Scepter to the central 'Source of Magic' or to destroy the enemy's Scepter. Core Features Seven Unique Pieces: Summoner : Summon an army to overwhelm your opponent. Illusionist : Stealth and invisibility, shifting positions at will. Abjurer : Project a Force Field to protect allies or crush enemies. Necromancer : Manipulate life and death, reviving any corpse to serve you. Diviner : Project a Divine Ward to suppress magic, the bane of all mages. Evoker : Pierce through the battlefield, incinerating everything. Scepter : The core and soul, the key to victory. Contest the Center, Unleash Metamagic The 'Source of Magic' at the center of the board is a strategic focal point. When your piece occupies the center, it gains powerful Metamagic  abilities. Controlling the center often tips the scales of victory in your favor. 2v2 Alliance Battles In four-player matches, players sitting opposite each other form an alliance. Tacit cooperation is the key to victory.
row.short_description: Glyph Chess is a strategic board game infused with magical fantasy elements, derived from the Tales of Tarsylia. You will command mages with distinct abilities to escort your Scepter to the central 'Source of Magic', or to destroy the enemy's Scepter.

row.name: Geobeast
row.detailed_description: Do you think you’re good at geography? Put your knowledge to the test with Geobeast . The concept is simple: find as many countries on the world map as possible before time runs out. At the end of each game, your score is recorded, allowing you to compete with players worldwide through the global Steam leaderboard . Normal Mode The default competitive mode in Geobeast. Each country found earns 1 point 12 minutes to find as many as possible Accuracy, memory, and speed make the difference Jumbo Mode The fun and strategic mode. A score multiplier system is introduced Find a country, then a neighboring country to double your points A third neighboring country triples the score, and so on 12 minutes to score as many points as possible Here, the goal isn’t just to find a lot of countries, but to make smart choices . Strategy is the key.
row.short_description: Test your geography skills with Geobeast! Find as many countries as you can in 12 minutes, master two unique game modes, and climb the global Steam leaderboard.

row.name: Take Care Of It.
row.detailed_description: Austin and Riley are childhood friends. Despite their tumultuous friendship in high school, things are going pretty good now in college. But that stability does not last. Something happens. Old habits resurface. Riley can fall back into old patterns, or he can draw a line. Both choices leave marks. Play as Riley as he grapples with guilt, responsibility, and personal limits.
row.short_description: Horror/thriller visual novel with RPG elements about two friends that explores guilt, co-dependency, and personal limits being pushed.
row.notes: Blood, Gore, Cannibalism, Murder Animal/Pet death Underage drinking Smoking weed Emotional abuse/manipulation Strong language

row.name: Five Nights At Monkeys: Flat Mode
row.detailed_description: Five Nights At Monkeys: Flat Mode brings the chaos and unpredictability of the original VR experience to flatscreen play. Every night is different, with changing mechanics, systems, and threats that keep you on edge. Monsters roam freely, power systems can fail at the worst times, and things rarely go as planned. Learning how to react quickly is just as important as planning ahead. Throughout the nights, you’ll find yourself moving between a range of new locations, including forest treehouses, canyon huts, city streets, and dark underground mines. Each area introduces its own mechanics, dangers, and surprises, forcing you to adapt your strategy as you go. Some nights are quiet and tense, while others spiral into chaos without warning.
row.short_description: Five Nights At Monkeys: Flat Mode is a flat screen horror experience where every night is different. Survive roaming monsters, manage tricky power systems, and face sudden jumpscares across forests, canyons, cities, and dark mines.
row.reviews: “This truely made me feel at home agian. Would recommend” 10/10 – John Fnam “Ehh i was confused at first but slowly adapted. Would recommend :)” 9.5/10 – Homeless Dude “Ce jeu est génial ! Je le recommanderais.” 9.8/10 – French Painter I Met In an Alleyway

row.name: VHSMan
row.detailed_description: 'Alice decides to watch a VHS she found in the dumpster 6 months ago and crazy stuff happens!' A Visual Novel about a magical VHS tape Updates and stuff like that will be made over time when I can, I hope you enjoy my silly little game! Featuring cool characters such as 'Alice' (The one you will be playing as) VHSMan DVDMan Floopy the floppy disk BlueRay
row.short_description: 'Alice decides to watch a VHS she found in the dumpster 6 months ago and crazy stuff happens!' A Visual Novel about a magical VHS tape

row.name: Double Cross Dungeon
row.detailed_description: Watch out, your friend may become your foe! Lost in the Temple of Nimh, your party trying to fight their way to freedom. Level up using the Ancient Cards and clearing each room of enemies as a team. All is fine until one of you is corrupted by the  Traitor Card...  Now it is not only a battle to escape but a battle to stay alive against your once friend! -=== Set Up ===- Connect 2 - 4 controllers to your laptop/PC via either Bluetooth or cable. Stand on the pressure plates to start, select your cards and fight your way through the dungeon! -=== How To Play ===- In Game (General): Movement: Left Joystick In Game Menu (Toggle): + Stats Peeks: Left Bumper Switch: Primary - Y Secondary - B Xbox: Primary - X Secondary - A Card Selection: Select Card - Left Joystick Confirm - A Deny - B -=== ===- Please note that if you wish to connect a Nintendo Switch Pro Controller as a wired controller, or experience controller vibration on a Nintendo Switch Pro Controller, you must enable Steam Input for Nintendo Switch Pro Controllers (from your Steam client controller settings) before launching the game, as Unity does not support either of these features natively. Please also make sure the 'Use Nintendo Button Layout' toggle is OFF, otherwise in-game button indicators will not be accurate.
row.short_description: The couch co-op roguelike dungeon crawler with a twist! Compete to perform the best in each room to see who gets first pick on the Ancient cards to prepare for the final fight. Will you escape with your friends, or die trying?

row.name: Sorrow's Serenade
row.detailed_description: Visit the final resting place of your beloved, fulfill the promise. Sorrow's Serenade is a micro-game delivering a concentrated 5-minute gameplay experience. This brief, emotional journey utilizes simple mechanics to tell a haunting tale of love that transcends the grave and the enduring power of a promise kept. Key Features: First-Person Perspective: Deep immersion in a hauntingly atmospheric world. Emotional Narrative: A story-driven experience focused on mood and meaning. Bite-sized Gameplay: A concise experience designed to be completed in a single 5-minute sitting. Gothic Horror: A thick, melancholic atmosphere blending dread with beauty. Simple Action Mechanics: Clear and intuitive gameplay that keeps the focus on the story. Written Dialogue: Text-based storytelling that enhances the intimate and poetic tone.
row.short_description: A brief emotional experience lasting a few minutes, centered on the quiet weight of a kept promise. A narrative-driven tale with minimal mechanics.
