row.name: BYE BYE! POLICE!
row.detailed_description: Want to enjoy stealing more casually than a thief simulator? 'BYE BYE! POLICE!' is for you! This is a high-tempo, first-person thief action game where you use 11 different upgrades to break through police blockades. Enjoy a 'smooth' stealing experience across 7 stages, including tutorials and bonus levels! [11 Strategic Upgrades to Expand Your Tactics] Vacuum Van: Allows you to toss loot into the van from a distance! Rabbit Run: Increases movement speed. Outrun the cops with pure speed! Muscle Toss: Enhances throwing power. Throw heavy loot from afar for maximum efficiency! Extra Life: Increases remaining lives. You have more than one chance to succeed! Police Scanner: Highlights police positions. Know exactly where they are at all times! Scanner Burst: Increases the number of times you can use the scanner. Burst Shoot: Throw all your held loot at once in a single burst! Police Knockout: Allows you to take down police. But beware—are you ready for the 'Felony' (more reinforcements)? Bullet Time: Slows down time. Use slow-motion to assess the situation and escape! Summon Portal: Set up a portal that teleports loot directly to your van! Portal Plus: Increases the number of portals you can place. Build the perfect escape route. [7 Challenging Stages] Tutorial Trailer House The Bar Mansion The City Bonus Stages (Past game locations turned into heist scenes!?) Apartment Ruins - Streaming Guidelines - We welcome video posts and live streams of this game! Monetization is also permitted. The creator would be very happy if you could do the following: Link back to the store: Include the Steam store URL in your video description (Optional). Include the title: Please put 'BYE BYE! POLICE!' in your video title (The creator would love to find and watch your gameplay!).
row.short_description: Steal, Escape, and Power Up! 'BYE BYE! POLICE!' is a high-octane, first-person heist action game set in a stylized world. Evade the police blockade, cash in your loot, and upgrade your abilities. Master various skills to pull off the ultimate, 'smooth' robbery!

row.name: Downfall MMORPG
row.detailed_description: Sci-Fi and Fantasy Collide in a Living Open World Downfall MMORPG is a cross-genre open-world MMORPG where advanced technology clashes with ancient magic in a persistent, player-driven war. Choose your allegiance. Shape your playstyle. Decide the fate of an entire planet. Two Factions. One World. Endless Conflict. Kaelthera is home to the Lumen, a nature-bound civilization capable of wielding powerful magic drawn from the planet itself. Their world is under siege by the Coalition, a technologically superior spacefaring force stranded after a catastrophic crash and now determined to claim Kaelthera’s resources at any cost. Your choice of faction defines your journey: Embrace fantasy combat, ancient powers, and primal weapons Or step into a sci-fi RPG experience with firearms, mechs, and advanced armor Play Your Way Downfall is designed to adapt to your preferred MMORPG playstyle: Engage in large-scale PvP battles where entire servers fight for faction dominance Focus on PvE progression, hunting wildlife, elite enemies, and world bosses Explore a fully open world solo, with friends, or as part of a guild Mix and match gear, skills, and classes to create your own unique build Every choice matters. Every battle leaves a mark. Deep Customization & Progression 18 playable classes, each with unique abilities All classes can equip all weapons and armor Skillsets dynamically change based on equipped items Hundreds of items ranging from medieval weapons to futuristic firearms Upgrade and enhance your gear to push your power to its limits A True Open World MMORPG Fully open world with 7 distinct regions Seamless exploration without artificial barriers Dynamic environments and procedurally generated instances for infinite PvE replayability Dedicated PvP zone featuring massive faction-wide conflicts and rewards Cooperative & Social Gameplay Form parties, alliances, and guilds Take on epic bosses and high-risk content together Own pets that assist you in combat Collect mounts to traverse Kaelthera faster Key Features Open-world Sci-Fi & Fantasy MMORPG PvP and PvE gameplay at massive scale Two factions with distinct themes and playstyles Procedurally generated content for endless replayability Legendary loot, heroic quests, and world-changing battles The war for Kaelthera has begun. Choose your side. Forge your build. Welcome to Downfall MMORPG.
row.short_description: Downfall MMORPG is an open-world sci-fi & fantasy MMORPG where magic and technology collide. Choose a faction, forge your own playstyle, and fight for control of a living world in massive PvP battles and endless PvE adventures.

row.name: A Date With Chester 2
row.detailed_description: Has it been three years already? A Date With Chester 2 is a short, standalone story about remembering the good times. You've been with Chester for a while now. Have things gotten a little too comfortable? It's your anniversary today, and you've got something really special planned. You wonder what he's got in store for you... Hey, snap out of it - you've been planning this for a long time! Features: A short but thrilling experience - 30 minute to 1 hour expected playtime.  A nostalgic aesthetic that blends 3D with hand-drawn 2D art. ONE OR MORE otters! (There's one.) MORE THAN ONE ending! (....... There's two.) Twists and turns shake up the gameplay, guaranteed to keep your heart racing! A fresh, unexpected blend of genres, including point-and-click elements and tense first-person sections. Loads of collectible items scattered throughout - seek them out to unlock Chester's deepest hopes and fears. Note: Love can be a bit scary sometimes. That's okay, right?
row.short_description: It's been three years since your first date with Chester the Otter. It's your anniversary today, and you've both got surprises in store. Are you ready for a date that's truly out of this world?

row.name: Agent C
row.detailed_description: Experience the thrill of aerial combat with Agent C, an action-packed shooting game that puts you in control of a powerful helicopter. Engage in intense battles as you take aim at enemy tanks and strategize your way to victory. With dynamic gameplay and immersive graphics, Agent C offers an exhilarating challenge for gamers seeking adrenaline-fueled excitement. Dominate the skies and prove your skills in this ultimate test of precision and reflexes. Get ready to soar and conquer!
row.short_description: Agent C is the ultimate stealth survivor designed for tactical operations. This innovative character excels in infiltrating military bases, utilizing advanced stealth techniques to navigate through enemy lines undetected with the added capability of piloting a powerful helicopter.

row.name: Touhou Mistystory
row.detailed_description: A free-to-play, single-player, fan-made bullet hell shooter based on the Touhou Project, incorporating light roguelike elements and modifying the original game rules. Defeat your enemies and collect dropped spell cards to enhance your abilities (or sell them). In addition, the game's framework has been significantly modified, with substantial changes to resource collection and usage logic. You can use dodge actions or hide off-screen to avoid enemy attacks. Furthermore, this game is built on the Godot engine, demonstrating Godot's potential to create visually appealing 3D games. The game was originally intended for a university game development competition; now that the competition is over, it's being released for free play.
row.short_description: A free-to-play, single-player Touhou Project fan-made bullet hell shooter that blends light roguelike elements with modified gameplay mechanics. Defeat your enemies and collect dropped spell cards to enhance your abilities!

row.name: Paperback
row.detailed_description: Dawn Of The Millenium  - the year is 2001 . You're a novice librarian tasked with keeping things running smoothly and closing up shop for the night. Sort out the shelves, maintain the utilities of the library and take calls as they come in - but keep your ears to the ground; there's something sinister unfurling in Maple Falls County Logic-oriented puzzles and mechanics make up most of this game with a fully integrated physics and object-grabbing system, drawing inspiration from horror games of the past and present. The game takes roughly 30-60 minutes to finish depending on your own individual pace. It features multiple paths the player can take, and even has a secret easter egg. Think you can find it?  Highly recommended for playing in the dark - the muted orange hue of the library coupled with the dark atmosphere should be very easy on the eyes. An ideal game for those seeking a cozy indie horror experience. Also, headphones are a big must if you enjoy immersive 3D sound design. Disclaimer Regarding AI Usage This game does not feature any AI content. All voice lines, assets, texts and sound effects have been produced naturally by verified users and commissioned artists. If you think a particular asset featured in the game was generated by AI, please reach out to me at morningraininteractive@gmail.com
row.short_description: Paperback is a short horror game that takes place in a public library at night with an aggressive thunderstorm raging in the vicinity where you take on the role of the newly hired novice librarian, Max.
row.notes: This game contains flashing lights, loud sounds as well as depictions and insinuations of violence that may not be suitable for all audiences.

row.name: Robo Dolphin Escape
row.detailed_description: You emerge in an underwater military testing site, next to a mysterious portal. If you can move fast enough, you might just be able to enter the portal, and make your escape. The site is littered with mechanical foes, which are best slain through the clever coordination of their own attacks. Full features list: Enemies  - Fight against 4 types of aquatic machines, each with their own attack patterns. As you explore the facility, enemies become stronger and more frequent! Devices  - Start each game with one of 6 special abilities, which can protect you from harm, distract enemies, or just straight-up kill them. Game Modifiers  - Make the game easier or harder with the choice of 10 different gamemodes, which can all be enabled in parallel with each other. There's also 2 super-challenge modes for pros. Highscores  - Earn score by defeating enemies. Your best scores are saved locally, so you can cherish them forever. Original Soundtrack  - Listen to the 5 songs (honestly not that many) I made for this game. Each song is inspired by one of the game's characters! Pixel Graphics  -   Enjoy a nostalgic pixel-art aesthetic.
row.short_description: Break out of a top-secret military operation! To enter the portal that leads to your escape, you must thwart an army of fish-like machines and collect their power-ups.

row.name: Channel 4 Midnight
row.detailed_description: You are far away from home. Winter chills you to the bone. Staying at a dingy inn, you perform an old ritual that who-knows-whom on the internet taught you. This is a story-driven, first person horror game of 15-20 minutes of gameplay. Guidelines to the ritual are hinted at in a blog called The Channels, which can only be accessed through the inn's private network. You read the page carefully and follow the guidelines. Then you will be fine. At the end of a successful ritual, you will be rewarded by being transformed into someone completely different from who you are. Well, how does that sound? Tempting? Then give it a try.
row.short_description: A bite-sized psychological horror game about a wayward soul who seeks transformation through a sinister ritual.
row.notes: Content warnings include but are not limited to: blood, corpse

row.name: Game Saloon Simulator: Prologue
row.detailed_description: [ Game Saloon Simulator: Prologue is a free version prepared for you to experience the  Game Saloon Simulator in advance. This version contains limited content and allows you to try out the general mechanics of the game.] Game Saloon Simulator invites you to become the boss of your own entertainment hall! Are you ready to turn a small bar into a giant gaming complex? In this game, you will serve customers their orders and manage a wide variety of arcade machines. By purchasing and placing classic arcade machines, you can increase your saloon’s appeal and expand your venue by unlocking new areas. But that’s not all — just like your customers, you can also enjoy the games! Grow your business while having fun in your own game saloon. Key Features: Expandable saloon system Interactive entertainment equipment Service mechanics that increase customer satisfaction Freedom to design your own play area Relaxing, humorous, and enjoyable simulation experience Build the 'Game Saloon' you’ve always dreamed of — manage it and have fun!
row.short_description: Step into the world of fun and become the boss of your own game saloon! In this free version of the game, you’ll serve customers, enjoy interactive games, and get a taste of the relaxing and enjoyable experience that awaits you.

row.name: 天使戦争 Angels' War
row.detailed_description: Is there salvation in this 'world'? 天使戦争 Angels' War is a free fan-made 'souls-like' action game, featuring Amane Kanata from Hololive 4th Gen as the main character. In this game, our angel Amane Kanata soars the sky to reach the end of this imaginary world. This is a short game featuring only a few boss fights. Note from the Author Inspired by Amane Kanata's 3D Live, I started developing this game as a passion side project mid-2025. As a Heimin (Kanata‘s fan), I wanted to create an experience where Kanata is flying in the sky, overcoming any obstacles she faces, just like the legendary idol and VTuber herself. The original scope was bigger, and the project was initially planned to be finished in 2027. After Kanata’s graduation announcement on December 2nd, 2025, I almost gave up on this game for... a day. But in the end, I decided that I had something I needed to express, and that I still had an experience I wanted to share in this game. I decided to take a break from work until Christmas 2025, holing myself up in my apartment to finish the game with reduced scope, 'if this game would at least function as a game by then, I would release it as a free and non-commercial game available to the world'. I managed to finish it 2 hours before Kanata's farewell live concert on December 27, 2025. Note that the narrative is strongly fan-oriented. In certain situations in the game, messages collected from fellow Heimins will appear at random. Through this, we hope to let at least one player know that 'you are not alone.'   These messages are presented in their original languages, mostly Japanese. The game may be short and feel unpolished, and it is a very different game from the original vision, but still, I tried my best in this short period to convey the experience I want to share. If you find enjoyment, I would be very happy. -Windy Darian Controls Controls manual is also available at in-game pause menu. Controller recommended. Controller: L2/LT: Fly Square/X: Dodge R1/RB: Punch R2/RT: Shuriken Left Thumbstick: Move Right Thumbstick: Camera R3/RS: Lock on Mouse/Keyboard: Space: Fly Left Shift: Dodge LMB: Punch RMB: Shuriken WASD: Move Mouse: Camera Q/MMB: Lock on Disclaimer This game is a personal, free and non-commercial derivative work featuring character Amane Kanata © COVER Corp. / Hololive Production. This game was made following the official Derivative Works Guidelines from COVER Corp. . This game is not endorsed by, sponsored by, or affiliated with COVER Corp. or Hololive Production. For third-party assets used, please refer to third_party.txt in the game folder.
row.short_description: Our angel Amane Kanata soars the sky in this short 'souls-like' action game.

row.name: Hopping Ninja-san
row.detailed_description: Control Hopping Ninja-san and bounce your way to the goal. Hopping Ninja-san automatically jumps off the ground and walls. You only need two buttons: rotate left or right to adjust your angle and jump over obstacles. It’s a high-difficulty, skill-based platformer, but frequent checkpoints make it approachable even for beginners. Hitting your head sends you back to the last checkpoint. The game can be completed in about 1–2 hours.
row.short_description: Hop your way to the goal as Hopping Ninja-san! A high-difficulty game with simple controls — just be careful not to hit your head.

row.name: Down With Hell: Crystal
row.detailed_description: In this adventure you'll find yourself journeying through ruins to find an oasis said to grant a short burst of unlimited power, you are headed there to open a portal to the heavens to retrieve 'God's Crystal'. Play as M in this retro styled 2D shooter and blast your way up to the heavens! Scale walls with your versatile wall jump & blast enemies with your GUN! Defeat enemies to collect encyclopedia pages to learn more about each enemy! Features a difficult New Game +
row.short_description: Play as M in this retro styled platform-shooter and blast your way up to heaven!
row.notes: Heavy use of profanity Animated blood Brief mention of pornographic material.
